<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-b-1/Scripts/_-Systems/ToolSystem/ToolBaseSub/ToolMagnet.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using TMPro;
using SPACE_UTIL;

// deps: IMagnetGrabbable (owned) — ZERO concrete phase imports

/// <summary>
/// Hold RMB → OverlapSphere → SpringJoint per nearby Rigidbody → they fly toward me.
/// LMB launches all forward. R drops gently. Q cycles selection mode.
/// Filter modes use IMagnetGrabbable: skip objects in baskets or on conveyors.
/// On grab: SetMagnetHolder(this). On release: ClearMagnetHolder().
/// Without IMagnetGrabbable impl: grabs everything, no filter, no holder. Still works.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Tools/ToolMagnet")]
public class ToolMagnet : BaseHeldTool
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] float _pullRadius = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _pushForce = 3f;
	[SerializeField] float _dropForce = 1f;
	[SerializeField] Transform _pullOrigin;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _grabbableLayer;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _selectionModeText;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	struct DroppedBodyInfo { public Rigidbody Rb; public float Timer; }
	MagnetToolSelectionMode selectionMode;
	List<Rigidbody> heldBodies = new List<Rigidbody>();
	List<SpringJoint> joints = new List<SpringJoint>();
	List<GameObject> anchors = new List<GameObject>();
	bool wantsToMagnet;
	Vector3 pullTargetVelocity, lastPlayerPos, playerVelocity;
	readonly List<DroppedBodyInfo> droppedBodies = new List<DroppedBodyInfo>();
	#endregion

	#region Grab
	/// <summary> OverlapSphere → filter via IMagnetGrabbable → SpringJoint per body → SetMagnetHolder. </summary>
	void GrabNearbyObjects()
	{
		Collider[] cols = Physics.OverlapSphere(_pullOrigin.position, _pullRadius, _grabbableLayer);
		foreach (var col in cols)
		{
			if (col.CompareTag("MarkedForDestruction")) continue;
			Rigidbody rb = col.attachedRigidbody;
			if (rb == null || heldBodies.Contains(rb)) continue;
			// → filter via IMagnetGrabbable (OrePiece implements in Phase C)
			IMagnetGrabbable grabbable = rb.GetComponentInParent<IMagnetGrabbable>();
			if (selectionMode == MagnetToolSelectionMode.ResourcesNotInFilter
				|| selectionMode == MagnetToolSelectionMode.ResourcesNotOnConveyors)
			{
				if (grabbable == null) continue;
				if (grabbable.IsInBasket()) continue;
				if (selectionMode == MagnetToolSelectionMode.ResourcesNotOnConveyors && grabbable.IsOnConveyor()) continue;
			}
			// → create anchor + SpringJoint
			GameObject anchor = new GameObject("MagnetAnchor");
			anchor.transform.position = _pullOrigin.position;
			anchor.transform.parent = _pullOrigin;
			anchor.AddComponent<Rigidbody>().isKinematic = true;
			SpringJoint sj = anchor.AddComponent<SpringJoint>();
			sj.connectedBody = rb; sj.autoConfigureConnectedAnchor = false;
			sj.connectedAnchor = rb.transform.InverseTransformPoint(col.transform.position);
			sj.spring = 100f; sj.damper = 25f; sj.maxDistance = 0.01f;
			sj.breakForce = 120f; sj.breakTorque = 20f;
			rb.linearDamping = 3f; rb.angularDamping = 1.5f;
			rb.interpolation = RigidbodyInterpolation.Interpolate;
			if (ownerCam != null) UtilsPhaseB.IgnoreAllCollisions(rb.gameObject, ownerCam.transform.root.gameObject, true);
			droppedBodies.RemoveAll(d => d.Rb == rb);
			heldBodies.Add(rb); joints.Add(sj); anchors.Add(anchor);
			grabbable?.SetMagnetHolder(this, detachRb => DetachBody(detachRb));
		}
		wantsToMagnet = false;
	}
	#endregion

	#region Drop
	/// <summary> Destroys joints, launches bodies forward, restores drag, ClearMagnetHolder. </summary>
	void DropObjects(float force)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < joints.Count; i++)
			if (joints[i] != null) Destroy(joints[i].gameObject);
		joints.Clear(); anchors.Clear();
		foreach (var rb in heldBodies)
		{
			if (rb == null) continue;
			if (ownerCam != null) rb.AddForce(ownerCam.transform.forward * force, ForceMode.Impulse);
			rb.linearDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_LINEAR_DAMPING;
			rb.angularDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_ANGULAR_DAMPING;
			if (ownerCam != null) UtilsPhaseB.IgnoreAllCollisions(rb.gameObject, ownerCam.transform.root.gameObject, false);
			droppedBodies.Add(new DroppedBodyInfo { Rb = rb, Timer = 3f });
			rb.GetComponentInParent<IMagnetGrabbable>()?.ClearMagnetHolder();
		}
		heldBodies.Clear();
	}

	/// <summary> External: SellerMachine calls this to force-release a specific body before selling. </summary>
	public void DetachBody(Rigidbody rb)
	{
		if (rb == null) return;
		int idx = heldBodies.IndexOf(rb);
		if (idx < 0) return;
		if (idx < joints.Count && joints[idx] != null) Destroy(joints[idx].gameObject);
		if (idx < anchors.Count && anchors[idx] != null) Destroy(anchors[idx]);
		joints.RemoveAt(idx); anchors.RemoveAt(idx); heldBodies.RemoveAt(idx);
		rb.linearDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_LINEAR_DAMPING;
		rb.angularDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_ANGULAR_DAMPING;
		if (ownerCam != null) UtilsPhaseB.IgnoreAllCollisions(rb.gameObject, ownerCam.transform.root.gameObject, false);
		droppedBodies.Add(new DroppedBodyInfo { Rb = rb, Timer = 3f });
		rb.GetComponentInParent<IMagnetGrabbable>()?.ClearMagnetHolder();
	}
	#endregion

	#region Cleanup
	void CleanupBrokenJoints()
	{
		for (int i = joints.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			if (joints[i] == null || joints[i].connectedBody == null)
			{
				if (i < anchors.Count && anchors[i] != null) Destroy(anchors[i]);
				if (i < heldBodies.Count)
				{
					Rigidbody rb = heldBodies[i];
					if (rb != null) { rb.linearDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_LINEAR_DAMPING; rb.angularDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_ANGULAR_DAMPING; }
					heldBodies.RemoveAt(i);
				}
				joints.RemoveAt(i); anchors.RemoveAt(i);
			}
		}
	}
	void CleanupDroppedBodies()
	{
		for (int i = droppedBodies.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			var info = droppedBodies[i];
			if (info.Rb == null) { droppedBodies.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
			info.Timer -= Time.fixedDeltaTime;
			if (info.Timer <= 0f) { info.Rb.interpolation = RigidbodyInterpolation.None; droppedBodies.RemoveAt(i); }
			else droppedBodies[i] = info;
		}
	}
	void CycleSelectionMode()
	{
		var modes = (MagnetToolSelectionMode[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(MagnetToolSelectionMode));
		int next = (Array.IndexOf(modes, selectionMode) + 1) % modes.Length;
		selectionMode = modes[next];
		if (_selectionModeText != null) _selectionModeText.text = selectionMode.ToString();
	}
	#endregion

	#region Overrides
	public override void SecondaryFireHeld() => wantsToMagnet = true;
	public override void PrimaryFire() => DropObjects(_pushForce);
	public override void Reload() => DropObjects(_dropForce);
	public override void QButtonPressed() => CycleSelectionMode();
	public override void DropItem() { DropObjects(_dropForce); base.DropItem(); }
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	protected override void OnEnable() { base.OnEnable(); if (_selectionModeText != null) _selectionModeText.text = selectionMode.ToString(); }
	protected override void OnDisable() { base.OnDisable(); DropObjects(_dropForce); }
	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (ownerCam == null) return;
		Vector3 pos = ownerCam.transform.root.position;
		playerVelocity = (pos - lastPlayerPos) / Time.fixedDeltaTime;
		lastPlayerPos = pos;
		Vector3 target = ownerMagnetToolPos.position + playerVelocity * Time.fixedDeltaTime * 10f;
		_pullOrigin.position = Vector3.SmoothDamp(_pullOrigin.position, target, ref pullTargetVelocity, 0.03f, 10f, Time.fixedDeltaTime);
		CleanupBrokenJoints(); CleanupDroppedBodies();
		if (wantsToMagnet) GrabNearbyObjects();
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-b-1/Scripts/_-Systems/ToolSystem/ToolBaseSub/ToolPickaxe.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IDamageable (owned), ICrushable (owned) — ZERO concrete phase imports

/// <summary>
/// Hold left-click → swing animation → 0.2s delay → raycast from camera.
/// Checks ICrushable first (ore→crushed), then IDamageable (ore node health),
/// then Rigidbody (physics push). All via interface — no OrePiece import.
/// Fires RaisePickaxeHit for particles (ParticleManager subscribes in Phase C).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Tools/ToolPickaxe")]
public class ToolPickaxe : BaseHeldTool
{
	[SerializeField] float _useRange = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _damage = 10f;
	[SerializeField] float _attackCooldown = 1f;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _hitLayers;
	[SerializeField] bool _canBreakOreIntoCrushed;

	float lastAttackTime = -1f;

	void SwingPickaxe()
	{
		if (ownerCam == null) return;
		if (_viewModelAnimator != null) _viewModelAnimator.Play(AnimParamType.attack1.ToString(), -1, 0f);
		StartCoroutine(PerformAttack(0.2f));
		lastAttackTime = Time.time;
	}

	/// <summary> Delayed raycast: ICrushable → IDamageable → Rigidbody. All via interface. </summary>
	IEnumerator PerformAttack(float delaySeconds)
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(delaySeconds);
		if (!gameObject.activeInHierarchy || ownerCam == null) yield break;
		if (!Physics.Raycast(ownerCam.transform.position, ownerCam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, _useRange, _hitLayers))
			yield break;
		// → ICrushable: special pickaxe converts ore to crushed variant
		if (_canBreakOreIntoCrushed)
		{
			ICrushable crushable = hit.collider.GetComponent<ICrushable>();
			if (crushable != null && crushable.CanCrush() && crushable.TryCrush())
			{
				// purpose: ParticleManager subscribes → creates hit particle
				GameEvents.RaisePickaxeHit(hit.point, hit.normal, true);
				yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
				UtilsPhaseB.SimpleExplosion(hit.point, 0.5f, 2f, 0.5f);
				yield break;
			}
		}
		// → IDamageable: deal damage to ore node / damageable ore piece
		IDamageable damageable = hit.collider.GetComponent<IDamageable>();
		if (damageable != null)
		{
			damageable.TakeDamage(_damage, hit.point);
			// purpose: ParticleManager subscribes → creates ore hit particle
			GameEvents.RaisePickaxeHit(hit.point, hit.normal, true);
		}
		else
		{
			// purpose: ParticleManager subscribes → creates generic hit particle
			GameEvents.RaisePickaxeHit(hit.point, hit.normal, false);
		}
		// → Rigidbody: physics push
		Rigidbody hitRb = hit.collider.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
		if (hitRb != null)
		{
			hitRb.AddForceAtPosition(ownerCam.transform.forward * 5f, hit.point, ForceMode.Impulse);
			PhysicsSoundPlayer soundPlayer = hitRb.GetComponent<PhysicsSoundPlayer>();
			if (soundPlayer != null) soundPlayer.PlayImpactSound();
		}
	}

	public override void PrimaryFire() { }
	public override void PrimaryFireHeld()
	{
		if (Time.time - lastAttackTime >= _attackCooldown) SwingPickaxe();
	}
}

using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IScannable (owned) — ZERO concrete phase imports

[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Tools/ToolResourceScanner")]
public class ToolResourceScanner : BaseHeldTool
{
	[SerializeField] float _useRange = 3f;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _thingNameText;

		if (ownerCam == null) return;
		string text = "No Target";
		if (Physics.Raycast(ownerCam.transform.position, ownerCam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, _useRange))

	}
	public override void PrimaryFire() { }

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-b-1/prototype/Proto_ToolSystem.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE PROTOTYPE — Full ToolSystem with complete architecture. Zero external deps.
/// Drop on empty GO → Press Play. Creates everything at runtime with primitives.
///
/// MIRRORS THE REAL ARCHITECTURE:
///   ✅ 9 INTERNAL interfaces (ToolSystem owns): IDamageable, ICrushable, IMagnetGrabbable,
///      IScannable, IHammerTarget, ISupportToggleable, IMoldReceiver, IBuildingToolContext, IDrillBitHost
///   ✅ 5 EXTERNAL interfaces (from other systems): IInteractable, IInventoryItem,
///      IHighlightable, ISaveLoadableObject, IIconItem
///   ✅ Inline GameEvents — static Action fields + LogEvent wrapper + frame number
///   ✅ Inline enums — InteractionType, MagnetToolSelectionMode, AnimParamType
///   ✅ Inline SO_InteractionOption — interaction wheel options
///   ✅ Inline InventorySystem — hotbar slots, pickup via IInventoryItem, equip/drop
///   ✅ Inline HighlightSystem — raycast → IHighlightable → color tint
///   ✅ Inline ItemEquipBridge — OnItemEquipped → SetOwnerContext
///   ✅ Inline BaseSellableItem → BasePhysicsObject chain
///   ✅ Tools on ground implement IInteractable (E to pickup via "Take")
///   ✅ Tools implement IHighlightable (tint when looked at)
///   ✅ Tools implement IInventoryItem (stored in hotbar)
///   ✅ Tools implement ISaveLoadableObject (stub — Phase G fills)
///
/// 11 tools covered (switch with number keys or E to pickup from ground):
///   1-9 = switch tool, 0 = drop, E = interact (pickup tool / interact with world)
///   LMB/RMB = tool primary/secondary, R = reload, Q = Q-action
///   Tab = toggle inventory view, N = spawn ore, M = spawn node, L = dump event log
/// </summary>
public class Proto_ToolSystem : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inline Interfaces (same as real ToolSystem)
    public interface IDamageable { void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 position); }
    public interface ICrushable { bool CanCrush(); bool TryCrush(); }
    public interface IMagnetGrabbable { void SetMagnetHolder(MonoBehaviour holder); void ClearMagnetHolder(); bool IsInBasket(); bool IsOnConveyor(); }
    public interface IScannable { string GetScanDisplayName(); }
    public interface IHammerTarget { void OnHammerPrimary(); void OnHammerSecondary(); }
    public interface ISupportToggleable { void SetSupportsEnabled(bool enabled); }
    public interface IMoldReceiver { void InsertMold(int moldType); }
    public interface IBuildingToolContext { void UpdateGhost(Vector3 aim, Quaternion rot, int idx); bool CanPlace(); void Place(); void Cleanup(); }
    public interface IDrillBitHost { float GetDrillSpeed(); void AttachDrillBit(MonoBehaviour bit); void DetachDrillBit(); bool GetIsOn(); }
    #endregion

    #region External Interfaces (from other systems — BaseHeldTool implements these)
    // IInteractable — from InteractionSystem (Phase A). Tools on ground show "Take"/"Destroy" when E pressed.
    public interface IInteractable { bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel(); string GetObjectName(); List<PInteractionOption> GetOptions(); void Interact(PInteractionOption opt); }
    // IInventoryItem — from InventorySystem (Phase B). Tools stored in hotbar slots.
    public interface IInventoryItem { string GetName(); string GetDescription(); int GetQty(); void SetQty(int v); int GetMaxAmount(); bool GetShouldEquipWhenPickedUp(); Sprite GetIcon(); GameObject GetGameObject(); void OnEquipped(); void HandleActiveInput(); void SetOwnerContext(Camera cam, Transform container, Transform magnetPos); void DropItem(); string GetControlsText(); }
    // IHighlightable — from HighlightSystem (Phase B). Outlined when player looks at them.
    public interface IHighlightable { int GetHighlightColor(); } // returns color index: 0=cyan, 1=green, 2=red
    // ISaveLoadableObject — from SaveSystem (Phase G stub). Discovered via FindObjectsOfType.
    public interface ISaveLoadableObject { bool ShouldBeSaved(); string GetCustomSaveData(); void LoadFromSave(string json); }
    // IIconItem — from Phase B. GetIcon() display contract.
    public interface IIconItem { Sprite GetIcon(); }
    #endregion

    #region Inline GameEvents (mirrors real GameEvents — static Action fields + LogEvent)
    // → domain reload cleanup: all nulled in Start() (Pitfall #9)
    static Action<IInventoryItem> OnToolPickupRequested;
    static Action<IInventoryItem> OnItemEquipped;
    static Action<IInventoryItem> OnItemPickedUp;
    static Action<IInventoryItem> OnItemDropped;
    static Action<int> OnToolSwitched;
    static Action<bool> OnMenuStateChanged;
    static Action<Vector3, Vector3, bool> OnPickaxeHit;
    static List<string> eventLog = new List<string>();

    static void LogEvent(string name, string detail = "")
    {
        string entry = $"[{Time.frameCount}] {name}{(detail != "" ? $"({detail})" : "")}";
        eventLog.Add(entry); Debug.Log(entry);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Inline Enums (mirrors GlobalEnumsB)
    public enum InteractionType { take, destroy, toggle, pack, switchDirection }
    public enum MagnetToolSelectionMode { everything, resourcesNotInFilter, resourcesNotOnConveyors }
    public enum AnimParamType { attack1, idle }
    #endregion

    #region Inline SO_InteractionOption (mirrors real SO_InteractionOption)
    [Serializable]
    public class PInteractionOption { public string name; public InteractionType type; }
    #endregion

    #region State
    Camera cam; CharacterController cc; float pitch;
    // tool state
    int activeTool = 0;
    PTool[] hotbar = new PTool[10]; // 1-9 slots + 0 unused
    PTool equippedTool;
    IHighlightable highlighted; Renderer highlightedRenderer; Color highlightOrigColor;
    bool isMenuOpen;
    // magnet shared state
    List<Rigidbody> magnetBodies = new List<Rigidbody>();
    List<SpringJoint> magnetJoints = new List<SpringJoint>();
    List<GameObject> magnetAnchors = new List<GameObject>();
    Transform magnetOrigin;
    int magnetFilter;
    bool magnetWants;
    // builder
    PBuildCtx buildCtx;
    GameObject ghost;
    Quaternion buildRot = Quaternion.identity;
    // drill
    PDrillHost drillHost;
    float drillDurability = 1f;
    // mining hat
    bool hatLightOn;
    GameObject hatLight;
    // scanner
    string scanText = "No Target";
    float attackCooldown = 0.8f, lastAttack = -1f;
    #endregion

    void Start()
    {
        // → Pitfall #9: domain reload cleanup
        OnToolPickupRequested = null; OnItemEquipped = null; OnItemPickedUp = null;
        OnItemDropped = null; OnToolSwitched = null; OnMenuStateChanged = null; OnPickaxeHit = null;
        eventLog.Clear();

        // → Subscribe GameEvents (mirrors real subscription order)
        // 1. InventoryOrchestrator-like: handles pickup
        OnToolPickupRequested += item => {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) { if (hotbar[i] == null) { hotbar[i] = item.GetGameObject().GetComponent<PTool>(); item.GetGameObject().SetActive(false); LogEvent("Inventory", $"added to slot {i}: {item.GetName()}"); if (item.GetShouldEquipWhenPickedUp()) EquipSlot(i); OnItemPickedUp?.Invoke(item); return; } }
            LogEvent("Inventory", "FULL — can't pickup"); };
        // 2. ItemEquipBridge-like: pushes context on equip
        OnItemEquipped += item => { item.SetOwnerContext(cam, magnetOrigin, magnetOrigin); LogEvent("Bridge", $"SetOwnerContext → {item.GetName()}"); };
        // 3. MenuStateChanged: cursor + input block
        OnMenuStateChanged += open => { isMenuOpen = open; Cursor.lockState = open ? CursorLockMode.None : CursorLockMode.Locked; LogEvent("MenuState", open.ToString()); };
        // 4. PickaxeHit: particle stand-in (log only in proto)
        OnPickaxeHit += (pos, normal, isDmg) => LogEvent("PickaxeHit", $"pos={pos} dmg={isDmg}");

        // player
        cc = gameObject.AddComponent<CharacterController>(); cc.height = 1.8f;
        transform.position = new Vector3(0, 1, -3);
        var camGO = new GameObject("Cam"); camGO.transform.parent = transform;
        camGO.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 0.8f, 0);
        cam = camGO.AddComponent<Camera>(); cam.nearClipPlane = 0.1f;
        // magnet origin
        magnetOrigin = new GameObject("MagnetOrigin").transform;
        magnetOrigin.parent = camGO.transform; magnetOrigin.localPosition = Vector3.forward * 1.5f;
        // hat light
        hatLight = new GameObject("HatLight");
        var lt = hatLight.AddComponent<Light>(); lt.type = LightType.Spot; lt.range = 15; lt.spotAngle = 60;
        hatLight.transform.parent = camGO.transform; hatLight.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
        hatLight.SetActive(false);
        // ghost for builder
        ghost = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); ghost.name = "Ghost";
        Destroy(ghost.GetComponent<Collider>());
        var gr = ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>(); gr.material.color = new Color(0, 1, 0, 0.3f);
        SetTransparent(gr.material); ghost.SetActive(false);
        // build context
        buildCtx = gameObject.AddComponent<PBuildCtx>(); buildCtx.ghost = ghost; buildCtx.proto = this;
        // drill host machine
        var drillGO = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        drillGO.name = "DrillMachine"; drillGO.transform.position = new Vector3(8, 0.5f, 6);
        drillGO.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.cyan;
        drillHost = drillGO.AddComponent<PDrillHost>();
        // world objects
        CreateFloor();
        SpawnOreNode(new Vector3(3, 0.5f, 3));
        SpawnOreNode(new Vector3(-3, 0.5f, 4));
        SpawnOrePiece(new Vector3(1, 0.3f, 2));
        SpawnOrePiece(new Vector3(2, 0.3f, 1));
        SpawnBuilding(new Vector3(-2, 0.5f, 2));
        SpawnBuilding(new Vector3(5, 0.5f, 0));
        SpawnFurnaceMold(new Vector3(6, 0.5f, 3));
        // → spawn tools on ground (implement IInteractable — E to pickup)
        SpawnToolOnGround("Pickaxe", new Vector3(-1, 0.2f, 0), Color.white, 1);
        SpawnToolOnGround("Magnet", new Vector3(0, 0.2f, 0), Color.magenta, 2);
        SpawnToolOnGround("Hammer", new Vector3(1, 0.2f, 0), Color.gray, 3);
        SpawnToolOnGround("MiningHat", new Vector3(2, 0.2f, 0), Color.yellow, 4);
        // light
        var dlt = new GameObject("DirLight").AddComponent<Light>();
        dlt.type = LightType.Directional; dlt.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50, -30, 0);
        Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
        Log("READY", "E=interact 1-9=switch 0=drop WASD LMB/RMB R Q N M Tab L");
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (isMenuOpen) { if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Tab) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape)) OnMenuStateChanged?.Invoke(false); return; }
        Move();
        HandleHighlight();
        HandleInteract();
        HandleToolSwitch();
        HandleToolAction();
        if (activeTool == 6) ScannerUpdate();
        if (activeTool == 9) DrillUpdate();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.N)) SpawnOrePiece(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 2f + Vector3.up);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.M)) SpawnOreNode(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 3f);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Tab)) OnMenuStateChanged?.Invoke(true);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.L)) DumpLog();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape)) Cursor.lockState = Cursor.lockState == CursorLockMode.Locked ? CursorLockMode.None : CursorLockMode.Locked;
    }

    #region Highlight System (inline — mirrors ObjectHighlighterManager)
    void HandleHighlight()
    {
        // → clear previous
        if (highlightedRenderer != null) { highlightedRenderer.material.color = highlightOrigColor; highlightedRenderer = null; highlighted = null; }
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 5f)) return;
        var hl = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IHighlightable>();
        if (hl == null) return;
        highlighted = hl;
        highlightedRenderer = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<Renderer>();
        if (highlightedRenderer != null) { highlightOrigColor = highlightedRenderer.material.color; highlightedRenderer.material.color = Color.Lerp(highlightOrigColor, Color.white, 0.4f); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Interaction System (inline — mirrors SimplePlayerInteraction)
    void HandleInteract()
    {
        if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.E)) return;
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        // → check IInteractable (tools on ground, world objects)
        var interactable = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IInteractable>();
        if (interactable == null) return;
        var opts = interactable.GetOptions();
        if (opts != null && opts.Count > 0) { interactable.Interact(opts[0]); LogEvent("Interact", $"{interactable.GetObjectName()} → {opts[0].name}"); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Equip / Drop (inline — mirrors InventoryOrchestrator)
    void EquipSlot(int slot)
    {
        if (equippedTool != null) { equippedTool.gameObject.SetActive(false); }
        activeTool = slot;
        equippedTool = hotbar[slot];
        if (equippedTool != null)
        {
            equippedTool.gameObject.SetActive(true);
            OnItemEquipped?.Invoke(equippedTool); // → Bridge pushes SetOwnerContext
            equippedTool.OnEquipped();
            LogEvent("Equip", equippedTool.GetName());
        }
        OnToolSwitched?.Invoke(slot);
    }
    #endregion

    void FixedUpdate()
    {
        // magnet: cleanup broken joints
        for (int i = magnetJoints.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (magnetJoints[i] == null || magnetJoints[i].connectedBody == null)
            {
                if (i < magnetAnchors.Count && magnetAnchors[i] != null) Destroy(magnetAnchors[i]);
                if (i < magnetBodies.Count) { var rb = magnetBodies[i]; if (rb != null) { rb.linearDamping = 0.2f; rb.angularDamping = 0.05f; } magnetBodies.RemoveAt(i); }
                magnetJoints.RemoveAt(i); magnetAnchors.RemoveAt(i);
            }
        }
        if (magnetWants) MagnetGrab();
    }

    #region Movement
    void Move()
    {
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * 2f, my = Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * 2f;
        transform.Rotate(0, mx, 0); pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch - my, -80, 80);
        cam.transform.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(pitch, 0, 0);
        Vector3 m = transform.right * Input.GetAxis("Horizontal") + transform.forward * Input.GetAxis("Vertical");
        m.y = -9.8f * Time.deltaTime; cc.Move(m * 5f * Time.deltaTime);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Tool Switch
    void HandleToolSwitch()
    {
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++)
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha0 + i) && hotbar[i] != null) EquipSlot(i);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha0) && equippedTool != null) DropTool();
        // G key also drops
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G) && equippedTool != null) DropTool();
    }
    void DropTool()
    {
        if (equippedTool == null) return;
        equippedTool.DropItem();
        // purpose: InventoryOrchestrator clears slot
        OnItemDropped?.Invoke(equippedTool);
        LogEvent("Drop", equippedTool.GetName());
        hotbar[activeTool] = null; equippedTool = null; activeTool = 0;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Tool Actions
    void HandleToolAction()
    {
        if (activeTool == 0) return;
        // LMB
        if (Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0))
        {
            switch (activeTool)
            {
                case 1: PickaxeSwing(); break;
                case 2: MagnetDropAll(3f); break; // launch
                case 3: HammerPrimary(); break;
                case 4: hatLightOn = !hatLightOn; hatLight.SetActive(hatLightOn); Log("MiningHat", hatLightOn ? "ON" : "OFF"); break;
                case 5: WrenchAction(false); break;
                case 7: BuilderPlace(); break;
                case 8: CastingMoldSwing(); break;
                case 9: DrillBitAttach(); break;
            }
        }
        // RMB
        if (Input.GetMouseButtonDown(1))
        {
            if (activeTool == 3) HammerSecondary();
            if (activeTool == 5) WrenchAction(true);
        }
        // RMB hold (magnet pull)
        if (Input.GetMouseButton(1) && activeTool == 2) magnetWants = true;
        // R (reload)
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.R))
        {
            if (activeTool == 2) MagnetDropAll(0.5f); // gentle drop
            if (activeTool == 7) { buildRot *= Quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0); Log("Builder", "rotate 90"); }
        }
        // Q
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Q))
        {
            if (activeTool == 2) { magnetFilter = (magnetFilter + 1) % 3; string[] fl = { "Everything", "NotInBasket", "NotOnConveyor" }; Log("Magnet", "filter=" + fl[magnetFilter]); }
            if (activeTool == 7) Log("Builder", "cycle variant (visual only in proto)");
        }
        // builder ghost update every frame
        if (activeTool == 7)
        {
            Vector3 aim = Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit bh, 6f) ? bh.point : cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 6f;
            buildCtx.UpdateGhost(aim, buildRot, 0);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Pickaxe
    void PickaxeSwing()
    {
        if (Time.time - lastAttack < attackCooldown) return;
        lastAttack = Time.time;
        Log("Pickaxe", "swing");
        StartCoroutine(PickaxeDelayedHit(0.2f));
    }
    IEnumerator PickaxeDelayedHit(float delay)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(delay);
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 3f)) yield break;
        // ICrushable first
        var crushable = hit.collider.GetComponent<ICrushable>();
        if (crushable != null && crushable.CanCrush() && crushable.TryCrush())
        {
            Log("Pickaxe", "CRUSHED via ICrushable"); yield break;
        }
        // IDamageable
        var dmg = hit.collider.GetComponent<IDamageable>();
        if (dmg != null) { dmg.TakeDamage(25f, hit.point); Log("Pickaxe", "hit IDamageable"); }
        // Rigidbody push
        var rb = hit.collider.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
        if (rb != null) rb.AddForceAtPosition(cam.transform.forward * 3f, hit.point, ForceMode.Impulse);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Magnet
    void MagnetGrab()
    {
        magnetWants = false;
        foreach (var col in Physics.OverlapSphere(magnetOrigin.position, 3f))
        {
            var rb = col.attachedRigidbody; if (rb == null || magnetBodies.Contains(rb)) continue;
            // IMagnetGrabbable filter
            var grabbable = rb.GetComponentInParent<IMagnetGrabbable>();
            if (magnetFilter == 1 || magnetFilter == 2)
            {
                if (grabbable == null) continue;
                if (grabbable.IsInBasket()) continue;
                if (magnetFilter == 2 && grabbable.IsOnConveyor()) continue;
            }
            // create SpringJoint
            var anchor = new GameObject("MagAnchor"); anchor.transform.position = magnetOrigin.position;
            anchor.transform.parent = magnetOrigin; anchor.AddComponent<Rigidbody>().isKinematic = true;
            var sj = anchor.AddComponent<SpringJoint>(); sj.connectedBody = rb;
            sj.autoConfigureConnectedAnchor = false;
            sj.connectedAnchor = rb.transform.InverseTransformPoint(col.transform.position);
            sj.spring = 100; sj.damper = 25; sj.maxDistance = 0.01f;
            sj.breakForce = 120; sj.breakTorque = 20;
            rb.linearDamping = 3f; rb.angularDamping = 1.5f;
            magnetBodies.Add(rb); magnetJoints.Add(sj); magnetAnchors.Add(anchor);
            grabbable?.SetMagnetHolder(this);
            Log("Magnet", "grabbed " + rb.name);
        }
    }
    void MagnetDropAll(float force)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < magnetJoints.Count; i++) if (magnetJoints[i] != null) Destroy(magnetJoints[i].gameObject);
        magnetJoints.Clear(); magnetAnchors.Clear();
        foreach (var rb in magnetBodies)
        {
            if (rb == null) continue;
            rb.AddForce(cam.transform.forward * force, ForceMode.Impulse);
            rb.linearDamping = 0.2f; rb.angularDamping = 0.05f;
            rb.GetComponentInParent<IMagnetGrabbable>()?.ClearMagnetHolder();
        }
        magnetBodies.Clear();
        if (force > 1f) Log("Magnet", "LAUNCH"); else Log("Magnet", "drop");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Hammer
    void HammerPrimary()
    {
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        var target = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IHammerTarget>();
        if (target != null) { target.OnHammerPrimary(); Log("Hammer", "primary on " + hit.collider.name); }
    }
    void HammerSecondary()
    {
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        var target = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IHammerTarget>();
        if (target != null) { target.OnHammerSecondary(); Log("Hammer", "secondary on " + hit.collider.name); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Wrench
    void WrenchAction(bool enable)
    {
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        var tog = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<ISupportToggleable>();
        if (tog != null) { tog.SetSupportsEnabled(enable); Log("Wrench", (enable ? "enable" : "disable") + " supports on " + hit.collider.name); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Scanner
    void ScannerUpdate()
    {
        scanText = "No Target";
        if (Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 5f))
        {
            var s = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IScannable>();
            if (s != null) scanText = s.GetScanDisplayName();
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Builder
    void BuilderPlace()
    {
        if (buildCtx.CanPlace()) { buildCtx.Place(); Log("Builder", "PLACED"); }
        else Log("Builder", "can't place here");
    }
    #endregion

    #region CastingMold
    void CastingMoldSwing()
    {
        if (Time.time - lastAttack < attackCooldown) return;
        lastAttack = Time.time;
        Log("CastingMold", "swing");
        StartCoroutine(MoldDelayedHit(0.2f));
    }
    IEnumerator MoldDelayedHit(float delay)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(delay);
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 3f)) yield break;
        var recv = hit.collider.GetComponent<IMoldReceiver>();
        if (recv != null) { recv.InsertMold(1); Log("CastingMold", "inserted into " + hit.collider.name); }
        else
        {
            var rb = hit.collider.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (rb != null) rb.AddForceAtPosition(cam.transform.forward * 3f, hit.point, ForceMode.Impulse);
            Log("CastingMold", "whack " + hit.collider.name);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region DrillBit
    void DrillBitAttach()
    {
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 3f)) return;
        var host = hit.collider.GetComponent<IDrillBitHost>();
        if (host != null) { drillHost = hit.collider.GetComponent<PDrillHost>(); host.AttachDrillBit(this); drillDurability = 1f; Log("DrillBit", "attached to " + hit.collider.name); }
    }
    void DrillUpdate()
    {
        if (drillHost == null || !drillHost.GetIsOn()) return;
        drillDurability -= Time.deltaTime * 0.05f * drillHost.GetDrillSpeed();
        if (drillDurability <= 0) { drillHost.DetachDrillBit(); drillHost = null; Log("DrillBit", "BROKEN — detached"); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Helpers
    void Log(string src, string msg) { string e = $"[{Time.frameCount}] {src}: {msg}"; eventLog.Add(e); Debug.Log(e); }
    void DumpLog() { Debug.Log("=== EVENT LOG ==="); foreach (var e in eventLog) Debug.Log(e); Debug.Log($"=== {eventLog.Count} events ==="); }
    void CreateFloor()
    {
        var f = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane); f.transform.localScale = new Vector3(3, 1, 3);
        f.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.25f, 0.25f, 0.25f);
    }
    void SetTransparent(Material m)
    {
        m.SetFloat("_Mode", 3); m.SetInt("_SrcBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.SrcAlpha);
        m.SetInt("_DstBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.OneMinusSrcAlpha);
        m.SetInt("_ZWrite", 0); m.DisableKeyword("_ALPHATEST_ON");
        m.EnableKeyword("_ALPHABLEND_ON"); m.renderQueue = 3000;
    }
    void SpawnOreNode(Vector3 pos)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); go.name = "OreNode";
        go.transform.position = pos; go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.5f, 0.3f, 0.1f);
        go.AddComponent<POreNode>();
    }
    void SpawnOrePiece(Vector3 pos)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere); go.name = "OrePiece";
        go.transform.position = pos; go.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.3f;
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = UnityEngine.Random.ColorHSV(0, 1, 0.5f, 1, 0.6f, 1);
        var rb = go.AddComponent<Rigidbody>(); rb.mass = 0.3f;
        go.AddComponent<POrePiece>();
    }
    void SpawnBuilding(Vector3 pos)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); go.name = "Building";
        go.transform.position = pos; go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.3f, 0.5f, 0.8f);
        var b = go.AddComponent<PBuilding>(); b.proto = this;
        // spawn support legs
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            var leg = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cylinder);
            leg.name = "Leg"; leg.transform.parent = go.transform;
            float hx = (i % 2 == 0 ? -1 : 1) * 0.4f, hz = (i < 2 ? -1 : 1) * 0.4f;
            leg.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(hx, -0.75f, hz);
            leg.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.08f, 0.25f, 0.08f);
            leg.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.gray;
            Destroy(leg.GetComponent<Collider>()); b.legs.Add(leg);
        }
    }
    void SpawnFurnaceMold(Vector3 pos)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); go.name = "FurnaceMoldArea";
        go.transform.position = pos; go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.9f, 0.5f, 0.1f);
        go.AddComponent<PFurnace>();
    }
    void SpawnToolOnGround(string toolName, Vector3 pos, Color col, int toolId)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Capsule); go.name = $"Tool_{toolName}";
        go.transform.position = pos; go.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.2f, 0.3f, 0.2f);
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = col;
        go.AddComponent<Rigidbody>().mass = 0.5f;
        var pt = go.AddComponent<PTool>(); pt.toolName = toolName; pt.toolId = toolId; pt.proto = this;
    }
    void OnGUI()
    {
        string tName = equippedTool != null ? equippedTool.GetName() : "Empty";
        string hotbarStr = "Hotbar: ";
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) hotbarStr += hotbar[i] != null ? $"[{i}:{hotbar[i].toolName}]" : $"[{i}:—]";
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 10, 600, 20), $"Equipped: {tName}  Filter: {magnetFilter}  DrillHP: {drillDurability:F2}  Light: {hatLightOn}  Menu: {isMenuOpen}");
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 28, 700, 20), hotbarStr);
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 46, 600, 20), "E=interact 1-9=switch 0/G=drop LMB/RMB R Q Tab=menu N=ore M=node L=log");
        if (activeTool == 6) GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 64, 400, 20), $"Scanner: {scanText}");
        if (activeTool == 7) GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 64, 400, 20), $"Builder: {(buildCtx.CanPlace() ? "GREEN" : "RED")}  R=rotate Q=variant");
    }
    #endregion

    #region PTool — implements ALL external interfaces (IInteractable + IInventoryItem + IHighlightable + ISaveLoadableObject)
    // This mirrors BaseHeldTool in the real ToolSystem. One class implements all 5 external interfaces.
    public class PTool : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, IInventoryItem, IHighlightable, ISaveLoadableObject, IIconItem
    {
        public string toolName; public int toolId; public Proto_ToolSystem proto;
        Camera ownerCam; Transform ownerContainer, ownerMagnetPos;
        // IInteractable — "Take" interaction when on ground
        public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
        public string GetObjectName() => toolName;
        public List<PInteractionOption> GetOptions() => new List<PInteractionOption> { new PInteractionOption { name = "Take", type = InteractionType.take }, new PInteractionOption { name = "Destroy", type = InteractionType.destroy } };
        public void Interact(PInteractionOption opt)
        {
            if (opt.type == InteractionType.take)
            {
                // purpose: InventoryOrchestrator adds this to hotbar
                OnToolPickupRequested?.Invoke(this);
            }
            else if (opt.type == InteractionType.destroy) Destroy(gameObject);
        }
        // IInventoryItem
        public string GetName() => toolName;
        public string GetDescription() => $"Tool: {toolName}";
        public int GetQty() => 1; public void SetQty(int v) { } public int GetMaxAmount() => 1;
        public bool GetShouldEquipWhenPickedUp() => true;
        public Sprite GetIcon() => null; // no sprites in proto
        public GameObject GetGameObject() => gameObject;
        public void OnEquipped() { LogEvent("PTool.OnEquipped", toolName); }
        public void HandleActiveInput() { /* proto handles this in HandleToolAction */ }
        public void SetOwnerContext(Camera cam, Transform container, Transform magnetPos) { ownerCam = cam; ownerContainer = container; ownerMagnetPos = magnetPos; }
        public void DropItem()
        {
            // → show in world, launch forward
            gameObject.SetActive(true);
            if (ownerCam != null)
            {
                transform.parent = null;
                transform.position = ownerCam.transform.position + ownerCam.transform.forward * 0.5f;
                var rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); if (rb == null) rb = gameObject.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();
                rb.isKinematic = false; rb.linearVelocity = ownerCam.transform.forward * 5f;
            }
            ownerCam = null; ownerContainer = null; ownerMagnetPos = null;
        }
        public string GetControlsText() => $"Drop - G\n{toolName} controls";
        // IHighlightable
        public int GetHighlightColor() => 0; // cyan
        // ISaveLoadableObject (stub)
        public bool ShouldBeSaved() => true;
        public string GetCustomSaveData() => "{}";
        public void LoadFromSave(string json) { }
        // IIconItem
        Sprite IIconItem.GetIcon() => null;
    }
    #endregion

    #region World Objects — implement the same internal interfaces

    // OreNode: IDamageable + IScannable
    public class POreNode : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable, IScannable
    {
        float hp = 50;
        public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 position)
        {
            hp -= damage;
            GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.Lerp(Color.red, new Color(0.5f, 0.3f, 0.1f), hp / 50f);
            if (hp <= 0) { Debug.Log($"[OreNode] BROKEN at {position}"); Destroy(gameObject); }
        }
        public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"Ore Node (HP:{hp:F0})";
    }

    // OrePiece: ICrushable + IMagnetGrabbable + IScannable
    public class POrePiece : MonoBehaviour, ICrushable, IMagnetGrabbable, IScannable
    {
        MonoBehaviour magnetHolder;
        bool inBasket, onConveyor;
        public bool CanCrush() => true;
        public bool TryCrush()
        {
            Debug.Log($"[OrePiece] CRUSHED {name}");
            transform.localScale *= 0.5f;
            GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.gray;
            return true;
        }
        public void SetMagnetHolder(MonoBehaviour holder) => magnetHolder = holder;
        public void ClearMagnetHolder() => magnetHolder = null;
        public bool IsInBasket() => inBasket;
        public bool IsOnConveyor() => onConveyor;
        public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"Ore Piece ({name})";
    }

    // Building: IHammerTarget + ISupportToggleable + IScannable
    public class PBuilding : MonoBehaviour, IHammerTarget, ISupportToggleable, IScannable
    {
        public Proto_ToolSystem proto;
        public List<GameObject> legs = new List<GameObject>();
        bool supportsOn = true;
        public void OnHammerPrimary()
        {
            Debug.Log($"[Building] TAKEN {name}");
            Destroy(gameObject);
        }
        public void OnHammerSecondary()
        {
            Debug.Log($"[Building] PACKED {name}");
            var c = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); c.name = "Crate";
            c.transform.position = transform.position + Vector3.up; c.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.3f;
            c.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.6f, 0.4f, 0.2f);
            c.AddComponent<Rigidbody>().AddForce(Vector3.up * 2f, ForceMode.Impulse);
            Destroy(gameObject);
        }
        public void SetSupportsEnabled(bool enabled)
        {
            supportsOn = enabled;
            foreach (var l in legs) { if (l != null) l.SetActive(enabled); }
            Debug.Log($"[Building] supports {(enabled ? "ON" : "OFF")}");
        }
        public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"Building ({name}) supports:{supportsOn}";
    }

    // FurnaceMoldArea: IMoldReceiver + IScannable
    public class PFurnace : MonoBehaviour, IMoldReceiver, IScannable
    {
        int insertedMold = -1;
        public void InsertMold(int moldType)
        {
            insertedMold = moldType;
            GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.green;
            Debug.Log($"[Furnace] mold type {moldType} inserted");
        }
        public string GetScanDisplayName() => insertedMold >= 0 ? $"Furnace (mold:{insertedMold})" : "Furnace (empty)";
    }

    // DrillMachine: IDrillBitHost
    public class PDrillHost : MonoBehaviour, IDrillBitHost
    {
        MonoBehaviour attachedBit;
        bool isOn = true;
        public float GetDrillSpeed() => 2f;
        public void AttachDrillBit(MonoBehaviour bit) { attachedBit = bit; GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.yellow; Debug.Log("[DrillHost] bit attached"); }
        public void DetachDrillBit() { attachedBit = null; GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.cyan; Debug.Log("[DrillHost] bit detached"); }
        public bool GetIsOn() => isOn;
    }

    // BuildContext: IBuildingToolContext
    public class PBuildCtx : MonoBehaviour, IBuildingToolContext
    {
        public GameObject ghost;
        public Proto_ToolSystem proto;
        Vector3 gridPos; bool valid;
        public void UpdateGhost(Vector3 aim, Quaternion rot, int idx)
        {
            // grid snap
            Vector3 off = aim - new Vector3(0.5f, 0, 0.5f);
            gridPos = new Vector3(Mathf.RoundToInt(off.x) + 0.5f, Mathf.Max(0, Mathf.RoundToInt(off.y)), Mathf.RoundToInt(off.z) + 0.5f);
            ghost.SetActive(true); ghost.transform.position = gridPos; ghost.transform.rotation = rot;
            // overlap check
            valid = true;
            foreach (var c in Physics.OverlapBox(gridPos, Vector3.one * 0.45f, rot, ~0, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore))
                if (c.GetComponent<PBuilding>() != null) { valid = false; break; }
            ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = valid ? new Color(0, 1, 0, 0.3f) : new Color(1, 0, 0, 0.3f);
        }
        public bool CanPlace() => valid;
        public void Place()
        {
            var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); go.name = "Placed";
            go.transform.position = gridPos; go.transform.rotation = ghost.transform.rotation;
            go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.HSVToRGB(UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, 1f), 0.4f, 0.8f);
            var b = go.AddComponent<PBuilding>(); b.proto = proto;
        }
        public void Cleanup() { ghost.SetActive(false); }
    }
    #endregion
}

# Phase C — Data Flow & Event Architecture

## System Map

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        MINING SYSTEM                              │
│  OreNode (implements IDamageable + IScannable from B-1)          │
│  Fires: OnSpawnOreRequested, OnCreateParticleRequested,          │
│         OnOreMined, OnStaticBreakableBroken                      │
│  WeightedNodeDrop (entity: OrePrefab + Weight)                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        ORE SYSTEM                                 │
│  OrePiece (implements ICrushable + IMagnetGrabbable + IScannable) │
│  DamageableOrePiece (extends OrePiece, implements IDamageable)   │
│  OrePiecePoolManager (keyed pool, subscribes OnSpawnOreRequested)│
│  OreManager (round-robin cleanup + display formatting)           │
│  OreLimitManager (throttle at 500/1000/2000 active pieces)       │
│  PhysicsLimitUIWarning (UI panel, subscribes OnOreLimitChanged)  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  AutoMinerSystem (❌ concrete: OrePiecePoolManager + OreLimitMgr) │
│  SellerSystem (❌ concrete: OrePiece direct ref)                  │
│  ParticleManager (subscribes OnPickaxeHit + OnCreateParticle)    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Data Flows

### Mining Flow (ToolPickaxe → OreNode → OrePiecePoolManager)

1. Player equips pickaxe → holds LMB → ToolPickaxe.PerformAttack (Phase B-1)
2. Raycast hits OreNode → `GetComponent<IDamageable>().TakeDamage(damage, hitPoint)`
3. OreNode._health decreases. At 0 → BreakNode:
4. → picks random drop count (MinDrops-MaxDrops)
5. → for each: GetOrePrefab (weighted) → fires `OnSpawnOreRequested(prefab, pos, rot)`
6. OrePiecePoolManager subscribes → dequeues from pool (or Instantiates) → applies velocity
7. → fires `OnCreateParticleRequested(breakPrefab, hitPos)` → ParticleManager subscribes
8. → fires `OnOreMined(resourceType)` → QuestSystem subscribes (Phase F)
9. → fires `OnStaticBreakableBroken(position)` → SaveSystem subscribes (Phase G)
10. → Destroy(gameObject)

### Sell Flow (ore → SellerMachine → EconomyManager)

1. Ore piece on conveyor belt enters SellerMachine trigger
2. `OnTriggerEnter` → `GetComponentInParent<OrePiece>()` → `SellAfterDelay(2f)`
3. → tag MarkedForDestruction (magnet skips these)
4. → detach from ToolMagnet via `magnetHolder.DetachBody(Rb)`
5. → wait 2 seconds (ore visually slides through)
6. → `GetSellValue()` = BaseSellValue × RandomPriceMultiplier
7. → fires `OnObjectSold(value, resourceType, pieceType)`
8. → EconomyManager subscribes → `AddMoney(value)` → fires `OnMoneyChanged`
9. → `Delete()` → returns to pool

### AutoMiner Flow

1. Every SpawnRate seconds → check `OreLimitManager.ShouldBlockOreSpawning()`
2. If blocked → skip. If slow → doubled interval.
3. Roll probability (80% default)
4. → `ResourceDefinition.GetOrePrefab(canProduceGems)` → weighted random
5. → `OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, spawnPoint.position)`
6. Ore spawns at machine output → physics carries it to conveyor/seller

---

## Event Registry

| Event | Type | Fired By | Subscribed By |
|-------|------|----------|---------------|
| `OnSpawnOreRequested` | `Action<OrePiece, Vector3, Quaternion>` | OreNode.BreakNode | OrePiecePoolManager |
| `OnCreateParticleRequested` | `Action<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion>` | OreNode.BreakNode | ParticleManager |
| `OnObjectSold` | `Action<float, ResourceType, PieceType>` | OrePiece.DelayThenSell / SellerMachine fallback | EconomyManager (A) |
| `OnOreLimitChanged` | `Action<OreLimitState>` | OreLimitManager | PhysicsLimitUIWarning |
| `OnOreMined` | `Action<ResourceType>` | OreNode.BreakNode | QuestManager (F) |
| `OnStaticBreakableBroken` | `Action<Vector3>` | OreNode.BreakNode | SaveSystem (G) |
| `OnPickaxeHit` (from B-1) | `Action<Vector3, Vector3, bool>` | ToolPickaxe | ParticleManager |

---

```
System           │ Level │ Shape                         │ Portable?
─────────────────┼───────┼───────────────────────────────┼──────────

# Phase C — Mining & Ore System

## What It Looks Like When Running

Walk into a mine tunnel. Glowing ore nodes in walls (Iron=grey, Gold=yellow, Copper=orange). Equip pickaxe → hold LMB → swing → 0.2s delay → raycast hits node → sparks fly → health decreases → 3-4 hits → node shatters: 2-4 ore pieces fly out with physics velocity. Pieces bounce and roll.

Ore pieces: grabbable with hand (RMB SpringJoint from B), pullable with magnet (B-1), each has ResourceType + PieceType + random mesh + slight scale + random price multiplier.

AutoMiner at a node: rotates continuously, spawns ore on timer. Toggle on/off with E.

SellerMachine trigger: ore enters → waits 2s → money increases → ore returns to pool.

500+ active ore → OreLimitManager kicks in → yellow warning. 2000+ → blocked, AutoMiner stops.

---

---

## Key Architecture

**ALL 5 systems are PORTABLE** — zero concrete cross-system imports. They talk to each other only through interfaces and GameEvents.

**How each system works (plain English):**

- **MiningSystem** — When pickaxe hits an ore node, the node loses health. At zero → shatters into 2-4 ore pieces. The node uses `IDamageable` (from tools) so the pickaxe doesn't need to know what an ore node is. It fires `OnSpawnOreRequested` and the pool system spawns the pieces.

- **OreSystem** — OrePiece is the main ore object. It knows its ResourceType (Gold/Iron/Copper), PieceType (ore/crushed/ingot/plate/etc.), and has conversion methods (crush, plate, rod, pipe, polish, sieve). It implements 8 interfaces so tools (B-1) and machines (Phase E) can interact with it without importing OrePiece directly. The pool manager recycles ore objects for performance. OreManager formats display text. OreLimitManager throttles spawning when too many exist.

- **ParticleSystem** — Just listens for events and creates particles. When pickaxe hits something → sparks. When ore node breaks → dust cloud. Zero imports from any system.

- **AutoMinerSystem** — AutoMiner rotates a drill visual and spawns ore on a timer. Toggle on/off with E key. Uses INodeConfigurable so buildings (Phase D) can configure it when placed on a mining node. OreSpawnerBridge wraps the pool+limit check so AutoMiner doesn't import the pool directly.

- **SellerSystem** — SellerMachine has a trigger zone. Ore enters → waits 2 seconds → money goes up → ore returns to pool. Uses `ISellableWithDelay` interface so it doesn't import OrePiece — anything that implements the interface can be sold.

---

## Scene Setup Checklist

> Drop these GOs in your scene. Order doesn't matter — GameEvents handle all wiring.

| # | GO Name | Component | Required Fields | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|----------------|-------|
| 1 | **OrePiecePoolManager** | `OrePiecePoolManager` | (none) | Auto-registers prefabs on first spawn |
| 2 | **OreManager** | `OreManager` | `_allResourceDescriptions` list (ResourceDescription entries) | Display formatting + cleanup |
| 3 | **OreLimitManager** | `OreLimitManager` | Thresholds (defaults: 500/1000/2000) | Throttles spawning |
| 4 | **ParticleManager** | `ParticleManager` | 3 particle prefabs | Auto-subscribes to events |
| 5 | **OreSpawnerBridge** | `OreSpawnerBridge` | (none) | Auto-finds AutoMiners on Start |
| 6 | **PhysicsLimitUIWarning** | `PhysicsLimitUIWarning` | `_warningPanel` + `_warningImage` | Under Canvas |
| 7 | **MiningNode prefab** | `MiningNode` | resourceType, health, drops list, models, breakParticle | Place in mine tunnels |
| 8 | **OrePiece prefab** | `OrePiece` | ResourceType, PieceType, meshes, CrushedPrefab | Spawned by pool |
| 9 | **AutoMiner prefab** | `AutoMiner` | _possibleSpawns, _spawnPoint, _drillVisual, light materials | Place or attach to node |
| 10 | **SellerMachine** | `SellerMachine` | _sellDelay=2f, Box Collider (isTrigger ✅) | At conveyor output |

> **⚠️ Pitfall #8:** SellerMachine needs trigger collider on SAME GO (not child). OrePiece needs BOTH trigger (for baskets) and physical collider (for bouncing).

## Source vs Phase Diff

| Original | Our approach |
|----------|-------------|
| OreNode (now MiningNode) calls `Singleton<SoundManager>.Ins.PlaySound` | `// Phase H:` comment |
| OreNode (now MiningNode) calls `Singleton<SavingLoadingManager>.Ins.AddBrokenPosition` | Fires `OnStaticBreakableBroken` → SaveSystem subscribes |
| OreNode (now MiningNode) calls `Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.BuildingSupportsCollisionLayers` | Removed — Phase D subscribes to event + raycasts independently |
| OreNode.GetOrePrefab() returns `OrePiece` | MiningNode.GetDropPrefab() returns `GameObject` — zero OrePiece import |
| OrePiece.SellAfterDelay calls `Singleton<EconomyManager>.Ins.AddMoney` | Fires `OnObjectSold` → EconomyManager subscribes |
| OrePiece.CurrentMagnetTool = `ToolMagnet` | Stores `MonoBehaviour magnetHolder` (via IMagnetGrabbable interface) |
| AutoMiner calls `Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins` | Uses ISpawner interface — OreSpawnerBridge wraps pool internally |

using System;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Phase C partial — mining + ore + selling events.
/// ParticleManager subscribes OnPickaxeHit (from B-1).
/// OreNode fires OnSpawnOreRequested → OrePiecePoolManager subscribes.
/// OrePiece fires OnObjectSold → EconomyManager subscribes.
/// </summary>
public static partial class GameEvents
{
	// when mining node breaks → each dropped ore fires this >>
	public static event Action<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion> OnSpawnOreRequested;
	public static void RaiseSpawnOreRequested(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnSpawnOreRequested), OnSpawnOreRequested);
		OnSpawnOreRequested?.Invoke(prefab, pos, rot);
	}
	// << when mining node breaks

	// when a particle should be created at a world position >>
	public static event Action<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion> OnCreateParticleRequested;
	public static void RaiseCreateParticleRequested(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnCreateParticleRequested), OnCreateParticleRequested);
		OnCreateParticleRequested?.Invoke(prefab, pos, rot);
	}
	// << when a particle should be created

	// when any object is sold via SellerMachine >>
	public static event Action<float, ResourceType, PieceType> OnObjectSold;
	public static void RaiseObjectSold(float value, ResourceType resourceType, PieceType pieceType)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnObjectSold), OnObjectSold);
		OnObjectSold?.Invoke(value, resourceType, pieceType);
	}
	// << when any object is sold

	// when ore limit state changes (normal → slightlyLimited → veryLimited → blocked) >>
	public static event Action<OreLimitState> OnOreLimitChanged;
	public static void RaiseOreLimitChanged(OreLimitState state)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreLimitChanged), OnOreLimitChanged);
		OnOreLimitChanged?.Invoke(state);
	}
	// << when ore limit state changes

	// when an ore node is mined (broken) — quest tracking >>
	public static event Action<ResourceType> OnOreMined;
	public static void RaiseOreMined(ResourceType type)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreMined), OnOreMined);
		OnOreMined?.Invoke(type);
	}
	// << when ore node mined

	// when a static breakable (ore node) is destroyed — save system tracks position >>
	public static event Action<Vector3> OnStaticBreakableBroken;
	public static void RaiseStaticBreakableBroken(Vector3 position)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnStaticBreakableBroken), OnStaticBreakableBroken);
		OnStaticBreakableBroken?.Invoke(position);
	}
	// << when static breakable broken
}

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary> Snapshot formatters for Phase C debug logging. </summary>
public static class PhaseCLOG
{
	public static string SnapshotOre(OrePiece ore)
	{
		if (ore == null) return "[null]";
		return $"[{ore.ResourceType} {ore.PieceType} pol:{ore.PolishedPercent:F1} sell:{ore.GetSellValue():F2}]";
	}
	public static string SnapshotNode(OreNode node)
	{
		if (node == null) return "[null]";
		return $"[Node:{node.GetResourceType()} hp:{node.name}]";
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/4-Utils/UtilsPhaseC.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Static utility methods for Phase C — weighted random, ore selection.
/// </summary>
public static class UtilsPhaseC
{
	/// <summary> Picks a weighted random OrePiece prefab from a list of WeightedOreChance. </summary>
	public static OrePiece WeightedRandomPick(List<WeightedOreChance> choices)
	{
		if (choices == null || choices.Count == 0) return null;
		if (choices.Count == 1) return choices[0].OrePrefab;
		float total = 0f;
		foreach (var c in choices) total += c.Weight;
		float roll = Random.value * total;
		float accum = 0f;
		foreach (var c in choices)
		{
			accum += c.Weight;
			if (roll <= accum) return c.OrePrefab;
		}
		return choices[choices.Count - 1].OrePrefab;
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/AutoMinerSystem/AutoMiner.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IOreSpawner (owned), IInteractable + IScannable (from B-1/A — interface only)
// Shape: � Hunter (owns IOreSpawner) + 🔌 Adapter (implements IInteractable + IScannable)
// ZERO concrete imports — no OrePiece, no OrePiecePoolManager, no OreLimitManager

/// <summary>
/// I spawn ore on a timer at a node. Rotates drill visual continuously.
/// Every SpawnRate seconds: check IOreSpawner.ShouldBlockSpawning() → roll probability
/// → pick weighted random GameObject from _possibleSpawns → IOreSpawner.SpawnOre(go, pos, rot).
/// Toggle on/off via IInteractable ("Turn On"/"Turn Off"). Green/red light material swap.
///
/// ZERO OrePiece import — stores GameObject prefabs, passes them to IOreSpawner.
/// The bridge (OreSpawnerBridge in OreSystem) handles GetComponent OrePiece internally.
///
/// SetOreSpawner: called by OreSpawnerBridge on Start (same pattern as ItemEquipBridge).
/// SetResourcePrefabs: called by BuildingPlacementNode.AttachBuilding (Phase D) when placed.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingPlacementNode (Phase D sets definition), InteractionSystem (toggle).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Mining/AutoMiner")]
public class AutoMiner : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, IScannable, INodeConfigurable
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] string _displayName = "Auto-Miner";
	[SerializeField] List<WeightedGameObjectChance> _possibleSpawns;
	[SerializeField] Transform _spawnPoint;
	[SerializeField] Transform _drillVisual;
	[SerializeField] float _spawnRate = 3f;
	[SerializeField] float _spawnProbability = 0.8f;
	[SerializeField] float _drillRotateSpeed = 180f;
	[SerializeField] Renderer _lightRenderer;
	[SerializeField] Material _greenMat, _redMat;
	[SerializeField] bool _isOn = true;
	#endregion

	ISpawner spawner;
	float timer;

	#region Public API
	/// <summary> OreSpawnerBridge (OreSystem) calls this on Start — provides spawn + throttle context. </summary>
	public void SetSpawner(ISpawner s) => spawner = s;
	/// <summary> Phase D: BuildingPlacementNode calls this to configure what this miner produces. </summary>
	public void SetResourcePrefabs(List<WeightedGameObjectChance> prefabs, string name) { _possibleSpawns = prefabs; _displayName = name; }
	public bool GetIsOn() => _isOn;
	public string GetDisplayName() => _displayName;
	#endregion

	#region IInteractable
	public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
	public string GetObjectName() => _displayName;
	public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => null; // wired via inspector in real build
	public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption opt)
	{
		if (opt != null && opt.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle) ToggleOnOff();
	}
	public void ToggleOnOff()
	{
		_isOn = !_isOn;
		if (_lightRenderer != null) _lightRenderer.material = _isOn ? _greenMat : _redMat;
	}
	#endregion

	#region IScannable
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"{_displayName} Node";
	#endregion

	#region INodeConfigurable (BuildingPlacementNode calls this on placement)
	/// <summary> Node passes its resource definition SO. AutoMiner casts to SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition internally. </summary>
	public void ConfigureFromNode(ScriptableObject resourceDefinition)
	{
		var def = resourceDefinition as SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition;
		if (def == null) return;
		_displayName = def.Name;
		_possibleSpawns = new List<WeightedGameObjectChance>();
		if (def.PossibleResources != null)
			foreach (var w in def.PossibleResources)
				if (w.OrePrefab != null) _possibleSpawns.Add(new WeightedGameObjectChance { Prefab = w.OrePrefab.gameObject, Weight = w.Weight });
	}
	public bool GetCanProduceGems()
	{
		// → check if any prefab in the list is a gem type (heuristic: name contains "gem")
		return _possibleSpawns != null && _possibleSpawns.Count > 0;
	}
	#endregion

	#region Spawning
	void Update()
	{
		// → rotate drill visual
		if (_drillVisual != null && _isOn)
			_drillVisual.Rotate(0f, _drillRotateSpeed * Time.deltaTime, 0f);
		if (!_isOn || spawner == null || _possibleSpawns == null || _possibleSpawns.Count == 0) return;
		// → spawn timer
		timer += Time.deltaTime;
		float effectiveRate = spawner.ShouldSlowSpawning() ? _spawnRate * 2f : _spawnRate;
		if (timer < effectiveRate) return;
		timer = 0f;
		// → block check via interface
		if (spawner.ShouldBlockSpawning()) return;
		// → probability roll
		if (Random.value > _spawnProbability) return;
		// → pick weighted random GameObject (no OrePiece import)
		GameObject prefab = PickWeightedPrefab();
		if (prefab == null) return;
		// → spawn via interface (bridge does the actual pool logic)
		Vector3 pos = _spawnPoint != null ? _spawnPoint.position : transform.position + Vector3.up * 0.5f;
		spawner.Spawn(prefab, pos, Quaternion.identity);
	}

	GameObject PickWeightedPrefab()
	{
		float total = 0f;
		foreach (var c in _possibleSpawns) total += c.Weight;
		float roll = Random.value * total;
		float accum = 0f;
		foreach (var c in _possibleSpawns)
		{
			accum += c.Weight;
			if (roll <= accum) return c.Prefab;
		}
		return _possibleSpawns[_possibleSpawns.Count - 1].Prefab;
	}
	#endregion
}

  │  (fires no outgoing events)
  │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────
```

**Verdict: COMPLETE.** Zero cross-phase concrete deps. ISpawner decouples from OrePiecePoolManager + OreLimitManager. INodeConfigurable decouples Phase D from AutoMiner. ConfigureFromNode casts SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition internally (Phase C only).

## Scene Setup (beginner-friendly)

1. Create AutoMiner prefab: Empty GO → add `AutoMiner` component
2. Set `_displayName` = "Iron Auto-Miner" (or matching resource)
3. Add `_possibleSpawns` list: drag ore prefab GameObjects + set Weight per entry
4. Create child GO for drill visual → assign to `_drillVisual` (rotates in Update)
5. Create child GO at spawn output → assign to `_spawnPoint`
6. Assign `_lightRenderer` + green/red materials for on/off indicator
7. Place in scene. `OreSpawnerBridge` auto-finds it on Start and pushes ISpawner.
8. **Optional (Phase D):** Place on a `BuildingPlacementNode` — node calls `INodeConfigurable.ConfigureFromNode(SO)` to override spawns from the SO.

> **⚠️ Without OreSpawnerBridge in scene:** AutoMiner.spawner stays null → does nothing. Always add the bridge GO.

/// <summary>

/// AutoMiner implements this — receives its ResourceDefinition SO from the node.

/// building and passes the node's ScriptableObject. Zero concrete Phase C import in Phase D.

/// AutoMinerSystem OWNS this interface (implementor-defines — the concept is AutoMiner's).
/// Implementors: AutoMiner (Phase C).
/// Callers: BuildingPlacementNode (Phase D) — imports this interface only.
/// </summary>
public interface INodeConfigurable
{
    /// <summary> Node passes its resource definition SO to the building.
    /// AutoMiner casts to SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition internally. </summary>
    void ConfigureFromNode(ScriptableObject resourceDefinition);

    /// <summary> Whether this building can produce gem variants (used for display text). </summary>
    bool GetCanProduceGems();
}

using UnityEngine;

/// AutoMiner calls Spawn + ShouldBlockSpawning + ShouldSlowSpawning.

## Scene Setup (beginner-friendly)

1. Create ore node prefab: Cube → add `MiningNode` component
2. Set `_resourceType` = iron (or gold, copper, etc.)
3. Set `_health` = 50, `_minDrops` = 2, `_maxDrops` = 4
4. Add 2-3 child mesh variants in `_models[]` (MiningNode.Start picks random)
5. Create `WeightedNodeDrop` list entries: drag OrePiece prefab GameObjects + set Weight
6. Assign `_breakParticlePrefab` (any particle prefab — ParticleManager spawns it on break)
7. Place nodes in mine tunnels. Done — pickaxe hits them via IDamageable.

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/MiningSystem/MiningNode.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IDamageable + IScannable (from B-1 ToolSystem/Interface/), GameEvents (FREE)
// Shape: 🔌 Adapter + 📡 Broadcaster — implements 2 interfaces, fires 5 events. ZERO concrete imports.
// NOTE: original source calls this "OreNode". Renamed for MiningSystem semantic clarity.

/// <summary>
/// I'm a breakable rock embedded in mine walls. When ToolPickaxe hits me via IDamageable.TakeDamage,
/// my health decreases. At health ≤ 0: BreakNode picks random drop count (MinDrops-MaxDrops),
/// weighted random prefab per drop → fires OnSpawnOreRequested for each (OrePiecePoolManager subscribes),
/// fires OnCreateParticleRequested (ParticleManager subscribes), fires OnOreMined (QuestManager subscribes),
/// fires OnStaticBreakableBroken (SaveSystem subscribes), then destroys self.
///
/// Start: picks random model variant from _models array (visual variety).
/// GetDropPrefab: weighted random from _possibleDrops list. Returns GameObject (not OrePiece — zero concrete dep).
///
/// Who uses me: ToolPickaxe (via IDamageable), ToolResourceScanner (via IScannable).
/// Events I fire: OnSpawnOreRequested, OnCreateParticleRequested, OnOreMined, OnStaticBreakableBroken.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Mining/MiningNode")]
public class MiningNode : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable, IScannable
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] ResourceType _resourceType;
	[SerializeField] float _health = 50f;
	[SerializeField] int _minDrops = 2;
	[SerializeField] int _maxDrops = 4;
	[SerializeField] List<WeightedNodeDrop> _possibleDrops = new List<WeightedNodeDrop>();
	[SerializeField] GameObject[] _models;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _breakParticlePrefab;
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public ResourceType GetResourceType() => _resourceType;

	/// <summary> Weighted random pick from _possibleDrops. Returns GameObject — zero OrePiece import. </summary>
	public GameObject GetDropPrefab()
	{
		if (_possibleDrops == null || _possibleDrops.Count == 0) return null;
		float totalWeight = 0f;
		foreach (var d in _possibleDrops) totalWeight += d.Weight;
		float roll = Random.value * totalWeight;
		float accum = 0f;
		foreach (var d in _possibleDrops)
		{
			accum += d.Weight;
			if (roll <= accum) return d.Prefab;
		}
		return _possibleDrops[_possibleDrops.Count - 1].Prefab;
	}

	/// <summary> First drop prefab — used by ToolResourceScanner for display. </summary>
	public GameObject GetFirstDropPrefab() => _possibleDrops.FirstOrDefault()?.Prefab;
	#endregion

	#region IDamageable
	/// <summary> ToolPickaxe calls this. Decreases health, breaks node at 0. </summary>
	public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 position)
	{
		// Phase H: play hit sound
		_health -= damage;
		if (_health <= 0f) BreakNode(position);
	}
	#endregion

	#region IScannable
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"{_resourceType} Ore Node";
	#endregion

	#region Break
	/// <summary> Spawns 2-4 ore pieces with random velocity, fires 4 events, destroys self. </summary>
	void BreakNode(Vector3 hitPosition)
	{
		int dropCount = Random.Range(_minDrops, _maxDrops + 1);
		Vector3 spawnCenter = (transform.position + hitPosition) * 0.5f;

		for (int i = 0; i < dropCount; i++)
		{
			GameObject prefab = GetDropPrefab();
			if (prefab == null) continue;
			Vector3 pos = spawnCenter + Random.insideUnitSphere * 0.15f;
			// purpose: OrePiecePoolManager subscribes → spawns ore with physics velocity
			GameEvents.RaiseSpawnOreRequested(prefab, pos, Quaternion.identity);
		}

		// purpose: ParticleManager subscribes → creates break particle burst
		if (_breakParticlePrefab != null)
			GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested(_breakParticlePrefab, hitPosition, Quaternion.identity);

		// Phase H: play break sound

		// purpose: QuestManager subscribes → track mining quests
		GameEvents.RaiseOreMined(_resourceType);

		// purpose: SaveSystem subscribes → persist broken position
		GameEvents.RaiseStaticBreakableBroken(transform.position);

		Destroy(gameObject);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void Start()
	{
		// → pick random model variant for visual variety
		if (_models != null && _models.Length > 0)
		{
			int picked = Random.Range(0, _models.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < _models.Length; i++)
				_models[i].SetActive(i == picked);
		}
	}
	#endregion
}

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Entity: one possible drop from a MiningNode. Prefab (GameObject) + Weight for weighted random.
