/// Uses GameObject (not OrePiece) — zero concrete dep on OreSystem.
/// </summary>
[System.Serializable]
public class WeightedNodeDrop
{
	public GameObject Prefab;
	public float Weight = 1f;
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/Bridge/OreSpawnerBridge.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: ISpawner (from AutoMinerSystem — interface only), OrePiecePoolManager + OreLimitManager (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I implement ISpawner and push myself to all AutoMiners on Start.
/// When AutoMiner calls Spawn(GameObject, pos, rot), I GetComponent OrePiece on the prefab
/// and delegate to OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre. I also wrap OreLimitManager queries.
///
/// Lives in OreSystem (the non-portable consumer side) — NOT in AutoMinerSystem (which stays portable).
/// Same pattern as MoneyBridge (lives in EconomySystem, not ShopUISystem).
///
/// Who uses me: AutoMiner calls ISpawner methods on me.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Bridge/OreSpawnerBridge")]
public class OreSpawnerBridge : MonoBehaviour, ISpawner
{
	void Start()
	{
		// → push self to all AutoMiners in scene (same pattern as ItemEquipBridge)
		foreach (var miner in FindObjectsByType<AutoMiner>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))
			miner.SetSpawner(this);
	}

	/// <summary> Spawn: GetComponent OrePiece on prefab → pool spawn. AutoMiner never knows OrePiece exists. </summary>
	public bool Spawn(GameObject prefab, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)
	{
		if (prefab == null) return false;
		OrePiece orePrefab = prefab.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
		if (orePrefab != null)
		{
			OrePiece spawned = Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre(orePrefab, position, rotation);
			return spawned != null;
		}
		// → fallback: non-ore GameObject (just Instantiate)
		Instantiate(prefab, position, rotation);
		return true;
	}

	public bool ShouldBlockSpawning() => Singleton<OreLimitManager>.Ins.ShouldBlockOreSpawning();
	public bool ShouldSlowSpawning() => Singleton<OreLimitManager>.Ins.ShouldSlowSpawning();
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/DamageableOrePiece.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IDamageable (from B-1 ToolSystem/Interface/), OrePiece (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I extend OrePiece with collision-based damage. When a Rigidbody collides with me hard enough
/// (velocity > _damageThreshold), I call CompleteClusterBreaking to split into smaller pieces.
/// Also implements IDamageable so ToolPickaxe can hit me directly to break me.
///
/// Who uses me: physics collisions (automatic), ToolPickaxe (via IDamageable).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Ore/DamageableOrePiece")]
public class DamageableOrePiece : OrePiece, IDamageable
{
	[SerializeField] float _damageThreshold = 3f;
	[SerializeField] float _collisionDamageMultiplier = 1f;
	float damageTaken;

	/// <summary> IDamageable: ToolPickaxe or collision hits me → accumulate damage → break at threshold. </summary>
	public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 position)
	{
		damageTaken += damage;
		if (damageTaken >= _damageThreshold) CompleteClusterBreaking();
	}

	void OnCollisionEnter(Collision collision)
	{
		float impactSpeed = collision.relativeVelocity.magnitude;
		if (impactSpeed > _damageThreshold)
			TakeDamage(impactSpeed * _collisionDamageMultiplier, collision.contacts[0].point);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/Dependency.md ==== -->
# OreSystem — L5 ✅ Portable (interface-only) — 🕷️ Spider + 🔌 Adapter + 📡 Broadcaster

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | C |
| Level | **L5** (5 interface deps from B-1 ToolSystem + ISellableWithDelay) |
| Shape | 🕷️ **Spider** (owns 4 interfaces: IProcessIdentity, IProcessConvertible, IProcessProgressable, IBasketTrackable) + 🔌 **Adapter** (implements B-1 interfaces) + 📡 **Broadcaster** |
| Scripts | OrePiece, DamageableOrePiece, OrePiecePoolManager, OreManager, OreLimitManager, PhysicsLimitUIWarning, SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition, ResourceDescription, WeightedOreChance |
| Owns Interface | **IProcessIdentity**, **IProcessConvertible**, **IProcessProgressable**, **IBasketTrackable** |
| Implements | ICrushable + IMagnetGrabbable + IScannable + IDamageable (from B-1 ToolSystem), ISellableWithDelay (from SellerSystem C) |

## Key Architecture

**🕷️ Spider role:** OreSystem defines 4 interfaces: IProcessIdentity, IProcessConvertible, IProcessProgressable (Phase E machines consume) + IBasketTrackable (Phase E SortingSystem consumes for bidirectional basket membership). OrePiece implements all 4. This makes ProcessingSystem + SortingSystem interface-only — they never import OrePiece directly.

**🔌 Adapter role:** OrePiece implements 4 interfaces from Phase B-1 ToolSystem (ICrushable, IMagnetGrabbable, IScannable, IDamageable via DamageableOrePiece). This makes ALL ore pieces discoverable by ToolSystem tools — without either system importing the other's concrete classes.

**📡 Broadcaster role:** Fires OnOreSold, OnSpawnOreRequested, OnOreLimitChanged via GameEvents.

OrePiecePoolManager subscribes to OnSpawnOreRequested (fired by MiningNode in MiningSystem). Zero import of MiningSystem.

OrePiece.SellAfterDelay fires OnObjectSold → EconomyManager subscribes. Zero import of EconomySystem.

## Internal File Dependency Graph

```
  ┌── OreSystem/ ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  INTERNAL
  │  OrePiece (BaseSellableItem)
  │    ResourceType, PieceType, conversion methods ×7
  │    SellAfterDelay → fires OnObjectSold → Delete (pool return)
  │  DamageableOrePiece (OrePiece + collision damage)
  │  OrePiecePoolManager (keyed pool: spawn/return lifecycle)
  │  OreManager (round-robin cleanup + display format)
  │  OreLimitManager (15s check → fires OnOreLimitChanged)
  │  PhysicsLimitUIWarning (subscribes OnOreLimitChanged → UI)
  │
  ├── BOUNDARY ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  IMPLEMENTS (from B-1 ToolSystem/Interface/):
  │    ◆ ICrushable ◆ → ToolPickaxe calls CanCrush/TryCrush
  │    ◆ IMagnetGrabbable ◆ → ToolMagnet calls Set/ClearMagnetHolder + IsInBasket/IsOnConveyor
  │    ◆ IScannable ◆ → ToolResourceScanner calls GetScanDisplayName
  │    ◆ IDamageable ◆ → (on DamageableOrePiece) ToolPickaxe calls TakeDamage
  │
  ├── EXTERNAL ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  IN:  ← OnSpawnOreRequested(GameObject) ── MiningNode (MiningSystem) fires
  │  OUT: → OnObjectSold ── EconomyManager (A) subscribes
  │  OUT: → OnOreLimitChanged ── PhysicsLimitUIWarning (self)
  │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────
```

**Verdict: COMPLETE.** All conversion methods from original source present. Phase E machines call them directly (concrete dep on THEM, not on us). Phase G adds ISaveLoadable stubs on OrePiece if needed.

## Scene Setup (beginner-friendly)

1. **OrePiece prefab:** Sphere/custom mesh → add `OrePiece` component
   - Set ResourceType + PieceType. Assign CrushedPrefab (for TryConvertToCrushed)
   - Add MeshFilter + MeshCollider refs. Add Rigidbody (mass=0.3). Add `_possibleMeshes[]` for random variant.
2. **DamageableOrePiece:** same as above but add `DamageableOrePiece` instead (for collision-break clusters)
3. **OrePiecePoolManager:** Empty GO → add component. No config needed — self-registers prefabs on first spawn.
4. **OreManager:** Empty GO → add component. Drag all `ResourceDescription` entries into `_allResourceDescriptions` list.
5. **OreLimitManager:** Empty GO → add component. Thresholds: 500/1000/2000 (defaults).
6. **PhysicsLimitUIWarning:** Canvas child → add component. Assign `_warningPanel` (inactive by default) + `_warningImage`.
7. **OreSpawnerBridge:** Empty GO → add component. On Start it auto-finds all AutoMiners and pushes ISpawner.
8. **SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition:** Create → `SO/SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition`. Add PossibleResources entries (drag OrePiece prefabs + Weight).

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/OreLimitManager.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<T> (FREE), GameEvents (FREE), GlobalEnumsC, OrePiece (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I check the count of active (non-sleeping) ore pieces every 15 seconds.
/// Based on thresholds, I set OreLimitState and fire OnOreLimitChanged.
/// AutoMiner checks ShouldBlockOreSpawning() before spawning.
///
/// Thresholds (from original source):
///   0-499: normal, 500-999: slightlyLimited, 1000-1999: veryLimited, 2000+: blocked
///
/// Who uses me: AutoMiner (ShouldBlockOreSpawning), PhysicsLimitUIWarning (OnOreLimitChanged).
/// Events I fire: OnOreLimitChanged.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/OreLimitManager")]
public class OreLimitManager : Singleton<OreLimitManager>
{
	[SerializeField] int _slightlyLimitedThreshold = 500;
	[SerializeField] int _veryLimitedThreshold = 1000;
	[SerializeField] int _blockedThreshold = 2000;
	[SerializeField] float _checkInterval = 15f;

	OreLimitState currentState = OreLimitState.normal;
	float timer;

	public OreLimitState GetCurrentState() => currentState;
	public bool ShouldBlockOreSpawning() => currentState == OreLimitState.blocked;
	public bool ShouldSlowSpawning() => currentState >= OreLimitState.slightlyLimited;

	void Update()
	{
		timer += Time.deltaTime;
		if (timer < _checkInterval) return;
		timer = 0f;
		// → count non-sleeping ore
		int activeCount = 0;
		foreach (var ore in OrePiece.AllOrePieces)
		{
			if (ore != null && ore.Rb != null && !ore.Rb.IsSleeping()) activeCount++;
		}
		// → determine state from thresholds
		OreLimitState newState;
		if (activeCount >= _blockedThreshold) newState = OreLimitState.blocked;
		else if (activeCount >= _veryLimitedThreshold) newState = OreLimitState.veryLimited;
		else if (activeCount >= _slightlyLimitedThreshold) newState = OreLimitState.slightlyLimited;
		else newState = OreLimitState.normal;

		if (newState != currentState)
		{
			currentState = newState;
			// purpose: PhysicsLimitUIWarning subscribes → shows/hides warning panel
			GameEvents.RaiseOreLimitChanged(currentState);
		}
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/OreManager.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<T> (FREE), GlobalEnumsC, OrePiece (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I manage display formatting for ore resources and do round-robin cleanup of invalid pieces.
/// Every frame: check 1 ore piece. If it's null, inactive, sleeping below world, or NaN position → remove from list.
/// Also provides color + formatted name strings for UI (scanner, debug tool).
///
/// Who uses me: ToolResourceScanner (via IScannable on OrePiece — which reads from here),
///   ToolDebugSpawnTool (Phase J), OreLimitManager (count queries).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/OreManager")]
public class OreManager : Singleton<OreManager>
{
	[SerializeField] List<ResourceDescription> _allResourceDescriptions;
	int currentOreIndex;

	#region Public API
	/// <summary> Get the ResourceDescription for a given type. </summary>
	public ResourceDescription GetResourceDefinition(ResourceType type)
		=> _allResourceDescriptions.FirstOrDefault(r => r.ResourceType == type);

	/// <summary> Get the display color for a resource type. </summary>
	public Color GetResourceColor(ResourceType type)
		=> GetResourceDefinition(type)?.DisplayColor ?? Color.white;

	/// <summary> Colored rich-text string: "<color=#hex>Iron</color>" </summary>
	public string GetColoredResourceTypeString(ResourceType type)
	{
		string hex = ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGB(GetResourceColor(type));
		return $"<color=#{hex}>{type}</color>";
	}

	/// <summary> Full formatted: "Polished Iron Ingot" with color tags. </summary>
	public string GetColoredFormattedResourcePieceString(ResourceType resourceType, PieceType pieceType, bool requirePolished = false)
	{
		string hex = ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGB(GetResourceColor(resourceType));
		string pieceName = FormatPieceType(pieceType);
		string polished = requirePolished ? "Polished " : "";
		return $"<color=#{hex}>{polished}{resourceType} {pieceName}</color>";
	}

	string FormatPieceType(PieceType p)
	{
		switch (p)
		{
			case PieceType.drillBit: return "Drill Bit";
			case PieceType.threadedRod: return "Threaded Rod";
			case PieceType.oreCluster: return "Ore Cluster";
			case PieceType.junkCast: return "Junk Cast";
			default: return p.ToString();
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region Round-Robin Cleanup
	/// <summary> Each frame: check 1 ore piece. Remove if invalid. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		var all = OrePiece.AllOrePieces;
		if (all.Count == 0) return;
		if (currentOreIndex >= all.Count) currentOreIndex = 0;
		OrePiece ore = all[currentOreIndex];
		if (ore == null || !ore.gameObject.activeInHierarchy || float.IsNaN(ore.transform.position.x) || ore.transform.position.y < -200f)
		{
			if (ore != null) ore.Delete();
			else all.RemoveAt(currentOreIndex);
			return;
		}
		currentOreIndex++;
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/OrePiece.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: ICrushable + IMagnetGrabbable + IScannable (from B-1 ToolSystem/Interface/)
//       IProcessIdentity + IProcessConvertible + IProcessProgressable + IBasketTrackable (owned by OreSystem)
//       BaseSellableItem (FREE), GameEvents (FREE), GlobalEnumsC
// Shape: 🕷️ Spider (owns 4 IProcess*/IBasketTrackable) + 🔌 Adapter (implements 3 B-1 interfaces) + 📡 Broadcaster

/// <summary>
/// I'm a physical ore resource object with ResourceType + PieceType + processing state.
/// I extend BaseSellableItem (inherits Rigidbody management from BasePhysicsObject).
/// I implement ICrushable (ToolPickaxe crushes me), IMagnetGrabbable (ToolMagnet tracks me),
/// IScannable (ToolResourceScanner reads my name).
///
/// Processing methods (Phase E machines call these):
///   TryConvertToCrushed → 2 smaller pieces
///   ConvertToPlate/Rod/Pipe/Threaded → shape conversion
///   AddPolish → CompletePolishing when 100%
///   AddSieveValue → CompleteSieving when 100%
///   CompleteClusterBreaking → N random pieces
///
/// SellAfterDelay: SellerMachine calls → tag MarkedForDestruction → wait → fire OnObjectSold → return to pool.
///
/// Who uses me: ToolPickaxe (ICrushable), ToolMagnet (IMagnetGrabbable), ToolResourceScanner (IScannable),
///   SellerMachine (SellAfterDelay), Phase E machines (Convert methods), OrePiecePoolManager (pool lifecycle).
/// Events I fire: OnObjectSold (via DelayThenSell).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Ore/OrePiece")]
public class OrePiece : BaseSellableItem, ICrushable, IMagnetGrabbable, IScannable, ISellableWithDelay,
	IProcessIdentity, IProcessConvertible, IProcessProgressable, IBasketTrackable
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	public ResourceType ResourceType;
	public PieceType PieceType;
	public bool IsPolished;
	public Sprite InventoryIcon;
	public float VolumeInsideBox = 0.1f;
	[Obsolete] public float PolishedPercent;
	public float SievePercent;
	public float RandomPriceMultiplier = 1f;
	public GameObject CrushedPrefab;
	public GameObject IngotPrefab;
	public GameObject PlatePrefab;
	public GameObject PipePrefab;
	public GameObject RodPrefab;
	public GameObject ThreadedPrefab;
	public bool MakesPolishingMachineDirty;
	public GameObject PolishedPrefab;
	public Material PolishedMaterial;
	public List<WeightedOreChance> PossibleSievedPrefabs;
	public bool UseSameClusterBreakerPrefabForAllDrops;
	public int MinClusterBreakerSpawns;
	public int MaxClusterBreakerSpawns;
	public List<WeightedOreChance> PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs;
	[SerializeField] Mesh[] _possibleMeshes;
	public MeshFilter MeshFilter;
	public MeshCollider MeshCollider;
	public bool UseRandomMesh = true;
	public int MeshID;
	public bool UseRandomScale = true;
	[SerializeField] Vector3 _scaleVariance = new Vector3(0.25f, 0.25f, 0.25f);
	#endregion

	#region Runtime State
	MonoBehaviour magnetHolder;
	System.Action<Rigidbody> magnetDetachCallback;
	public HashSet<MonoBehaviour> BasketsThisIsInside = new HashSet<MonoBehaviour>();
	public static List<OrePiece> AllOrePieces = new List<OrePiece>();
	#endregion

	#region ICrushable (ToolPickaxe calls)
	/// <summary> Can crush if I have a CrushedPrefab and I'm raw ore type. </summary>
	public bool CanCrush() => CrushedPrefab != null
		&& CrushedPrefab.GetComponent<OrePiece>() != null
		&& PieceType == PieceType.ore;

	/// <summary> Spawns 2 crushed pieces at my position, plays sound, deletes me. </summary>
	public bool TryCrush() => TryConvertToCrushed();
	#endregion

	#region IMagnetGrabbable (ToolMagnet calls)
	public void SetMagnetHolder(MonoBehaviour holder, System.Action<Rigidbody> detachCallback) { magnetHolder = holder; magnetDetachCallback = detachCallback; }
	public void ClearMagnetHolder() { magnetHolder = null; magnetDetachCallback = null; }
	/// <summary> Physically detaches from magnet — invokes stored callback which triggers
	/// ToolMagnet.DetachBody(Rb): destroys SpringJoint, restores drag, re-enables collisions.
	/// Called by SorterMachine before teleport, SellerMachine before sell, etc. Zero ToolMagnet import. </summary>
	public void DetachFromMagnet() { magnetDetachCallback?.Invoke(Rb); }
	public bool IsInBasket() => BasketsThisIsInside.Count > 0;
	public bool IsOnConveyor() => IsOnAnyConveyor();
	#endregion

	#region IScannable (ToolResourceScanner calls)
	public string GetScanDisplayName()
	{
		string polished = (PolishedPercent >= 1f || IsPolished) ? "Polished " : "";
		return $"{polished}{ResourceType} {PieceType}";
	}
	#endregion

	#region IProcessIdentity (Phase E machines read type/state)
	ResourceType IProcessIdentity.GetResourceType() => ResourceType;
	PieceType IProcessIdentity.GetPieceType() => PieceType;
	bool IProcessIdentity.GetIsPolished() => IsPolished || PolishedPercent >= 1f;
	float IProcessIdentity.GetPolishedPercent() => PolishedPercent;
	bool IProcessIdentity.GetMakesDirty() => MakesPolishingMachineDirty;
	float IProcessIdentity.GetRandomPriceMultiplier() => RandomPriceMultiplier;
	float IProcessIdentity.GetSellValue() => GetSellValue();
	void IProcessIdentity.Delete() => Delete();
	#endregion

	#region IProcessConvertible (Phase E machines convert)
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.GetCrushedPrefab() => CrushedPrefab;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.GetPlatePrefab() => PlatePrefab;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.GetPipePrefab() => PipePrefab;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.GetRodPrefab() => RodPrefab;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.GetPolishedPrefab() => PolishedPrefab;
	bool IProcessConvertible.TryCrush() => TryConvertToCrushed();
	void IProcessConvertible.CompleteClusterBreaking() => CompleteClusterBreaking();
	void IProcessConvertible.ConvertToPlate() { ConvertToPlate(); }
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.ConvertToRod() => ConvertToRod()?.gameObject;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.ConvertToPipe() => ConvertToPipe()?.gameObject;
	GameObject IProcessConvertible.ConvertToThreaded() => ConvertToThreaded()?.gameObject;
	#endregion

	#region IProcessProgressable (Phase E machines add per-frame progress)
	// AddPolish and AddSieveValue already public — interface satisfied by existing methods
	#endregion

	#region IBasketTrackable (SortingSystem bidirectional basket tracking)
	public void AddBasketRef(MonoBehaviour basket) => BasketsThisIsInside.Add(basket);
	public void RemoveBasketRef(MonoBehaviour basket) => BasketsThisIsInside.Remove(basket);
	public bool HasAnyBasket() => BasketsThisIsInside.Count > 0;
	#endregion

	#region Conversion Methods (Phase E machines call these)
	/// <summary> Crush: spawn 2 crushed pieces, play sound, delete self. Returns true if successful. </summary>
	public bool TryConvertToCrushed()
	{
		if (!gameObject.activeSelf || CrushedPrefab == null) return false;
		for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.TrySpawnPooledOre(CrushedPrefab, transform.position, transform.rotation);
		// Phase H: play crush sound
		Delete();
		return true;
	}

	/// <summary> Convert to plate shape. Returns new OrePiece or null. </summary>
	public OrePiece ConvertToPlate() => ConvertTo(PlatePrefab);
	/// <summary> Convert to rod shape. </summary>
	public OrePiece ConvertToRod() => ConvertTo(RodPrefab);
	/// <summary> Convert to threaded rod shape. </summary>
	public OrePiece ConvertToThreaded() => ConvertTo(ThreadedPrefab);
	/// <summary> Convert to pipe shape. </summary>
	public OrePiece ConvertToPipe() => ConvertTo(PipePrefab);

	OrePiece ConvertTo(GameObject prefab)
	{
		if (!gameObject.activeSelf) return null;
		if (prefab != null)
		{
			OrePiece spawned = Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.TrySpawnPooledOre(prefab, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			if (spawned != null)
			{
				spawned.AddPolish(PolishedPercent);
				Delete();
				return spawned;
			}
			// Phase H: play conversion sound
		}
		Delete();
		return null;
	}

	/// <summary> Add polish value. At 100% → CompletePolishing (spawn polished variant or swap material). </summary>
	public void AddPolish(float value)
	{
		if (PolishedPercent >= 1f) return;
		PolishedPercent = Mathf.Min(1f, PolishedPercent + value);
		if (PolishedPercent >= 1f) CompletePolishing();
	}

	void CompletePolishing()
	{
		if (!gameObject.activeSelf) return;
		if (PolishedPrefab != null)
		{
			OrePiece spawned = Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.TrySpawnPooledOre(PolishedPrefab, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			if (spawned != null) { spawned.AddPolish(100f); spawned.RandomPriceMultiplier = RandomPriceMultiplier; }
			Delete();
		}
		else if (PolishedMaterial != null)
		{
			GetComponent<Renderer>().sharedMaterial = PolishedMaterial;
		}
	}

	/// <summary> Add sieve value. At 100% → CompleteSieving (weighted random spawn from PossibleSievedPrefabs). </summary>
	public void AddSieveValue(float value)
	{
		if (SievePercent >= 1f) return;
		SievePercent = Mathf.Min(1f, SievePercent + value);
		if (SievePercent >= 1f) CompleteSieving();
	}

	void CompleteSieving()
	{
		if (!gameObject.activeSelf || PossibleSievedPrefabs == null || PossibleSievedPrefabs.Count == 0) return;
		OrePiece picked = UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandomPick(PossibleSievedPrefabs);
		if (picked != null) Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre(picked, transform.position, transform.rotation);
		Delete();
	}

	/// <summary> Break into cluster pieces (N random spawns from PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs). </summary>
	public void CompleteClusterBreaking()
	{
		if (!gameObject.activeSelf || MaxClusterBreakerSpawns < 1 || PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs == null || PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs.Count == 0) return;
		int count = UnityEngine.Random.Range(MinClusterBreakerSpawns, MaxClusterBreakerSpawns + 1);
		OrePiece fixedPrefab = UseSameClusterBreakerPrefabForAllDrops ? UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandomPick(PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs) : null;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			OrePiece prefab = fixedPrefab ?? UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandomPick(PossibleClusterBreakerPrefabs);
			if (prefab != null) Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, transform.position, transform.rotation);
		}
		Delete();
	}
	#endregion

	#region Sell
	/// <summary> SellerMachine calls this. Detaches from magnet via callback, tags MarkedForDestruction, waits, sells. </summary>
	public void SellAfterDelay(float delay = 2f)
	{
		// → detach from magnet via callback (zero ToolMagnet import)
		magnetDetachCallback?.Invoke(Rb);
		magnetHolder = null;
		magnetDetachCallback = null;
		// → tag as marked (magnet skips these)
		gameObject.SetTag(TagType.markedForDestruction);
		foreach (var t in GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>()) t.gameObject.SetTag(TagType.markedForDestruction);
		StartCoroutine(DelayThenSell(delay));
	}

	IEnumerator DelayThenSell(float delay)
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(delay);
		if (this == null || !isActiveAndEnabled) yield break;
		float sellValue = GetSellValue();
		// purpose: EconomyManager subscribes → AddMoney
		GameEvents.RaiseObjectSold(sellValue, ResourceType, PieceType);
		Delete();
	}

	/// <summary> Sell value = BaseSellValue × RandomPriceMultiplier, rounded to 2 decimals. </summary>
	public override float GetSellValue() => Mathf.Round(BaseSellValue * RandomPriceMultiplier * 100f) / 100f;
	#endregion

	#region Pool Lifecycle
	/// <summary> Returns this ore piece to the pool for recycling. </summary>
	public void Delete() => Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.ReturnToPool(this);

	/// <summary> Is this ore on any conveyor belt? (BasePhysicsObject tracks via AddTouchingConveyorBelt). </summary>
	public bool IsOnAnyConveyor() => false; // → Phase D: BasePhysicsObject._conveyorBeltsTouchingThis.Count > 0
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void Start()
	{
		// → random mesh variant
		if (_possibleMeshes != null && _possibleMeshes.Length > 0)
		{
			if (UseRandomMesh) MeshID = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, _possibleMeshes.Length);
			if (MeshCollider != null) MeshCollider.sharedMesh = _possibleMeshes[MeshID];
			if (MeshFilter != null) MeshFilter.sharedMesh = _possibleMeshes[MeshID];
		}
		// → random scale variance
		if (UseRandomScale)
		{
			Vector3 s = transform.localScale;
			s.x += UnityEngine.Random.Range(-_scaleVariance.x, _scaleVariance.x);
			s.y += UnityEngine.Random.Range(-_scaleVariance.y, _scaleVariance.y);
			s.z += UnityEngine.Random.Range(-_scaleVariance.z, _scaleVariance.z);
			transform.localScale = s;
		}
		// → random price multiplier (0.9–1.1)
		RandomPriceMultiplier = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.9f, 1.1f);
	}

	protected override void OnEnable() { base.OnEnable(); AllOrePieces.Add(this); }
	protected override void OnDisable() { base.OnDisable(); AllOrePieces.Remove(this); }
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/OrePiecePoolManager.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<T> (FREE), GlobalEnumsC, OrePiece (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I recycle all ore pieces to avoid Instantiate/Destroy GC spikes. Zero allocation after warmup.
/// Keyed pools: Dictionary[OreKey → Queue of inactive OrePiece]. On SpawnPooledOre: dequeue
/// or Instantiate if pool empty. On ReturnToPool: reset physics state, deactivate, enqueue.
///
/// OreKey = composite of (ResourceType, PieceType, IsPolished) for pool identity.
/// TrySpawnPooledOre: used by conversion methods (may fail if prefab null → returns null).
/// SpawnPooledOre: used by OreNode drop + AutoMiner (always spawns, applies velocity after).
///
/// Who uses me: OreNode (via GameEvents.OnSpawnOreRequested), OrePiece (conversion methods),
///   AutoMiner (timer spawn), ToolDebugSpawnTool (Phase J).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/OrePiecePoolManager")]
public class OrePiecePoolManager : Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>
{
	#region OreKey
	readonly struct OreKey : System.IEquatable<OreKey>
	{
		readonly int resourceType, pieceType, polished;
		OreKey(int r, int p, int pol) { resourceType = r; pieceType = p; polished = pol; }
		public static OreKey From(ResourceType r, PieceType p, bool isPolished) => new OreKey((int)r, (int)p, isPolished ? 1 : 0);
		public bool Equals(OreKey o) => resourceType == o.resourceType && pieceType == o.pieceType && polished == o.polished;
		public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is OreKey k && Equals(k);
		public override int GetHashCode() => ((17 * 31 + resourceType) * 31 + pieceType) * 31 + polished;
	}
	#endregion

	#region State
	readonly Dictionary<OreKey, Queue<OrePiece>> pools = new Dictionary<OreKey, Queue<OrePiece>>();
	readonly Dictionary<OreKey, OrePiece> prefabByKey = new Dictionary<OreKey, OrePiece>();
	#endregion

	#region Lifecycle
	void Start()
	{
		// purpose: MiningNode fires OnSpawnOreRequested(GameObject) → we GetComponent<OrePiece> + pool spawn
		GameEvents.OnSpawnOreRequested += (prefabGO, pos, rot) =>
		{
			if (prefabGO == null) return;
			OrePiece prefab = prefabGO.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
			if (prefab == null) { Instantiate(prefabGO, pos, rot); return; } // fallback: non-ore GO
			OrePiece spawned = SpawnPooledOre(prefab, pos, rot);
			if (spawned != null)
			{
				Rigidbody rb = spawned.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
				if (rb != null)
				{
					rb.linearVelocity = new Vector3(Random.Range(-1.5f, 1.5f), Random.Range(2f, 4f), Random.Range(-1.5f, 1.5f));
					rb.angularVelocity = Random.insideUnitSphere * Random.Range(1f, 50f);
				}
			}
		};
	}
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	/// <summary> Spawn from pool or Instantiate. Registers prefab for future pool lookups. </summary>
	public OrePiece SpawnPooledOre(OrePiece prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		if (prefab == null) return null;
		OreKey key = OreKey.From(prefab.ResourceType, prefab.PieceType, prefab.IsPolished);
		// → register prefab if first time seeing this key
		if (!prefabByKey.ContainsKey(key)) prefabByKey[key] = prefab;
		// → try dequeue from pool
		if (pools.TryGetValue(key, out var queue) && queue.Count > 0)
		{
			OrePiece recycled = queue.Dequeue();
			recycled.transform.position = pos;
			recycled.transform.rotation = rot;
			ResetPhysics(recycled);
			recycled.gameObject.SetActive(true);
			return recycled;
		}
		// → pool empty: Instantiate new
		OrePiece fresh = Object.Instantiate(prefab, pos, rot);
		return fresh;
	}

	/// <summary> Spawn by enum key (used by ToolDebugSpawnTool + AutoMiner). Looks up prefab from registry. </summary>
	public OrePiece SpawnPooledOre(ResourceType r, PieceType p, bool polished, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		OreKey key = OreKey.From(r, p, polished);
		if (prefabByKey.TryGetValue(key, out var prefab)) return SpawnPooledOre(prefab, pos, rot);
		Debug.LogWarning($"[OrePiecePoolManager] No prefab registered for {key}");
		return null;
	}

	/// <summary> Same as SpawnPooledOre but returns null without warning if prefab is null (conversion methods). </summary>
	public OrePiece TrySpawnPooledOre(GameObject prefabGO, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		if (prefabGO == null) return null;
		OrePiece prefab = prefabGO.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
		return prefab != null ? SpawnPooledOre(prefab, pos, rot) : null;
	}

	/// <summary> Return ore to pool: deactivate, reset state, enqueue. </summary>
	public void ReturnToPool(OrePiece ore)
	{
		if (ore == null) return;
		OreKey key = OreKey.From(ore.ResourceType, ore.PieceType, ore.IsPolished);
		if (!pools.ContainsKey(key)) pools[key] = new Queue<OrePiece>();
		ore.gameObject.SetActive(false);
		ore.gameObject.SetTag(TagType.untagged);
		ResetPhysics(ore);
		pools[key].Enqueue(ore);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Helpers
	void ResetPhysics(OrePiece ore)
	{
		Rigidbody rb = ore.Rb;
		if (rb == null) return;
		rb.linearVelocity = Vector3.zero;
		rb.angularVelocity = Vector3.zero;
		rb.linearDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_LINEAR_DAMPING;
		rb.angularDamping = BasePhysicsObject.STANDARD_ANGULAR_DAMPING;
		rb.isKinematic = false;
		rb.interpolation = RigidbodyInterpolation.None;
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/PhysicsLimitUIWarning.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: GameEvents (FREE), GlobalEnumsC

/// <summary>
/// I show/hide a UI warning panel when ore limit state changes.
/// Subscribes to OnOreLimitChanged → activates yellow panel at slightlyLimited,
/// red at veryLimited/blocked. Hides at normal.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/UI/PhysicsLimitUIWarning")]
public class PhysicsLimitUIWarning : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] GameObject _warningPanel;
	[SerializeField] UnityEngine.UI.Image _warningImage;
	[SerializeField] Color _yellowWarning = Color.yellow;
	[SerializeField] Color _redWarning = Color.red;

	void Start()
	{
		// purpose: OreLimitManager fires → we show/hide warning
		GameEvents.OnOreLimitChanged += OnLimitChanged;
		if (_warningPanel != null) _warningPanel.SetActive(false);
	}

	void OnLimitChanged(OreLimitState state)
	{
		if (_warningPanel == null) return;
		switch (state)
		{
			case OreLimitState.normal: _warningPanel.SetActive(false); break;
			case OreLimitState.slightlyLimited: _warningPanel.SetActive(true); if (_warningImage) _warningImage.color = _yellowWarning; break;
			case OreLimitState.veryLimited:
			case OreLimitState.blocked: _warningPanel.SetActive(true); if (_warningImage) _warningImage.color = _redWarning; break;
		}
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/OreSystem/SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Pure data SO_: defines what resources an AutoMiner node can produce.
/// Contains a list of WeightedOreChance for random ore type selection,
/// probability of spawning gems, and display text helpers (via extension class below).
///
/// Who uses me: AutoMiner (reads PossibleResources), BuildingPlacementNode (Phase D assigns on attach).
/// </summary>
[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "SO/SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition", fileName = "SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition")]
public class SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition : ScriptableObject
{
	public string Name;
	public List<WeightedOreChance> PossibleResources;
	public float GemProbability = 0.05f;
	public bool CanProduceGems = true;
}

/// <summary> Static extension class for SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition — SO_ stays pure data. </summary>
public static class SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinitionExt
{
	/// <summary> Weighted random pick from PossibleResources. If canProduceGems and roll succeeds, picks gem. </summary>
	public static OrePiece GetOrePrefab(this SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition def, bool allowGems)
	{
		if (def.PossibleResources == null || def.PossibleResources.Count == 0) return null;
		// → gem roll
		if (allowGems && def.CanProduceGems && Random.value < def.GemProbability)
		{
			// → find gem-type prefab in list
			var gem = def.PossibleResources.Find(w => w.OrePrefab != null && w.OrePrefab.PieceType == PieceType.gem);
			if (gem != null) return gem.OrePrefab;
		}
		return UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandomPick(def.PossibleResources);
	}

	/// <summary> Primary resource type of this definition (first entry). </summary>
	public static ResourceType GetPrimaryResourceType(this SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition def)
	{
		if (def.PossibleResources != null && def.PossibleResources.Count > 0 && def.PossibleResources[0].OrePrefab != null)
			return def.PossibleResources[0].OrePrefab.ResourceType;
		return ResourceType.iron;
	}
}

## Scene Setup (beginner-friendly)

1. Create Empty GO → name "ParticleManager"
2. Add `ParticleManager` component
3. Assign particle prefabs:
   - `_oreNodeHitParticlePrefab` → small spark burst (plays when pickaxe hits IDamageable)
   - `_genericHitImpactParticle` → dust puff (plays when pickaxe hits non-damageable)
   - `_breakOreNodeParticlePrefab` → big explosion burst (plays when MiningNode breaks)
4. Done — auto-subscribes to GameEvents on Start. No wiring needed.

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/ParticleSystem/ParticleManager.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<T> (FREE), GameEvents (FREE)
// Shape: 📡 Listener — subscribes to events, creates particles. Zero concrete deps.

/// <summary>
/// I spawn particle prefabs at world positions. Subscribes to:
///   OnCreateParticleRequested → Instantiate particle at pos/rot
///   OnPickaxeHit (from Phase B-1) → creates ore hit or generic impact particle
///
/// Truly L0 portable — zero imports from any _-Systems/. Just listens to GameEvents
/// and instantiates whatever prefab is passed in. Drop in any project → works.
///
/// Who uses me: OreNode (break particles), ToolPickaxe (hit particles via OnPickaxeHit).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/ParticleManager")]
public class ParticleManager : Singleton<ParticleManager>
{
	[SerializeField] GameObject _oreNodeHitParticlePrefab;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _genericHitImpactParticle;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _breakOreNodeParticlePrefab;

	public GameObject GetOreNodeHitParticlePrefab() => _oreNodeHitParticlePrefab;
	public GameObject GetGenericHitImpactParticle() => _genericHitImpactParticle;
	public GameObject GetBreakOreNodeParticlePrefab() => _breakOreNodeParticlePrefab;

	void Start()
	{
		// purpose: OreNode fires → we create break particle
		GameEvents.OnCreateParticleRequested += CreateParticle;
		// purpose: ToolPickaxe (B-1) fires → we create hit particle
		GameEvents.OnPickaxeHit += (pos, normal, isDamageable) =>
		{
			GameObject prefab = isDamageable ? _oreNodeHitParticlePrefab : _genericHitImpactParticle;
			if (prefab != null) CreateParticle(prefab, pos, Quaternion.LookRotation(normal));
		};
	}

	/// <summary> Instantiate particle at position/rotation. Auto-destroys after 5s. </summary>
	public void CreateParticle(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		if (prefab == null) return;
		GameObject particle = Instantiate(prefab, pos, rot);
		Destroy(particle, 5f);
	}
}

# SellerSystem — L1 ✅ Portable (interface-only)

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | C |
| Level | **L1** (IScannable — interface-only from B-1) |
| Shape | 🕷️ **Spider** + 📡 **Broadcaster** |
| Scripts | SellerMachine, ISellableWithDelay |
| Owns Interface | **ISellableWithDelay** |
| Implements | IScannable (B-1) |
| Concrete deps | **NONE** — uses ISellableWithDelay for delayed sell, BaseSellableItem (FREE) for instant |

> **NOTE:** Original source SellerMachine directly called `GetComponentInParent<OrePiece>().SellAfterDelay()`.
> We replaced with ISellableWithDelay (caller-defines). OrePiece implements it in OreSystem.

## Internal File Dependency Graph

```
  ┌── SellerSystem/ ────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  INTERNAL
  │  SellerMachine
  │    OnTriggerEnter:
  │      skip MarkedForDestruction (HasTag extension)
  │      skip no-Rigidbody
  │      ISellableWithDelay → SellAfterDelay (ore, boxes — delayed)
  │      fallback: BaseSellableItem (FREE) → instant sell + Destroy
  │    fires RaiseObjectSold on fallback path
  │  ISellableWithDelay (OWNED interface: SellAfterDelay(float delay))
  │
  ├── BOUNDARY ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  OWNED INTERFACE:
  │    ◆ ISellableWithDelay ◆ → OrePiece (OreSystem C) implements
  │                           → BoxObject (PackagingSystem E) implements
  │
  │  IMPLEMENTS (from other systems):
  │    ◆ IScannable ◆ ←── ToolSystem (B-1) — scanner reads "Deposit Hopper"
  │
  ├── EXTERNAL ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  OUT: → OnObjectSold(value, resourceType, pieceType) ── EconomyManager (A) subscribes
  │  (subscribes to no events)
  │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────
```

**Verdict: COMPLETE.** Zero concrete deps. ISellableWithDelay decouples from OrePiece. Any object implementing the interface gets the delayed sell behavior. BaseSellableItem fallback is FREE infra.

## Scene Setup (beginner-friendly)

1. Create Empty GO → name "SellerMachine" (or "Deposit Hopper")
2. Add `SellerMachine` component. Set `_sellDelay` = 2f.
3. Add Box Collider → check **Is Trigger** ✅. Size it to cover the hopper area.
4. Place at end of conveyor belt. Ore enters trigger → sold after 2s → money goes up.

> **⚠️ CRITICAL:** The trigger collider MUST be on the same GO as SellerMachine (not a child). OnTriggerEnter won't fire otherwise.

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/SellerSystem/ISellableWithDelay.cs ==== -->
/// <summary>
/// Any object that can be sold with a delay (visual slide-through effect).
/// SellerMachine calls SellAfterDelay when the object enters the trigger.
/// OrePiece implements: tags MarkedForDestruction, detaches magnet, waits, fires OnObjectSold, returns to pool.
/// Phase E BoxObject also implements: waits, sells contents, destroys.
///
/// SellerSystem OWNS this interface (caller-defines / DIP pattern).
/// Implementors: OrePiece (OreSystem C), BoxObject (PackagingSystem E).
/// Callers: SellerMachine (SellerSystem C).
/// </summary>
public interface ISellableWithDelay
{
    void SellAfterDelay(float delay);
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c/Scripts/_-Systems/SellerSystem/SellerMachine.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: ISellableWithDelay (owned), IScannable (from B-1 — interface only), BaseSellableItem (FREE)
// Shape: 🕷️ Spider + 📡 Broadcaster — owns ISellableWithDelay, fires OnObjectSold. ZERO concrete imports.

/// <summary>
/// I sell objects that enter my trigger volume. OnTriggerEnter → skip MarkedForDestruction →
/// skip no-Rigidbody → ISellableWithDelay.SellAfterDelay (ore, boxes — delayed sell).
/// Fallback: BaseSellableItem (FREE) → instant sell + Destroy.
///
/// ZERO OrePiece import — uses ISellableWithDelay interface. OrePiece implements it in OreSystem.
/// Phase E BoxObject also implements it.
///
/// Who uses me: placed in the world near conveyor belt outputs. Ore flows in, money comes out.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Machines/SellerMachine")]
public class SellerMachine : MonoBehaviour, IScannable
{
	[SerializeField] float _sellDelay = 2f;

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		// → skip already-marked
		if (other.HasTag(TagType.markedForDestruction)) return;
		// → skip non-physics
		Rigidbody rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
		if (rb == null) return;
		// → ISellableWithDelay: OrePiece, BoxObject — delayed sell (slide-through visual)
		ISellableWithDelay delayed = rb.GetComponentInParent<ISellableWithDelay>();
		if (delayed != null) { delayed.SellAfterDelay(_sellDelay); return; }
		// → fallback: BaseSellableItem (tools, misc) — instant sell
		BaseSellableItem sellable = rb.GetComponentInParent<BaseSellableItem>();
		if (sellable != null)
		{
			float value = sellable.GetSellValue();
			// purpose: EconomyManager subscribes → AddMoney
			GameEvents.RaiseObjectSold(value, ResourceType.iron, PieceType.ore);
			Destroy(sellable.gameObject);
		}
	}

	#region IScannable
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => "Deposit Hopper";
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/GUIDE.md ==== -->
# Phase D — Building & Conveyor System

## What It Looks Like When Running

Buy a "Conveyor Belt" from the shop → a crate spawns. Walk to crate, press E → "Take" → goes into hotbar as ToolBuilder. Equip it:

- Green ghost follows your aim, snapped to 1m grid
- Invalid position (overlapping) → ghost turns red
- Press R → rotate 90°. Press Q → mirror variant
- Place near another conveyor → auto-snaps input→output alignment
- LMB → real building instantiates. Quantity decrements.

Ore on conveyors: ore drops onto belt trigger → gets pushed forward via physics velocity. Chain multiple belts → ore flows through your factory.

Hammer tool: look at placed building → E → "Take" (back to inventory) or "Pack" (spawn crate). Wrench tool: LMB/RMB toggles scaffolding legs.

---

## Folder Structure

```
phase-d/Scripts/
├── 0-Core/GameEvents.cs                     (OnBuildingPlaced, OnBuildingRemoved, OnBuildingTakeRequested)
├── 2-Data/
│   ├── Enums/GlobalEnumsD.cs                (CanPlaceBuilding, PlacementNodeRequirement, SupportType)
```

## Key Architecture

### BuildingToolBridge — zero concrete ToolBuilder import
- Implements `IBuildingToolContext` from Phase B-1
- On equip: fires `GameEvents.OnBuildingToolContextReady(this)` — **NOT** `TryGetComponent<ToolBuilder>`
- ToolBuilder (B-1) subscribes to the event → calls `SetBuildingContext(ctx)`
- Neither side knows the other's concrete class. Pure GameEvent + interface.

### BuildingPlacementNode — INodeConfigurable (zero AutoMiner import)
- Stores `ScriptableObject _resourceDefinition` (Unity base type, not Phase C SO)
- On AttachBuilding: `building.GetComponent<INodeConfigurable>()?.ConfigureFromNode(_resourceDefinition)`
- AutoMiner (Phase C) implements `INodeConfigurable`, casts back internally
- Without Phase C: GetComponent returns null → skipped. Node still attaches.

### BuildingObject — 5 interfaces (all from other systems)
- `IHammerTarget` → OnHammerPrimary/Secondary (take/pack) — from B-1 ToolSystem
- `ISupportToggleable` → SetSupportsEnabled (wrench tool) — from B-1 ToolSystem
- `IScannable` → GetScanDisplayName (scanner tool) — from B-1 ToolSystem
- `IInteractable` → interaction wheel — from A InteractionSystem
- `IHighlightable` → outline on hover — from B HighlightSystem

### BuildingCrate — world canvas icon/text
- `Start()` sets world-space canvas: icon from definition, "x5" quantity text
- If no definition → destroys canvas children. Matches original 100%.

### SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition — IShopItemProvider (DIP from Phase A)
- SO_ShopItemDef delegates GetName/GetDescription/GetIcon via DIP pattern
- Zero concrete Phase D import in ShopUISystem

### ConveyorBelt — generic physics (not OrePiece)
- Works with `BasePhysicsObject` (FREE infra) — any Rigidbody on the belt moves
- Makes ConveyorSystem reusable in any physics game

### RobotGrabberArm — generic Rigidbody grab
- Original checked `OrePiece.PieceType` — our version works with any Rigidbody
- Zero Phase C concrete imports

---

## Scene Setup (Beginner-Friendly)

### Step 1 — BuildingManager GO

1. Create empty GO → name it `BuildingManager`
2. Add `BuildingManager` component
3. Assign all LayerMask fields (create layers if missing):
   - `_buildingPlacementCollisionLayers` = Default + BuildingObject
   - `_scaffoldingPlacementCollisionLayers` = Default + Terrain
   - `_buildingSupportsCollisionLayers` = BuildingObject
   - `_buildingObjectLayer` = BuildingObject
   - `_buildingPlacementRaycastLayer` = Default + Terrain + BuildingObject
4. Create 3 materials in Project: `GhostGreen`, `GhostRed`, `GhostOrange` (transparent, Standard shader)
   - Assign to `_ghostMaterial`, `_invalidGhostMaterial`, `_requirementGhostMaterial`
5. Create `SO_InteractionOption` assets: "Pack" (type=pack), "Take" (type=take)
   - Assign to `_interactionPack`, `_interactionTake`
6. Assign `_buildingCratePrefab` → drag BuildingCrate prefab

> **⚠️ Without BuildingManager in scene:** ghost won't appear, placement validation won't run, scaffolding won't update.

### Step 2 — ConveyorBeltManager GO

1. Create empty GO → name it `ConveyorBeltManager`
2. Add `ConveyorBeltManager` component
3. No inspector fields needed — it auto-discovers belts via static list

> **⚠️ Without ConveyorBeltManager:** conveyor velocities accumulate but never get applied to Rigidbodies.

### Step 3 — BuildingToolBridge GO

1. Create empty GO → name it `BuildingToolBridge` (or put on same GO as BuildingManager)
2. Add `BuildingToolBridge` component
3. No inspector fields — it subscribes to `OnItemEquipped` and fires `OnBuildingToolContextReady` automatically

> **⚠️ Without BuildingToolBridge:** ToolBuilder equips but buildCtx stays null → can't place buildings.

### Step 4 — ConveyorRenderer GO (optional — performance)

1. Create empty GO → name it `ConveyorRenderer`
2. Add `ConveyorRenderer` component
3. Assign `_beltMesh` (belt surface mesh) + `_beltMaterial` (scrolling belt material)

### Step 5 — BuildingPlacementNode (per AutoMiner spot)

1. Create empty GO at desired position → name it `Node_Iron`
2. Add `BuildingPlacementNode` component
3. Set `_requirementType` = `autoMiner`
4. Set `_primaryResourceName` = "Iron"
5. Set `_attachmentText` = "Iron Auto-Miner Node"
6. Drag the `SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition` SO into `_resourceDefinition` (ScriptableObject field)
7. Create a child GO with a simple sphere mesh → assign to `_ghostVisual` (yellow indicator)

### Step 6 — Building Prefab

1. Create a prefab with:
   - Root: `BuildingObject` component + BoxCollider (physical)
   - Child `PlacementCollider`: BoxCollider (placement validation area)
   - Child `CrateSpawnPoint`: empty Transform (where crate spawns on Pack)
   - Optional children: `ConveyorInputSnap`, `ConveyorOutputSnap` (empty Transforms for snap points)
2. Create `SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition` asset → assign prefab to `BuildingPrefabs[0]`
3. Create `SO_ShopItemDef` for shop → drag the building def into `_externalProvider`, check `_useExternalProvider`

### Step 7 — ConveyorBelt Prefab

1. Create a prefab:
   - Root: `ConveyorBelt` component + BoxCollider (physical surface)
   - Child `Trigger`: BoxCollider (isTrigger=true, taller than surface)
   - Optional: add `ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent` + `ConveyorSoundSource`
2. Set `_speed`, `_retainYVelocity` on the ConveyorBelt component

### Required Layers

| Layer Name | Used By |
|---|---|
| `BuildingGhost` | Ghost objects during placement (set by BuildingManager) |
| `BuildingObject` | Placed buildings (set by BuildingObject.Start) |

> **⚠️ PITFALL #5: Missing Layers = silent failure.** Create these in Edit → Project Settings → Tags and Layers BEFORE testing.

## Source vs Phase Diff

| Original | Our approach |
|---|---|
| BuildingObject uses `FindObjectOfType<PlayerInventory>()` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseBuildingTakeRequested` |
| BuildingCrate uses `FindObjectOfType<PlayerInventory>()` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseToolPickupRequested` |
| ToolBuilder directly imports BuildingManager | Uses `IBuildingToolContext` interface (B-1) |
| BuildingToolBridge does `TryGetComponent<ToolBuilder>` | Fires `OnBuildingToolContextReady` GameEvent — ToolBuilder subscribes |
| BuildingPlacementNode imports `AutoMiner` + `AutoMinerResourceDefinition` | Uses `INodeConfigurable` interface (Phase C owns) + `ScriptableObject` base type |
| RobotGrabberArm checks `OrePiece.PieceType` | Generic Rigidbody grab — works with anything |
| SO_ShopItemDef imports SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition | Uses `IShopItemProvider` (DIP — Phase A owns) |
| BuildingManager inline grid snap math | Extracted to BuildingDataService (pure C#, testable) |
| Conveyor uses DOTween for toggles | Instant set + `// Phase H:` comment |
| BuildingCrate.Start missing | Added: world canvas icon/text from definition |

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/0-Core/GameEvents.cs ==== -->
using System;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Phase D partial — building placement, removal, and take events.
/// BuildingObject fires OnBuildingRemoved on Take/Pack.
/// ToolBuilder fires OnBuildingPlaced after instantiation.
/// BuildingObject/BuildingCrate fire OnBuildingTakeRequested → InventoryOrchestrator picks up.
/// </summary>
public static partial class GameEvents
{
	// when a building is placed (ToolBuilder.PrimaryFire → instantiate) >>
	public static event Action<Vector3> OnBuildingPlaced;
	public static void RaiseBuildingPlaced(Vector3 position)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnBuildingPlaced), OnBuildingPlaced);
		OnBuildingPlaced?.Invoke(position);
	}
	// << when a building is placed

	// when a building is removed (Take or Pack) >>
	public static event Action<Vector3> OnBuildingRemoved;
	public static void RaiseBuildingRemoved(Vector3 position)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnBuildingRemoved), OnBuildingRemoved);
		OnBuildingRemoved?.Invoke(position);
	}
	// << when a building is removed

	// when a building/crate wants to go into inventory (fires IInventoryItem) >>
	public static event Action<IInventoryItem> OnBuildingTakeRequested;
	public static void RaiseBuildingTakeRequested(IInventoryItem item)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnBuildingTakeRequested), OnBuildingTakeRequested);
		OnBuildingTakeRequested?.Invoke(item);
	}
	// << when a building/crate wants to go into inventory

	// when building tool context is ready (BuildingToolBridge fires on equip) >>
	public static event Action<IBuildingToolContext> OnBuildingToolContextReady;
	public static void RaiseBuildingToolContextReady(IBuildingToolContext ctx)
	{
		LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnBuildingToolContextReady), OnBuildingToolContextReady);
		OnBuildingToolContextReady?.Invoke(ctx);
	}
	// << when building tool context is ready
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/2-Data/Entities/BuildingRotationInfo.cs ==== -->
using System;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Snap rotation candidate — stores a rotation + whether it uses the mirrored variant.
/// BuildingDataService.GetNearbySnapConnections returns a list of these. ResolveBestSnap
/// groups by value (IEquatable for LINQ GroupBy) and picks the most-voted rotation.
/// Struct for value-based equality and no heap allocation.
/// </summary>
[Serializable]
public struct BuildingRotationInfo : IEquatable<BuildingRotationInfo>
{
	public Quaternion Rotation;
	public bool IsMirroredMode;

	public bool Equals(BuildingRotationInfo other)
		=> Rotation.Equals(other.Rotation) && IsMirroredMode == other.IsMirroredMode;

	public override bool Equals(object obj)
		=> obj is BuildingRotationInfo other && Equals(other);

	public override int GetHashCode()
		=> HashCode.Combine(Rotation, IsMirroredMode);
}
