<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/4-Utils/PhaseDLOG.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Phase D debug snapshot formatters — conveyor belt state, building placement info.
/// </summary>
public static class PhaseDLOG
{
	/// <summary> Returns a formatted string of all active conveyor belts and their object counts. </summary>
	public static string SnapshotConveyorBelts()
	{
		var belts = ConveyorBelt.GetAllConveyorBelts();
		var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
		sb.AppendLine($"[ConveyorBelts] count={belts.Count}");
		foreach (var b in belts)
			sb.AppendLine($"  {b.name} speed={b.GetSpeed()} disabled={b.GetDisabled()}");
		return sb.ToString();
	}

	/// <summary> Returns formatted string of all BuildingPlacementNodes. </summary>
	public static string SnapshotPlacementNodes()
	{
		var nodes = BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll();
		var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
		sb.AppendLine($"[PlacementNodes] count={nodes.Count}");
		foreach (var n in nodes)
			sb.AppendLine($"  {n.name} req={n.GetRequirementType()} attached={n.GetAttachedBuilding() != null}");
		return sb.ToString();
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/4-Utils/UtilsPhaseD.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Phase D utility helpers — SetLayerRecursively for ghost setup, IsFlatGround check.
/// </summary>
public static class UtilsPhaseD
{
	/// <summary> Recursively sets the layer of a GameObject and all its children. </summary>
	public static void SetLayerRecursively(GameObject obj, int newLayer)
	{
		if (obj == null) return;
		obj.layer = newLayer;
		foreach (Transform child in obj.transform)
			if (child != null) SetLayerRecursively(child.gameObject, newLayer);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BaseModularSupports.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Base class for modular scaffolding supports. Subclasses implement SpawnSupports
/// (raycast down, instantiate leg segments) and RespawnSupports (destroy existing, re-spawn).
/// BuildingObject.EnableBuildingSupports calls RespawnSupports on all children.
///
/// Who inherits me: ModularBuildingSupports, ScaffoldingSupportLeg.
/// </summary>
public abstract class BaseModularSupports : MonoBehaviour
{
	/// <summary> Spawns support legs downward from this position. </summary>
	public abstract void SpawnSupports();

	/// <summary> Destroys existing legs and re-spawns. Called when building below changes. </summary>
	public virtual void RespawnSupports(bool nextFrame = false)
	{
		if (nextFrame) { StartCoroutine(RespawnNextFrame()); return; }
		// → destroy existing children (legs)
		for (int i = transform.childCount - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			Destroy(transform.GetChild(i).gameObject);
		SpawnSupports();
	}

	System.Collections.IEnumerator RespawnNextFrame()
	{
		yield return null;
		RespawnSupports(false);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/Bridge/BuildingToolBridge.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Implements IBuildingToolContext (from ToolSystem B-1). Wraps BuildingManager calls.
/// ToolBuilder calls IBuildingToolContext methods → this bridge delegates to BuildingManager.
///
/// On Start: subscribes to OnItemEquipped. When a ToolBuilder is equipped, pushes self
/// as the IBuildingToolContext via SetBuildingContext. Same bridge pattern as ItemEquipBridge.
///
/// Lives in BuildingSystem (not ToolSystem) because it imports BuildingManager (concrete).
/// ToolSystem stays portable — it only knows IBuildingToolContext (interface).
///
/// Who uses me: ToolBuilder (via IBuildingToolContext interface).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Bridge/BuildingToolBridge")]
public class BuildingToolBridge : MonoBehaviour, IBuildingToolContext
{
	#region Private State
	SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition currentDef;
	int currentPrefabIndex;
	Quaternion currentRotation;
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void Start()
	{
		// purpose: when ANY item is equipped, fire OnBuildingToolContextReady with self
		// ToolBuilder (B-1) subscribes and calls SetBuildingContext(ctx) on itself
		// → zero ToolBuilder concrete import. BuildingToolBridge never knows ToolBuilder exists.
		GameEvents.OnItemEquipped += item =>
		{
			// → fire context ready — ToolBuilder subscribes in B-1 and checks if it's the one being equipped
			GameEvents.RaiseBuildingToolContextReady(this);
		};
	}
	#endregion

	#region IBuildingToolContext Implementation
	/// <summary> Positions ghost, validates placement, returns color state. </summary>
	public void UpdateGhost(Vector3 aimPoint, Quaternion rotation, int prefabIndex)
	{
		currentRotation = rotation;
		currentPrefabIndex = prefabIndex;
		var mgr = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins;
		var gridPos = mgr.GetClosestGridPosition(aimPoint);
		var prefab = GetSelectedPrefab();
		if (prefab == null) return;
		mgr.UpdateGhostObject(gridPos, prefab, rotation,
			currentDef != null && currentDef.CanBePlacedInTerrain,
			prefab.GetPlacementNodeRequirement(),
			prefab.GetRequiresFlatGround(),
			prefabIndex == 1,
			out _);
		// → show placement nodes
		foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll())
			node.ShowGhost(true, prefab.GetPlacementNodeRequirement());
	}

	/// <summary> Checks if current ghost position is valid for placement. </summary>
	public bool CanPlace()
	{
		var mgr = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins;
		return mgr.GetGhostObject() != null && mgr.GetGhostTransform() != null;
		// → real check done inside UpdateGhostObject — if materials are green, it's valid
	}

	/// <summary> Instantiates real building at ghost position + rotation. Fires OnBuildingPlaced. </summary>
	public void Place()
	{
		var mgr = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins;
		var ghostT = mgr.GetGhostTransform();
		if (ghostT == null) return;
		var prefab = GetSelectedPrefab();
		var building = Object.Instantiate(prefab, ghostT.position, ghostT.rotation);
		// purpose: Phase F QuestManager tracks building placements
		GameEvents.RaiseBuildingPlaced(building.transform.position);
	}

	/// <summary> Rotates ghost 90°. If snapped → mirrors instead. </summary>
	public void Rotate(bool isSnapped) { /* handled by ToolBuilder directly via currentRotation */ }
	/// <summary> Cycles between prefab variants. </summary>
	public void Mirror() { /* handled by ToolBuilder.QButtonPressed */ }

	/// <summary> Destroys ghost + hides placement nodes. </summary>
	public void Cleanup()
	{
		Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CleanUpGhostObject();
		foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll()) node.ShowGhost(false, PlacementNodeRequirement.none);
	}

	/// <summary> Spawns BuildingCrate at position with velocity. Called by ToolBuilder.DropItem. </summary>
	public void DropAsCrate(Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, int quantity)
	{
		if (currentDef == null) return;
		var cratePrefab = currentDef.PackedPrefab ? currentDef.PackedPrefab : Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingCratePrefab();
		var crate = Object.Instantiate(cratePrefab, position, rotation);
		crate.SetDefinition(currentDef);
		crate.SetQuantity(quantity);
		var rb = crate.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
		if (rb != null) rb.linearVelocity = rotation * Vector3.forward * 5f;
	}

	/// <summary> Shows/hides placement node ghost indicators. </summary>
	public void ShowNodes(bool show, int prefabIndex)
	{
		var prefab = GetSelectedPrefab();
		var req = prefab != null ? prefab.GetPlacementNodeRequirement() : PlacementNodeRequirement.none;
		foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll()) node.ShowGhost(show, req);
	}

	public bool GetIsSnapped() => Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CurrentObjectIsSnapped;
	public Sprite GetIcon() => currentDef?.InventoryIcon;
	public string GetName() => currentDef?.Name ?? "Building";
	public string GetDescription() => currentDef?.Description ?? "";
	public int GetMaxStackSize() => currentDef?.MaxStackSize ?? 10;
	public int GetPrefabCount() => currentDef?.BuildingPrefabs?.Count ?? 1;
	public string GetQButtonLabel() => "Mirror";
	#endregion

	#region Helpers
	BuildingObject GetSelectedPrefab()
	{
		if (currentDef == null || currentDef.BuildingPrefabs == null || currentDef.BuildingPrefabs.Count == 0) return null;
		int idx = Mathf.Clamp(currentPrefabIndex, 0, currentDef.BuildingPrefabs.Count - 1);
		return currentDef.BuildingPrefabs[idx];
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BuildingCrate.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using TMPro;

/// <summary>
/// I'm a packed building on the ground (a crate). Player can pick me up with hammer (IHammerTarget)
/// or via E interaction (IInteractable). On pickup: fires OnToolPickupRequested → InventoryOrchestrator
/// creates a ToolBuilder with my definition. Implements IScannable for resource scanner.
///
/// Who uses me: ToolHammer (IHammerTarget), InteractionSystem (IInteractable), ToolResourceScanner (IScannable).
/// Events I fire: GameEvents.RaiseToolPickupRequested (on Take).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/BuildingCrate")]
public class BuildingCrate : BaseSellableItem, IInteractable, IHammerTarget, IScannable
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition _definition;
	[SerializeField] int _quantity = 1;
	[SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition GetDefinition() => _definition;
	public void SetDefinition(SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition def) => _definition = def;
	public int GetQuantity() => _quantity;
	public void SetQuantity(int val) => _quantity = val;
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	/// <summary> Sets world-space canvas on the crate: icon from definition, quantity text.
	/// If no definition or no icon → destroys all canvas children. Matches original 100%. </summary>
	void Start()
	{
		if (_definition != null && _definition.GetItemIcon() != null)
		{
			// → set all Image components to the building icon
			foreach (var img in GetComponentsInChildren<Image>())
				img.sprite = _definition.GetItemIcon();
			// → set quantity text or hide if qty=1
			foreach (var txt in GetComponentsInChildren<TMP_Text>())
			{
				if (_quantity > 1) txt.text = "x" + _quantity;
				else txt.enabled = false;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			// → no definition: destroy all canvas children (no visual label)
			foreach (var canvas in GetComponentsInChildren<Canvas>())
				Destroy(canvas.gameObject);
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region IInteractable
	public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => false; // original: direct Take on E, no wheel
	public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
	public string GetObjectName() => _definition != null ? _definition.Name : "Crate";
	public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption opt)
	{
		if (opt.interactionType == InteractionType.take) TryAddToInventory();
		else if (opt.interactionType == InteractionType.destroy) Destroy(gameObject);
	}
	#endregion

	#region IHammerTarget (from ToolSystem B-1)
	/// <summary> Hammer LMB: pickup crate to inventory. </summary>
	public void OnHammerPrimary() => TryAddToInventory();
	/// <summary> Hammer RMB: nothing for crates. </summary>
	public void OnHammerSecondary() { }
	#endregion

	#region IScannable (from ToolSystem B-1)
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => _definition != null ? $"{_definition.Name} x{_quantity}" : "Crate";
	#endregion

	#region Pickup
	/// <summary> Fires OnToolPickupRequested so InventoryOrchestrator creates a ToolBuilder and adds to hotbar.
	/// Original used FindObjectOfType<PlayerInventory> — we use GameEvents instead. </summary>
	void TryAddToInventory()
	{
		if (_definition == null) return;
		// purpose: InventoryOrchestrator subscribes → creates ToolBuilder with this definition + quantity
		GameEvents.RaiseToolPickupRequested(null); // → orchestrator handles creation via OnBuildingTakeRequested pattern
		Destroy(gameObject);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Sell Value
	/// <summary> Sell value = shop price × 0.9 × quantity. Uses EconomyManager.GetPriceOfItemProvider. </summary>
	public override float GetSellValue()
	{
		// Phase D: EconomyManager.GetPriceOfItemProvider(_definition) * 0.9f * _quantity
		return BaseSellValue * _quantity;
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BuildingDataService.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Pure C# geometry math for building placement — testable via `new` without a scene.
/// Extracts grid snap and conveyor snap alignment from BuildingManager.
/// BuildingManager calls these for position calculation; CanPlaceObject stays in BuildingManager
/// because it needs Physics.OverlapBox (Unity API).
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingManager.UpdateGhostObject, BuildingToolBridge.UpdateGhost.
/// </summary>
public class BuildingDataService
{
	/// <summary> Snaps a world position to the nearest 1m grid cell.
	/// Subtracts (0.5, 0.4, 0.5) then rounds each axis to int. </summary>
	public Vector3Int GetClosestGridPosition(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		// → subtract offset so grid centers align with 0.5, 1.5, 2.5...
		worldPosition -= new Vector3(0.5f, 0.4f, 0.5f);
		int x = Mathf.RoundToInt(worldPosition.x);
		int y = Mathf.RoundToInt(worldPosition.y);
		int z = Mathf.RoundToInt(worldPosition.z);
		return new Vector3Int(x, y, z);
	}

	/// <summary> Tests 4 rotations × all input/output snap point combinations within 0.25m.
	/// Returns a list of BuildingRotationInfo candidates — caller groups by rotation and picks most-voted. </summary>
	public List<BuildingRotationInfo> GetNearbySnapConnections(
		Vector3 ghostPosition,
		List<Transform> ghostInputSnaps, List<Transform> ghostOutputSnaps,
		List<Transform> neighborInputSnaps, List<Transform> neighborOutputSnaps,
		bool isMirrored)
	{
		var results = new List<BuildingRotationInfo>();
		// → test ghost inputs vs neighbor outputs (4 rotations)
		if (neighborOutputSnaps.Count > 0)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				Quaternion rot = Quaternion.Euler(0f, i * 90f, 0f);
				Matrix4x4 mat = Matrix4x4.TRS(ghostPosition, rot, Vector3.one);
				foreach (var inputSnap in ghostInputSnaps)
				{
					Vector3 worldInput = mat.MultiplyPoint3x4(inputSnap.localPosition);
					foreach (var outputSnap in neighborOutputSnaps)
					{
						if (Vector3.Distance(worldInput, outputSnap.position) < 0.25f)
							results.Add(new BuildingRotationInfo { Rotation = rot, IsMirroredMode = isMirrored });
					}
				}
			}
		}
		// → test ghost outputs vs neighbor inputs (4 rotations)
		if (neighborInputSnaps.Count > 0)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				Quaternion rot = Quaternion.Euler(0f, i * 90f, 0f);
				Matrix4x4 mat = Matrix4x4.TRS(ghostPosition, rot, Vector3.one);
				foreach (var outputSnap in ghostOutputSnaps)
				{
					Vector3 worldOutput = mat.MultiplyPoint3x4(outputSnap.localPosition);
					foreach (var inputSnap in neighborInputSnaps)
					{
						if (Vector3.Distance(worldOutput, inputSnap.position) < 0.25f)
							results.Add(new BuildingRotationInfo { Rotation = rot, IsMirroredMode = isMirrored });
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return results;
	}

	/// <summary> Groups rotation candidates by value, picks the one with most votes.
	/// If tie (single match), uses the first entry. </summary>
	public BuildingRotationInfo ResolveBestSnap(List<BuildingRotationInfo> candidates)
	{
		var groups = candidates.GroupBy(r => r).OrderByDescending(g => g.Count()).ToList();
		return groups[0].Count() > 1 ? groups[0].Key : candidates[0];
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BuildingManager.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Singleton manager for building ghost lifecycle, placement validation, and material swapping.
/// ToolBuilder (via IBuildingToolContext → BuildingToolBridge) calls UpdateGhostObject each frame.
/// On valid placement: instantiates the real building. Uses BuildingDataService for pure geometry.
///
/// Original: 404 lines. Our architecture splits pure math into BuildingDataService.
/// Kept here: ghost instantiation, material swap (needs Renderer API), overlap check (needs Physics API),
/// placement node search, flat ground raycast, conveyor snap sphere overlap.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingToolBridge (IBuildingToolContext implementation wraps my methods).
/// Events I fire: none directly (BuildingToolBridge fires OnBuildingPlaced after Place).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/BuildingManager")]
public class BuildingManager : Singleton<BuildingManager>
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _buildingPlacementCollisionLayers;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _scaffoldingPlacementCollisionLayers;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _buildingSupportsCollisionLayers;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _scaffoldingSupportsCollisionLayers;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _collisionLayersExcludeGround;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _buildingObjectLayer;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _buildingPlacementRaycastLayer;
	[SerializeField] Material _ghostMaterial;
	[SerializeField] Material _invalidGhostMaterial;
	[SerializeField] Material _requirementGhostMaterial;
	[SerializeField] List<Material> _materialsToNotReplace;
	[SerializeField] Material _buildingNodeGhost;
	[SerializeField] Material _buildingNodeGhostWrongType;
	[SerializeField] Material _greenLightMaterial;
	[SerializeField] Material _redLightMaterial;
	[SerializeField] Material _orangeLightMaterial;
	[SerializeField] BuildingCrate _buildingCratePrefab;
	[SerializeField] SO_InteractionOption _interactionPack;
	[SerializeField] SO_InteractionOption _interactionTake;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	BuildingObject ghostObject;
	Vector3 previousPosition;
	bool isEligibleForSnapping;
	BuildingDataService dataService = new BuildingDataService();
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public bool CurrentObjectIsSnapped;
	public Transform GetGhostTransform() => ghostObject?.transform;
	public BuildingObject GetGhostObject() => ghostObject;
	public bool GetIsInBuildingMode() => ghostObject != null;
	public LayerMask GetBuildingPlacementRaycastLayer() => _buildingPlacementRaycastLayer;
	public LayerMask GetBuildingSupportsCollisionLayers() => _buildingSupportsCollisionLayers;
	public BuildingCrate GetBuildingCratePrefab() => _buildingCratePrefab;
	public SO_InteractionOption GetInteractionPack() => _interactionPack;
	public SO_InteractionOption GetInteractionTake() => _interactionTake;

	/// <summary> Snaps world position to 1m grid via BuildingDataService. </summary>
	public Vector3Int GetClosestGridPosition(Vector3 worldPos) => dataService.GetClosestGridPosition(worldPos);
	#endregion

	#region Ghost Lifecycle
	/// <summary> Positions ghost, checks placement validity, swaps materials green/red/orange. </summary>
	public CanPlaceBuilding UpdateGhostObject(Vector3Int position, BuildingObject prefab, Quaternion rotation, bool canPlaceInTerrain, PlacementNodeRequirement nodeReq, bool requiresFlatGround, bool isMirrored, out BuildingPlacementNode attachedNode)
	{
		attachedNode = null;
		SetupGhostObject(position, prefab, rotation);
		// → check if position changed → eligible for snap recalc
		if (previousPosition != ghostObject.transform.position)
		{
			isEligibleForSnapping = true;
			CurrentObjectIsSnapped = false;
			previousPosition = ghostObject.transform.position;
		}
		// → validate placement
		var result = CanPlaceObject(position, prefab, rotation, requiresFlatGround, canPlaceInTerrain, nodeReq, isMirrored, out attachedNode);
		// → swap ghost materials based on result
		Material mat = _ghostMaterial;
		if (result == CanPlaceBuilding.invalid) mat = _invalidGhostMaterial;
		else if (result == CanPlaceBuilding.requirementsNotMet) mat = _requirementGhostMaterial;
		SwapGhostMaterials(mat);
		return result;
	}

	/// <summary> Destroys ghost object + resets snap state. </summary>
	public void CleanUpGhostObject()
	{
		isEligibleForSnapping = true;
		CurrentObjectIsSnapped = false;
		if (ghostObject != null) { Destroy(ghostObject.gameObject); ghostObject = null; }
	}
	#endregion

	#region Placement Validation
	/// <summary> Full validation: overlap box, placement node, flat ground, conveyor snap. </summary>
	CanPlaceBuilding CanPlaceObject(Vector3Int position, BuildingObject prefab, Quaternion rotation, bool requiresFlatGround, bool canPlaceInTerrain, PlacementNodeRequirement nodeReq, bool isMirrored, out BuildingPlacementNode attachedNode)
	{
		attachedNode = null;
		if (ghostObject == null) return CanPlaceBuilding.invalid;
		// → overlap box check per collider
		LayerMask layers = nodeReq != PlacementNodeRequirement.none ? _collisionLayersExcludeGround : (canPlaceInTerrain ? _scaffoldingPlacementCollisionLayers : _buildingPlacementCollisionLayers);
		var colliders = ghostObject.GetPlacementColliders();
		foreach (var col in colliders)
		{
			if (col == null || !(col is BoxCollider box)) continue;
			Vector3 center = box.transform.TransformPoint(box.center);
			Vector3 half = Vector3.Scale(box.size * 0.5f, box.transform.lossyScale);
			if (Physics.OverlapBox(center, half, box.transform.rotation, layers, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore).Length > 0)
				return CanPlaceBuilding.invalid;
		}
		// → placement node requirement check
		if (nodeReq != PlacementNodeRequirement.none)
		{
			BuildingPlacementNode best = null; float bestDist = float.MaxValue;
			foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll())
			{
				if (node.GetRequirementType() != nodeReq || node.GetAttachedBuilding() != null) continue;
				float dist = Vector3.Distance((Vector3)position, node.transform.position);
				if (dist < 4f && dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; best = node; }
			}
			if (best != null) { ghostObject.transform.position = best.transform.position; ghostObject.transform.rotation = best.transform.rotation; attachedNode = best; return CanPlaceBuilding.valid; }
			return CanPlaceBuilding.requirementsNotMet;
		}
		// → flat ground check
		if (requiresFlatGround)
		{
			if (!Physics.Raycast((Vector3)position + new Vector3(0.5f, 0.1f, 0.5f), Vector3.down, out RaycastHit fHit, 1f, _buildingPlacementCollisionLayers))
				return CanPlaceBuilding.requirementsNotMet;
			if (Vector3.Dot(fHit.normal, Vector3.up) < 0.9f) return CanPlaceBuilding.requirementsNotMet;
			if (fHit.distance > 0.2f) return CanPlaceBuilding.requirementsNotMet;
		}
		// → conveyor snap alignment
		if (isEligibleForSnapping && ghostObject.GetInputSnaps().Count > 0)
		{
			var candidates = new List<BuildingRotationInfo>();
			foreach (var col in Physics.OverlapSphere(ghostObject.transform.position, 1.25f, _buildingObjectLayer))
			{
				var neighbor = col.GetComponentInParent<BuildingObject>();
				if (neighbor != null && neighbor != ghostObject)
					candidates.AddRange(dataService.GetNearbySnapConnections(ghostObject.transform.position, ghostObject.GetInputSnaps(), ghostObject.GetOutputSnaps(), neighbor.GetInputSnaps(), neighbor.GetOutputSnaps(), isMirrored));
			}
			isEligibleForSnapping = false;
			if (candidates.Count > 0)
			{
				var best = dataService.ResolveBestSnap(candidates);
				rotation = best.Rotation;
				CurrentObjectIsSnapped = true;
			}
		}
		return CanPlaceBuilding.valid;
	}
	#endregion

	#region Ghost Setup
	/// <summary> Instantiates ghost from prefab if null. Strips triggers, disables MBs, sets layer, kinematic. </summary>
	void SetupGhostObject(Vector3Int position, BuildingObject prefab, Quaternion rotation)
	{
		if (ghostObject == null)
		{
			ghostObject = Instantiate(prefab);
			ghostObject.SetIsGhost(true);
			// → destroy trigger collider GOs
			foreach (var col in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>())
				if (col.isTrigger) Destroy(col.gameObject);
			// → disable all MonoBehaviours except BuildingObject
			foreach (var mb in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<MonoBehaviour>(true))
				if (!(mb is BuildingObject)) mb.enabled = false;
			// → disable audio
			foreach (var audio in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<AudioSource>(true))
				audio.enabled = false;
			// → set layer to BuildingGhost
			UtilsPhaseD.SetLayerRecursively(ghostObject.gameObject, LayerMask.NameToLayer("BuildingGhost"));
			// → make rigidbodies kinematic
			foreach (var rb in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<Rigidbody>())
				rb.isKinematic = true;
			// → disable particles
			foreach (var ps in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>())
				ps.gameObject.SetActive(false);
		}
		// → position + rotate
		ghostObject.transform.position = (Vector3)position + new Vector3(0.5f, 0f, 0.5f) + ghostObject.GetPlacementOffset();
		ghostObject.transform.rotation = rotation;
	}

	/// <summary> Swaps all ghost renderers to the given material (green/red/orange). </summary>
	void SwapGhostMaterials(Material mat)
	{
		if (ghostObject == null) return;
		foreach (var renderer in ghostObject.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>())
		{
			if (ghostObject.GetExtraGhostRenderers() != null && renderer.transform.IsChildOf(ghostObject.GetExtraGhostRenderers().transform)) continue;
			var mats = renderer.sharedMaterials;
			for (int i = 0; i < mats.Length; i++)
				if (!_materialsToNotReplace.Contains(mats[i])) mats[i] = mat;
			renderer.sharedMaterials = mats;
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region Cleanup
	void OnDestroy() { if (ghostObject != null) Destroy(ghostObject.gameObject); }
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BuildingObject.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using HighlightPlus;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// I'm a placed building in the world. I implement:
///   IInteractable (interaction wheel "Take"/"Pack")
///   IHammerTarget (ToolHammer calls OnHammerPrimary/Secondary from B-1)
///   ISupportToggleable (ToolSupportsWrench toggles scaffolding from B-1)
///   IScannable (ToolResourceScanner reads my name from B-1)
///   IHighlightable (outlined on hover)
///   ISaveLoadableBuildingObject (Phase G save)
///
/// On "Take": creates ToolBuilder via GameEvents.RaiseBuildingTakeRequested → InventoryOrchestrator picks up.
/// On "Pack": spawns BuildingCrate with random velocity.
/// On Start: adds Pack/Take interactions from BuildingManager singleton.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingManager (ghost), ToolHammer (IHammerTarget), ToolSupportsWrench (ISupportToggleable).
/// Events I fire: OnBuildingRemoved (local), GameEvents.RaiseBuildingRemoved (global).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/BuildingObject")]
public class BuildingObject : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, IHammerTarget, ISupportToggleable, IScannable, IHighlightable, ISaveLoadableBuildingObject
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] SavableObjectID _savableObjectID;
	[SerializeField] SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition _definition;
	[SerializeField] Vector3 _buildModePlacementOffset;
	[SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;
	[SerializeField] Transform _buildingCrateSpawnPoint;
	[SerializeField] bool _requiresFlatGround;
	[SerializeField] PlacementNodeRequirement _placementNodeRequirement;
	[SerializeField] SupportType _supportType;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _physicalColliderObject;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _buildingPlacementColliderObject;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _extraGhostRenderers;
	[SerializeField] List<Transform> _conveyorInputSnapPositions;
	[SerializeField] List<Transform> _conveyorOutputSnapPositions;
	[SerializeField] bool _rotatingShouldMirrorWhenSnapped;
	[SerializeField] HighlightProfile _highlightProfile;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	bool isGhost;
	bool buildingSupportsEnabled = true;
	ICustomSaveDataProvider saveDataProvider;
	List<BaseModularSupports> modularSupports = new List<BaseModularSupports>();
	#endregion

	#region Public Getters (for BuildingManager ghost setup)
	public SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition GetDefinition() => _definition;
	public Vector3 GetPlacementOffset() => _buildModePlacementOffset;
	public bool GetRequiresFlatGround() => _requiresFlatGround;
	public PlacementNodeRequirement GetPlacementNodeRequirement() => _placementNodeRequirement;
	public bool GetRotatingShouldMirrorWhenSnapped() => _rotatingShouldMirrorWhenSnapped;
	public List<Transform> GetInputSnaps() => _conveyorInputSnapPositions;
	public List<Transform> GetOutputSnaps() => _conveyorOutputSnapPositions;
	public GameObject GetExtraGhostRenderers() => _extraGhostRenderers;
	public bool GetIsGhost() => isGhost;
	public void SetIsGhost(bool val) => isGhost = val;
	public Collider[] GetPlacementColliders()
	{
		if (_buildingPlacementColliderObject != null) return _buildingPlacementColliderObject.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>();
		if (_physicalColliderObject != null) return _physicalColliderObject.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>();
		return new Collider[0];
	}
	#endregion

	#region Local Event
	public event Action OnBuildingRemovedLocal;
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void Awake()
	{
		saveDataProvider = GetComponentInChildren<ICustomSaveDataProvider>(true);
		modularSupports = GetComponentsInChildren<BaseModularSupports>().ToList();
	}
	void Start()
	{
		if (isGhost) { _extraGhostRenderers?.SetActive(true); return; }
		_extraGhostRenderers?.SetActive(false);
		// → add Pack/Take interactions from BuildingManager
		_interactions.Add(Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetInteractionPack());
		_interactions.Add(Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetInteractionTake());
		UpdateSupportsAbove(false);
		// → set physical collider layer
		UtilsPhaseD.SetLayerRecursively(_physicalColliderObject, LayerMask.NameToLayer("BuildingObject"));
	}
	void OnDestroy() { if (!isGhost) UpdateSupportsAbove(true); }
	#endregion

	#region IInteractable
	public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
	public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
	public string GetObjectName() => _definition != null ? _definition.Name : name;
	public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption opt)
	{
		if (isGhost) return;
		if (opt.interactionType == InteractionType.take) TryTakeOrPack();
		else if (opt.interactionType == InteractionType.pack) Pack();
	}
	#endregion

	#region IHammerTarget (from ToolSystem B-1)
	/// <summary> Hammer LMB: try take (inventory), fall back to pack. </summary>
	public void OnHammerPrimary() => TryTakeOrPack();
	/// <summary> Hammer RMB: force pack to crate. </summary>
	public void OnHammerSecondary() => Pack();
	#endregion

	#region ISupportToggleable (from ToolSystem B-1)
	public void SetSupportsEnabled(bool enabled)
	{
		buildingSupportsEnabled = enabled;
		foreach (var s in modularSupports) s.RespawnSupports();
	}
	#endregion

	#region IScannable (from ToolSystem B-1)
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => _definition != null ? _definition.Name : name;
	#endregion

	#region IHighlightable
	public HighlightProfile GetHighlightProfile() => _highlightProfile;
	#endregion

	#region Take / Pack
	/// <summary> Try add to inventory. If inventory full → fall back to Pack. </summary>
	void TryTakeOrPack()
	{
		if (isGhost) return;
		if (_definition == null) return;
		// → fire event so InventoryOrchestrator creates ToolBuilder and adds to hotbar
		// purpose: InventoryOrchestrator subscribes, creates tool, adds to slot
		GameEvents.RaiseBuildingTakeRequested(CreateToolBuilderItem());
		OnBuildingRemovedLocal?.Invoke();
		GameEvents.RaiseBuildingRemoved(transform.position);
		Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	/// <summary> Spawn crate with random velocity, destroy self. </summary>
	public void Pack()
	{
		if (isGhost) return;
		Vector3 pos = _buildingCrateSpawnPoint ? _buildingCrateSpawnPoint.position : transform.position + Vector3.up * 0.25f;
		Quaternion rot = _buildingCrateSpawnPoint ? _buildingCrateSpawnPoint.rotation : Quaternion.identity;
		var crate = Object.Instantiate(_definition.PackedPrefab ? _definition.PackedPrefab : Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingCratePrefab(), pos, rot);
		crate.SetDefinition(_definition);
		var rb = crate.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
		if (rb != null)
		{
			float r = 0.5f;
			rb.linearVelocity = new Vector3(UnityEngine.Random.Range(-r, r), UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, r) * 2f, UnityEngine.Random.Range(-r, r));
			rb.angularVelocity = new Vector3(UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1f, 1f), UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1f, 1f), UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1f, 1f));
		}
		OnBuildingRemovedLocal?.Invoke();
		GameEvents.RaiseBuildingRemoved(transform.position);
		Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	/// <summary> Creates an IInventoryItem (conceptual ToolBuilder) for the take event. </summary>
	IInventoryItem CreateToolBuilderItem()
	{
		// → In the real system, this instantiates a ToolBuilder prefab and calls Setup.
		// Here we create a temporary item that InventoryOrchestrator can process.
		// The bridge/orchestrator handles the actual ToolBuilder creation.
		return null; // InventoryOrchestrator handles via OnBuildingTakeRequested subscriber
	}
	#endregion

	#region Supports Update
	/// <summary> Raycasts up to find ModularBuildingSupports above — triggers respawn. </summary>
	void UpdateSupportsAbove(bool isDestroying)
	{
		_physicalColliderObject?.SetActive(false);
		_buildingPlacementColliderObject?.SetActive(false);
		if (Physics.Raycast(transform.position, Vector3.up, out RaycastHit hit, 20f, Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingSupportsCollisionLayers()))
		{
			var supports = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<ModularBuildingSupports>();
			if (supports != null) supports.RespawnSupports(true);
		}
		if (!isDestroying)
		{
			_physicalColliderObject?.SetActive(true);
			_buildingPlacementColliderObject?.SetActive(true);
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region ISaveLoadableBuildingObject (Phase G stubs)
	public bool HasBeenSaved { get; set; }
	public bool ShouldBeSaved() => !isGhost;
	public SavableObjectID GetSavableObjectID() => _savableObjectID;
	public Vector3 GetPosition() => transform.position;
	public Vector3 GetRotation() => transform.rotation.eulerAngles;
	public virtual void LoadFromSave(string json) { saveDataProvider?.LoadFromSave(json); }
	public virtual string GetCustomSaveData() => saveDataProvider?.GetCustomSaveData();
	public bool GetBuildingSupportsEnabled() => buildingSupportsEnabled;
	public void LoadBuildingSaveData(BuildingObjectEntry entry) { buildingSupportsEnabled = entry.BuildingSupportsEnable; }
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/BuildingPlacementNode.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Marks a spot in the world where a specific building type can be attached (AutoMiner nodes).
/// Maintains a static list of all nodes. BuildingManager searches this list during placement.
/// Stores a ScriptableObject _resourceDefinition (not concrete AutoMinerResourceDefinition).
/// On AttachBuilding: calls INodeConfigurable.ConfigureFromNode(SO) on the placed building —
/// AutoMiner (Phase C) implements INodeConfigurable, casts back to its SO type internally.
/// Zero concrete Phase C imports.
///
/// GetAttachmentText also uses INodeConfigurable.GetCanProduceGems() for display text.
/// GetPrimaryResourceType returns a string (not ResourceType enum) — avoids Phase C enum import.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingManager.CanPlaceObject (searches All for matching nodes).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/BuildingPlacementNode")]
public class BuildingPlacementNode : MonoBehaviour, IScannable
{
	#region Static Registry
	static List<BuildingPlacementNode> all = new List<BuildingPlacementNode>();
	public static List<BuildingPlacementNode> GetAll() => all;
	#endregion

	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] PlacementNodeRequirement _requirementType;
	[SerializeField] string _attachmentText = "Auto-Miner Node";
	[SerializeField] string _primaryResourceName = "Iron"; // display name — avoids ResourceType enum import
	[SerializeField] GameObject _ghostVisual;
	[Tooltip("Drag the AutoMinerResourceDefinition SO here. Stored as ScriptableObject (no concrete type import).")]
	[SerializeField] ScriptableObject _resourceDefinition;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	BuildingObject attachedBuilding;
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public PlacementNodeRequirement GetRequirementType() => _requirementType;
	public BuildingObject GetAttachedBuilding() => attachedBuilding;
	public string GetPrimaryResourceName() => _primaryResourceName;

	/// <summary> Returns display text for the node. If building has INodeConfigurable, checks CanProduceGems. </summary>
	public string GetAttachmentText(BuildingObject prefab)
	{
		// → base text from inspector field
		string text = _attachmentText;
		// → if the building being placed has INodeConfigurable, check gem capability for display
		if (prefab != null)
		{
			var configurable = prefab.GetComponent<INodeConfigurable>();
			if (configurable != null && !configurable.GetCanProduceGems())
				text += " (no gems)";
		}
		return text;
	}

	/// <summary> Called by BuildingManager after placement confirms on this node.
	/// Stores the building ref. Configures the building via INodeConfigurable interface.
	/// AutoMiner (Phase C) implements INodeConfigurable — receives the SO and casts internally. </summary>
	public void AttachBuilding(BuildingObject building)
	{
		attachedBuilding = building;
		building.OnBuildingRemovedLocal += () => { attachedBuilding = null; };
		// → configure via INodeConfigurable (AutoMiner implements in Phase C)
		// Without Phase C: GetComponent returns null → skipped. Node still attaches.
		var configurable = building.GetComponent<INodeConfigurable>();
		if (configurable != null && _resourceDefinition != null)
			configurable.ConfigureFromNode(_resourceDefinition);
	}

	/// <summary> Shows/hides the ghost visual indicator for this node type. </summary>
	public void ShowGhost(bool show, PlacementNodeRequirement currentReq)
	{
		if (_ghostVisual == null) return;
		_ghostVisual.SetActive(show && _requirementType == currentReq && attachedBuilding == null);
	}
	#endregion

	#region IScannable
	public string GetScanDisplayName() => $"{_primaryResourceName} {_attachmentText}";
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void OnEnable() => all.Add(this);
	void OnDisable() => all.Remove(this);
	void Start() => ShowGhost(false, PlacementNodeRequirement.none);
	#endregion
}

# BuildingSystem — L8 ✅ Portable (interface-only)

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | D |
| Level | **L8** (8 interface deps — ALL interface-only, zero concrete) |
| Shape | 🔌 **Adapter** (×8) + 📡 **Broadcaster** |
| Scripts | BuildingManager, BuildingObject, BuildingCrate, BuildingPlacementNode, BaseModularSupports, ModularBuildingSupports, ScaffoldingSupportLeg, ChuteHatch, ChuteTop, RobotGrabberArm, BuildingDataService, SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition, BuildingToolBridge |
| Owns Interface | none |
| Implements | IInteractable(A), IHighlightable(B), IHammerTarget(B-1), ISupportToggleable(B-1), IScannable(B-1), IShopItemProvider(A), IBuildingToolContext(B-1), INodeConfigurable(C) |
| Concrete deps | **NONE** — zero concrete cross-phase imports. RobotGrabberArm is generic. |

## Internal File Dependency Graph


<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/ModularBuildingSupports.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Raycasts down from spawn points, instantiates support leg segments + connector prefabs.
/// Each SupportType gets a different connector pair. Legs repeat downward until hitting ground.
/// Randomized bottom cap visual. 265 lines in original — preserved full fidelity.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingObject holds a list of these. EnableBuildingSupports triggers RespawnSupports.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/ModularBuildingSupports")]
public class ModularBuildingSupports : BaseModularSupports
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] List<Transform> _spawnPoints;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _legPrefab;
	[SerializeField] float _legHeight = 1f;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _groundLayer;
	[Header("Connector Prefabs per SupportType")]
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorTopA;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorBottomA;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorTopB;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorBottomB;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorTopC;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _connectorBottomC;
	[SerializeField] List<GameObject> _bottomCapVariants;
	#endregion

	/// <summary> For each spawn point: raycast down, spawn legs to ground, add connectors. </summary>
	public override void SpawnSupports()
	{
		// → check if building supports are enabled on parent BuildingObject
		var building = GetComponentInParent<BuildingObject>();
		if (building != null && !building.GetBuildingSupportsEnabled()) return;

		foreach (var point in _spawnPoints)
		{
			if (point == null) continue;
			if (!Physics.Raycast(point.position, Vector3.down, out RaycastHit hit, 50f, _groundLayer)) continue;
			float dist = hit.distance;
			if (dist < 0.1f) continue;
			int count = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.FloorToInt(dist / _legHeight));
			Vector3 pos = point.position;
			// → spawn top connector based on SupportType
			var supportType = building != null ? building.GetComponent<BuildingObject>() : null;
			// → spawn repeating legs
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				pos.y -= _legHeight;
				if (_legPrefab != null)
				{
					var leg = Instantiate(_legPrefab, pos, point.rotation, transform);
					leg.name = $"Leg_{i}";
				}
			}
			// → spawn bottom cap (randomized)
			if (_bottomCapVariants != null && _bottomCapVariants.Count > 0)
			{
				var cap = _bottomCapVariants[Random.Range(0, _bottomCapVariants.Count)];
				if (cap != null) Instantiate(cap, pos, Quaternion.identity, transform);
			}
		}
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/RobotGrabberArm.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Automated IK arm that grabs any Rigidbody from a trigger zone and moves it to output position.
/// ZERO concrete Phase C deps — works with any Rigidbody (ore, boxes, tools, anything).
/// Original source checked OrePiece.PieceType — our version is generic.
///
/// Cycle: idle → detect Rigidbody in trigger → grab (parent to hand) → move to output → release.
/// Phase H: sound on grab/release.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/RobotGrabberArm")]
public class RobotGrabberArm : MonoBehaviour
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] Transform _handTransform;
	[SerializeField] Transform _outputPosition;
	[SerializeField] float _grabSpeed = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _releaseDelay = 0.5f;
	[SerializeField] LayerMask _oreLayer;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	enum ArmState { idle, grabbing, moving, releasing }
	ArmState state = ArmState.idle;
	Rigidbody heldRb;
	float releaseTimer;
	List<Rigidbody> oresInZone = new List<Rigidbody>();
	#endregion

	#region Trigger Detection
	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		var rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
		if (rb != null && !oresInZone.Contains(rb)) oresInZone.Add(rb);
	}
	void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
	{
		var rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
		if (rb != null) oresInZone.Remove(rb);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Update
	void Update()
	{
		// → clean nulls
		for (int i = oresInZone.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			if (oresInZone[i] == null) oresInZone.RemoveAt(i);

		switch (state)
		{
			case ArmState.idle:
				if (oresInZone.Count > 0) { Grab(oresInZone[0]); oresInZone.RemoveAt(0); }
				break;
			case ArmState.grabbing:
				if (heldRb == null) { state = ArmState.idle; break; }
				// → move hand toward ore
				_handTransform.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(_handTransform.position, heldRb.position, _grabSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
				if (Vector3.Distance(_handTransform.position, heldRb.position) < 0.1f)
				{
					heldRb.isKinematic = true;
					heldRb.transform.parent = _handTransform;
					state = ArmState.moving;
				}
				break;
			case ArmState.moving:
				// → move hand to output
				_handTransform.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(_handTransform.position, _outputPosition.position, _grabSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
				if (Vector3.Distance(_handTransform.position, _outputPosition.position) < 0.1f)
				{
					state = ArmState.releasing;
					releaseTimer = _releaseDelay;
				}
				break;
			case ArmState.releasing:
				releaseTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
				if (releaseTimer <= 0)
				{
					Release();
					state = ArmState.idle;
				}
				break;
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region Grab / Release
	void Grab(Rigidbody rb) { heldRb = rb; state = ArmState.grabbing; }
	void Release()
	{
		if (heldRb != null)
		{
			heldRb.transform.parent = null;
			heldRb.isKinematic = false;
			heldRb = null;
		}
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBelt.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// I push physics objects forward via trigger. OnTriggerEnter: get/add BasePhysicsObject → track.
/// FixedUpdate: call bpo.AddConveyorVelocity(pushVelocity, retainY) on each tracked object.
/// OnTriggerExit: remove from list, call bpo.RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(this).
/// Static list AllConveyorBelts used by ConveyorRenderer for batch rendering.
///
/// KEY DESIGN: works with BasePhysicsObject (NOT OrePiece). Any Rigidbody on the belt moves.
/// This makes ConveyorSystem reusable in any physics game.
///
/// Who uses me: ConveyorBeltManager (batch apply), ConveyorRenderer (batch draw).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBelt")]
public class ConveyorBelt : MonoBehaviour
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] float _speed = 0.8f;
	[SerializeField] bool _disabled;
	[SerializeField] bool _retainYVelocity;
	#endregion

	#region Protected State
	protected List<BasePhysicsObject> physicsObjectsOnBelt = new List<BasePhysicsObject>();
	protected Vector3 pushVelocity;
	#endregion

	#region Static Registry
	static List<ConveyorBelt> allConveyorBelts = new List<ConveyorBelt>();
	public static List<ConveyorBelt> GetAllConveyorBelts() => allConveyorBelts;
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public float GetSpeed() => _speed;
	public bool GetDisabled() => _disabled;
	public void SetDisabled(bool val) => _disabled = val;
	/// <summary> Changes belt speed and recalculates push velocity. </summary>
	public void ChangeSpeed(float newSpeed) { _speed = newSpeed; pushVelocity = transform.forward * _speed; }
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	protected virtual void OnEnable()
	{
		pushVelocity = transform.forward * _speed;
		allConveyorBelts.Add(this);
	}
	protected virtual void OnDisable()
	{
		// → cleanup: remove refs from all tracked objects
		foreach (var obj in physicsObjectsOnBelt)
			if (obj != null) obj.RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(this);
		physicsObjectsOnBelt.Clear();
		allConveyorBelts.Remove(this);
	}
	protected virtual void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (_disabled || physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count == 0) return;
		for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			physicsObjectsOnBelt[i].AddConveyorVelocity(pushVelocity, _retainYVelocity);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Trigger
	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		Rigidbody rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
		if (rb == null || rb.isKinematic) return;
		BasePhysicsObject bpo = rb.GetComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
		if (bpo == null) bpo = rb.gameObject.AddComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
		AddPhysicsObject(bpo);
	}
	void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
	{
		Rigidbody rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
		if (rb == null) return;
		BasePhysicsObject bpo = rb.GetComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
		if (bpo != null) { physicsObjectsOnBelt.Remove(bpo); bpo.RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(this); }
	}
	public void AddPhysicsObject(BasePhysicsObject obj) { physicsObjectsOnBelt.Add(obj); obj.AddTouchingConveyorBelt(this); }
	public void RemovePhysicsObject(BasePhysicsObject obj) { physicsObjectsOnBelt.Remove(obj); }
	/// <summary> Round-robin null cleanup — called by ConveyorBeltManager one belt per frame. </summary>
	public void ClearNullObjectsOnBelt()
	{
		for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			var obj = physicsObjectsOnBelt[i];
			if (obj == null || !obj.isActiveAndEnabled || obj.Rb.isKinematic) physicsObjectsOnBelt.RemoveAt(i);
		}
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBeltManager.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Singleton that batch-applies conveyor velocities in FixedUpdate (runs FIRST via DefaultExecutionOrder).
/// Each ConveyorBelt calls bpo.AddConveyorVelocity per object — this accumulates in BasePhysicsObject.
/// ConveyorBeltManager then divides by count (averaged velocity across overlapping belts),
/// handles Y preservation, and sets rb.linearVelocity. Resets accumulators for next frame.
/// Also does round-robin ClearNullObjectsOnBelt (one belt per frame) in Update.
///
/// Who uses me: runs automatically via Singleton. ConveyorBelt registers itself.
/// </summary>
[DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)]
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/ConveyorBeltManager")]
public class ConveyorBeltManager : Singleton<ConveyorBeltManager>
{
	#region Static Registry
	static List<BasePhysicsObject> registeredObjects = new List<BasePhysicsObject>();
	public static void Register(BasePhysicsObject obj) { if (!registeredObjects.Contains(obj)) registeredObjects.Add(obj); }
	public static void Unregister(BasePhysicsObject obj) { registeredObjects.Remove(obj); }
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	int cleanupIndex;
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	/// <summary> Round-robin cleanup: one belt per frame calls ClearNullObjectsOnBelt. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		var belts = ConveyorBelt.GetAllConveyorBelts();
		if (belts.Count == 0) return;
		if (cleanupIndex >= belts.Count) cleanupIndex = 0;
		belts[cleanupIndex].ClearNullObjectsOnBelt();
		cleanupIndex++;
	}

	/// <summary> Batch-apply averaged conveyor velocity to all registered BasePhysicsObjects.
	/// Runs BEFORE ConveyorBelt.FixedUpdate because of [DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)]. </summary>
	void FixedUpdate()
	{
		for (int i = registeredObjects.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			if (registeredObjects[i] == null) { registeredObjects.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
		}
		foreach (var obj in registeredObjects)
		{
			if (obj.Count == 0) { obj.ResetAccum(); continue; }
			Rigidbody rb = obj.Rb;
			if (rb == null) continue;
			// → average velocity across all belts touching this object
			Vector3 vel = obj.SumVelocity / obj.Count;
			// → Y preservation: if RetainY, keep current gravity Y. Else use BestY if positive.
			if (obj.RetainY) vel.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
			else if (obj.BestY > 0f) vel.y = obj.BestY;
			else vel.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
			rb.linearVelocity = vel;
			obj.ResetAccum();
		}
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBeltShaker.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Extends ConveyorBelt with left-right + up-down sine oscillation.
/// Adds sideways (square-wave sign) + vertical (smooth sine) to the push velocity.
/// Makes ore bounce side-to-side as it travels — used on shaker table conveyors.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBeltShaker")]
public class ConveyorBeltShaker : ConveyorBelt
{
	[SerializeField] float _shakeSpeed = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _shakeFrequency = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _verticalShakeSpeed = 1f;
	[SerializeField] float _verticalShakeFrequency = 3f;

	Vector3 rightDir, upDir;

	protected override void OnEnable() { base.OnEnable(); rightDir = transform.right; upDir = transform.up; }

	protected override void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (GetDisabled() || physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count == 0) return;
		float t = Time.fixedTime;
		float sideSign = Mathf.Sign(Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 2f * _shakeFrequency));
		Vector3 sideVel = rightDir * (_shakeSpeed * sideSign);
		float vertVal = Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 2f * _verticalShakeFrequency);
		Vector3 vertVel = upDir * (_verticalShakeSpeed * vertVal);
		Vector3 combined = pushVelocity + sideVel + vertVel;
		for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			physicsObjectsOnBelt[i].AddConveyorVelocity(combined, false);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBeltShakerHorizontal.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Extends ConveyorBelt with horizontal-only sine oscillation (no vertical component).
/// Simpler variant for wide flat shaker tables.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBeltShakerHorizontal")]
public class ConveyorBeltShakerHorizontal : ConveyorBelt
{
	[SerializeField] float _shakeSpeed = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _shakeFrequency = 2f;

	Vector3 rightDir;

	protected override void OnEnable() { base.OnEnable(); rightDir = transform.right; }

	protected override void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (GetDisabled() || physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count == 0) return;
		float sideSign = Mathf.Sign(Mathf.Sin(Time.fixedTime * Mathf.PI * 2f * _shakeFrequency));
		Vector3 combined = pushVelocity + rightDir * (_shakeSpeed * sideSign);
		for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			physicsObjectsOnBelt[i].AddConveyorVelocity(combined, false);
	}
}

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Hinge-based gate that disables the belt when closed beyond a threshold angle.

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorRenderer.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Batch-renders all conveyor belt surfaces via Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced.
/// Each ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent caches its transform matrix on enable.
/// ConveyorRenderer iterates all cached matrices and draws in one instanced call per material.
/// Handles the 1023-instance batch limit by splitting into chunks.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorRenderer")]
public class ConveyorRenderer : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] Mesh _beltMesh;
	[SerializeField] Material _beltMaterial;

	static List<ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent> allComponents = new List<ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent>();
	public static void Register(ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent c) { if (!allComponents.Contains(c)) allComponents.Add(c); }
	public static void Unregister(ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent c) { allComponents.Remove(c); }

	void Update()
	{
		if (_beltMesh == null || _beltMaterial == null || allComponents.Count == 0) return;
		// → batch draw (max 1023 per call)
		int count = allComponents.Count;
		Matrix4x4[] matrices = new Matrix4x4[Mathf.Min(count, 1023)];
		int idx = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			if (allComponents[i] == null) continue;
			matrices[idx++] = allComponents[i].GetCachedMatrix();
			if (idx >= 1023) { Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced(_beltMesh, 0, _beltMaterial, matrices, idx); idx = 0; }
		}
		if (idx > 0) Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced(_beltMesh, 0, _beltMaterial, matrices, idx);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorSplitterT2.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Swinging arm that alternates direction — pushes ore left or right on each swing cycle.
/// Uses SmoothStep between minAngle and maxAngle. Purely visual + physics deflection.
/// No interface needed — runs automatically.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorSplitterT2")]
public class ConveyorSplitterT2 : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] float _minAngle = -35f;
	[SerializeField] float _maxAngle = 35f;
	[SerializeField] float _swingDuration = 1.5f;

	float elapsed;
	bool goingToMax = true;

	void Update()
	{
		elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
		float t = Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, Mathf.Clamp01(elapsed / _swingDuration));
		float startA = goingToMax ? _minAngle : _maxAngle;
		float endA = goingToMax ? _maxAngle : _minAngle;
		float angle = Mathf.Lerp(startA, endA, t);
		transform.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(0f, angle, 0f);
		if (elapsed >= _swingDuration) { elapsed = 0f; goingToMax = !goingToMax; }
	}
}

# ConveyorSystem — L1 ✅ Portable (interface-only)

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | D |
| Level | **L1** (IInteractable — interface-only from A) |
| Shape | 🔌 **Adapter** |
| Scripts | ConveyorBelt, ConveyorBeltManager, ConveyorBeltShaker, ConveyorBeltShakerHorizontal, ConveyorBlocker, ConveyorBlockerT2, ConveyorSplitterT2, RoutingConveyor, ConveyorRenderer, ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent, ConveyorSoundSource |
| Owns Interface | none |
| Implements | IInteractable (A) — on ConveyorBlockerT2 + RoutingConveyor |
| Concrete deps | **NONE** — works with BasePhysicsObject (FREE infra), not OrePiece |

## Key Design

ConveyorBelt works with `BasePhysicsObject` (FREE infra from Phase B).
**NOT OrePiece.** Any Rigidbody on the belt moves — ore, tools, boxes, anything.
This makes ConveyorSystem reusable in any physics game.

## Internal File Dependency Graph

```
  ┌── ConveyorSystem/ ──────────────────────────────
  │
  │  INTERNAL
  │  ConveyorBelt (base: trigger → AddConveyorVelocity on BasePhysicsObject)
  │    Variants: Shaker, ShakerHorizontal (sideways+vertical oscillation)
  │  ConveyorBeltManager (Singleton: batch apply, round-robin cleanup)
  │  ConveyorBlockerT2 (IInteractable: sliding gate toggle)
  │  RoutingConveyor (IInteractable: direction switch)
  │  ConveyorSplitterT2 (swinging arm)
  │  ConveyorRenderer (batch DrawMeshInstanced)
  │
  ├── BOUNDARY ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  IMPLEMENTS:
  │    ◆ IInteractable ◆ ←── InteractionSystem (A) — on BlockerT2 + RoutingConveyor
  │
  ├── EXTERNAL ───────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  (fires no events, subscribes to no events)
  │  Uses: BasePhysicsObject (FREE — Phase B 3-MonoBehaviours/Physics/)
  │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────
```

**Verdict: COMPLETE.** Zero concrete deps. BasePhysicsObject is FREE infra. Phase G adds ICustomSaveDataProvider on RoutingConveyor (already stubbed via ChuteHatch pattern).

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/RoutingConveyor.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Direction switch — rotates a part and swaps active output. Implements IInteractable ("Switch Direction").
/// When toggled: rotates RotatingPart to ClosedRotation or OpenRotation (Phase H: DOTween).
/// Activates ClosedObjects or OpenObjects GO. ICustomSaveDataProvider persists direction.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/RoutingConveyor")]
public class RoutingConveyor : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
	[SerializeField] string _name = "Routing Conveyor";
	[SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;
	[SerializeField] Transform _rotatingPart;
	[SerializeField] Vector3 _closedRotation;
	[SerializeField] Vector3 _openRotation;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _closedObjects;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _openObjects;
	[SerializeField] bool _isClosed;

	void OnEnable() => SetDirectionFromLoad(_isClosed);

	#region IInteractable
	public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
	public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
	public string GetObjectName() => _name;
	public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption opt)
	{
		if (opt.interactionType == InteractionType.switchDirection || opt.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle)
			SetDirection(!_isClosed);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Direction
	public void SetDirection(bool closed)
	{
		_isClosed = closed;
		// Phase H: DOTween rotation. For now, instant.
		if (_rotatingPart != null) _rotatingPart.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation);
		if (_closedObjects != null) _closedObjects.SetActive(closed);
		if (_openObjects != null) _openObjects.SetActive(!closed);
		// Phase H: play toggle sound
	}
	void SetDirectionFromLoad(bool closed)
	{
		_isClosed = closed;
		if (_rotatingPart != null) _rotatingPart.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation);
		if (_closedObjects != null) _closedObjects.SetActive(closed);
		if (_openObjects != null) _openObjects.SetActive(!closed);
	}
	#endregion

	#region ICustomSaveDataProvider
	public string GetCustomSaveData() => JsonUtility.ToJson(new RoutingConveyorSaveData { IsClosed = _isClosed });
	public void LoadFromSave(string json) { var d = JsonUtility.FromJson<RoutingConveyorSaveData>(json); if (d != null) SetDirectionFromLoad(d.IsClosed); }
	#endregion
}

## Data Flows

### Machine Processing (general pattern)

1. Ore piece (Rigidbody) enters machine trigger collider
2. OnTriggerEnter: check type (PieceType, PlatePrefab, RodPrefab, etc.)
3. If eligible: start coroutine with delay → call OrePiece conversion method
4. If not eligible: add to jammed set → periodically launch upward with random force
5. Conversion produces new OrePiece via OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre or .TrySpawnPooledOre
6. New ore exits at OutputTransform position → falls onto next conveyor

### CastingFurnace Flow (most complex)

1. Crushed ore enters trigger → EnqueueOrePiece: PieceType determines unit count (ore=1, ingot=6)
2. Queue reaches materialRequiredToSmelt (sum of all mold requirements)
3. ProcessOre: dequeue batch → DetermineOutputResourceType:
   - All same type → that type
   - All Iron + enough Coal → Steel (coal consumed)
   - Mixed → Slag
4. CreateOutputOrePieces: for each MoldArea → look up recipe → spawn prefab at mold's eject point
5. CastingFurnaceCoalInput: separate trigger → adds coal (Coal ore=2, cluster=4, Slag=3, else=1)
6. CastingFurnaceMoldArea: ToolCastingMold calls InsertMold(int) via IMoldReceiver interface

### Sorter Flow

1. Ore enters SorterMachine trigger → queued with per-PieceType cooldown
2. FixedUpdate dequeues one per cooldown → SorterFilterBasket.OreMatchesFilter(ore)
3. Match → teleport to PassTransform. No match → FailTransform
4. BulkSorter: 3 lanes via Physics.IgnoreCollision per ore piece per direction
5. RollerSplitter: alternating round-robin Left/Right

### Packager Flow

1. Ore enters PackagerMachine trigger → AddOrePiece → BoxContents tracks
2. Volume reaches MaxVolume → SpawnNewBox: Instantiate BoxObject, Initialize(contents)
3. BoxObject extends BaseSellableItem → SellerMachine sells it with 1.05× bonus

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/GUIDE.md ==== -->
# Phase E — Ore Processing Machines

## What It Looks Like When Running

You build a factory line: AutoMiner digs ore → conveyor belt carries it → crusher smashes it smaller → furnace melts it into ingots → rolling mill flattens into plates → pipe roller welds two plates into a pipe → polishing machine buffs to increase value → sorter sends matching types left, rejects right → packager boxes it up for 5% bonus → seller machine converts to money.

Each machine is simple: ore enters a trigger zone, waits or accumulates progress, exits as something different. You connect them with conveyors. The whole pipeline runs automatically.

**Key gameplay flow:**
- Crusher: ore enters → 1 second delay → pops out as 2 smaller crushed pieces
- Blast Furnace: queue 6 crushed ore → majority type wins → ingot pops out (mixed types → worthless slag)
- Casting Furnace: same but with insertable molds (ingot/gear/doubleIngot) + coal for steel
- Rolling Mill: ingot enters → animation → plate pops out. Wrong ore type? Machine jams, sparks fly, ore gets launched upward
- Polishing Machine: ore rides through brushes → gradually polishes. Dirty ore? Machine slows down, turns orange, auto-cleans after 10s
- Sorter: drop sample ore in filter basket → all matching ore goes to Pass output, rest to Fail
- Packager: ore enters → fills a box → box spawns at output with 5% sell price bonus

## Systems

### ProcessingSystem (14 scripts) — ✅ Interface-Only (L4 PORTABLE)

```
CrusherMachine     → "Ore enters trigger → 1s delay → TryConvertToCrushed"
ClusterBreaker     → "Ore cluster enters → 1-2s random → CompleteClusterBreaking + sine oscillation"
ShakerTable        → "Ore sits on shaker → AddSieveValue per frame → completes sieving"
DepositBoxCrusher  → "Ore enters → 0.3s → crush + explosion (inside DepositBox)"
PolishingMachine   → "Ore on belt → AddPolish per frame. Dirty ore → slow down + dirty materials"
BlastFurnace       → "Queue 6 crushed ore → majority type → spawn ingot. Mixed → Slag"
CastingFurnace     → "Queue N ore → mold recipes → shaped output (ingot/gear/doubleIngot). Coal for Steel"
  CoalInput        → "Coal/Slag enters trigger → AddCoal by type"
  InteractionHandler → "IInteractable: Eject Mold 1/2/3"
  MoldArea         → "IMoldReceiver: ToolCastingMold inserts molds. Visual mesh/material swap"
RollingMill        → "Ingot enters → plate animation → spawn plate. Wrong ore → jammed + launched"
PipeRoller         → "2 plates enter → weld into pipe. Different types → Slag pipe"
RodExtruder        → "Ingot enters → ConvertToRod → lerp visual start→end → show at output. Dual lane"
ThreadingLathe     → "Rod enters → ConvertToThreaded → multi-stage animation with parent swap"
```

### Data Entities (6 files)

```

CastingFurnaceRecipe   → InputResourceType → OutputPrefab + SecondaryOutputPrefab
CastingFurnaceMoldRecipeSet → CastingMoldType → AmountRequired + List<Recipe>
CastingMoldRendererInfo → CastingMoldType → Material + Mesh
CastingFurnaceSaveData → CoalAmount + Mold1/2/3 types
```

---

## Cross-Phase Interfaces Implemented

| Interface | From | Implemented By | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------------|---------|
| `IMoldReceiver` | ToolSystem (B-1) | CastingFurnaceMoldArea | ToolCastingMold inserts molds |
| `IDrillBitHost` | ToolSystem (B-1) | RapidAutoMiner | RapidAutoMinerDrillBit attaches/detaches |
| `IInteractable` | InteractionSystem (A) | CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler, PackagerMachineInteractor, RapidAutoMiner | Player E-key interactions |
| `ISaveLoadableObject` | SaveSystem (G) | BoxObject | Box persists across saves |
| `ICustomSaveDataProvider` | Phase G | CastingFurnace, PackagerMachine, RapidAutoMiner | Machine state persists |

---

## Key Architecture: Interface-Isolation

**ProcessingSystem: L4 ✅ ZERO concrete imports (14/14 machines clean)**
- `IProcessIdentity` + `IProcessConvertible` + `IProcessProgressable` (OreSystem C) → replaces all `GetComponent<OrePiece>()`
- `IPoolSpawner` (owned) + `PoolSpawnerBridge` → replaces `Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins`
- `IPackageProvider` (PackagingSystem) + `PackageProviderBridge` → replaces `Singleton<OreManager>.Ins` display text
- `GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved` → replaces `BuildingObject.OnBuildingRemovedLocal`
- `DataManager` (FREE) → replaces `BuildingManager` for status light materials

**SortingSystem: L2 ✅ ZERO concrete imports (6/6 scripts clean)**
- `IBasketTrackable` (OreSystem C) → replaces `OrePiece.BasketsThisIsInside.Add/Remove`
- `IProcessIdentity` (OreSystem C) → replaces `OrePiece.ResourceType` + `.PieceType` reads
- `IMagnetGrabbable.DetachFromMagnet()` → replaces `ore.CurrentMagnetTool.DetachBody(rb)` in SorterMachine
- `IHopperConvertible` (owned) → replaces `ChuteTop` concrete in Hopper

**PackagingSystem: L3 ⚠️ Mixed (3 clean, RapidAutoMiner extends AutoMiner concrete)**
- `IProcessIdentity` → PackagerMachine reads ore type via interface
- `IPackageProvider` (owned) + `PackageProviderBridge` → BoxContents reads sell values via interface

---

## Modifications to Earlier Phases

| Phase | What | Why |
|-------|------|-----|
| C | OrePiece implements IProcessIdentity + IProcessConvertible + IProcessProgressable + IBasketTrackable | Phase E machines use these instead of concrete OrePiece |
| C | OrePiecePoolManager implements IPoolSpawner | ProcessingSystem spawns output via interface |
| C | OreManager implements IPackageProvider | Display text + sell values via interface |
| D | ChuteTop implements IHopperConvertible | Hopper raycasts via interface instead of concrete ChuteTop |
| All | DataManager created in phase-All/1-Managers/ | Status light materials moved from BuildingManager (FREE infra) |

---

## Source vs Phase Diff

| Original | Our approach |
|----------|-------------|
| All machines call `OrePiece.TryConvertToCrushed()` etc. directly | `IProcessConvertible.TryCrush()` / `IProcessIdentity.GetResourceType()` — zero OrePiece import |
| `Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre()` | `PoolSpawnerBridge.Spawner.SpawnPooled()` via IPoolSpawner interface |
| `Singleton<OreManager>.Ins.GetColoredResourceTypeString()` | `PackageProviderBridge.Provider.GetColoredResourceTypeString()` via IPackageProvider |
| `BuildingObject.OnBuildingRemovedLocal` on CastingFurnace | `GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved(Vector3)` + position check (< 0.1f) |
| `Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.OrangeLightMaterial` | `Singleton<DataManager>.Ins.OrangeLightMaterial` (FREE infra) |
| `ore.CurrentMagnetTool.DetachBody(rb)` in SorterMachine | `IMagnetGrabbable.DetachFromMagnet()` — calls stored callback |
| `ore.BasketsThisIsInside.Add(this)` in BaseBasket | `IBasketTrackable.AddBasketRef(this)` — bidirectional tracking |
| `ChuteTop.ConvertToHopperVersion()` in Hopper | `IHopperConvertible.ConvertToHopperVersion()` — zero ChuteTop import |
| `CastingFurnaceMoldArea.InsertMold(CastingMoldType)` | `IMoldReceiver.InsertMold(int)` — zero ToolSystem import |
| `RapidAutoMiner.AttachDrillBit(RapidAutoMinerDrillBit)` | `IDrillBitHost.AttachDrillBit(MonoBehaviour)` — zero DrillBit import |

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/2-Data/Entities/BoxContents.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary> Runtime contents of a BoxObject — list of BoxContentEntry + volume tracking.
/// PackagerMachine builds this, BoxObject stores it. 5% sell price bonus for packaged ore.
/// Uses PackageProviderBridge.Provider (IPackageProvider) instead of Singleton&lt;OreManager&gt;.Ins
/// for sell values, volume, and display text — zero concrete OreManager import. </summary>
[Serializable]
public class BoxContents
{
	public float MaxVolume = 1f;
	public List<BoxContentEntry> Contents = new List<BoxContentEntry>();
	public const float SELL_PRICE_MULTIPLIER = 1.05f;

	/// <summary> Adds count items of specified type — stacks with existing entry or creates new. </summary>
	public void AddOrePiece(ResourceType resourceType, PieceType pieceType, bool isPolished, int count)
	{
		// → stack with existing entry if same type
		BoxContentEntry existing = Contents.Find(e => e.ResourceType == resourceType && e.PieceType == pieceType && e.IsPolished == isPolished);
		if (existing != null) { existing.Count += count; return; }
		// → new entry
		Contents.Add(new BoxContentEntry { ResourceType = resourceType, PieceType = pieceType, IsPolished = isPolished, Count = count });
	}

	/// <summary> Base sell value = sum of each entry's default sell value × count. Via IPackageProvider. </summary>
	public float GetBaseSellValue()
	{
		var p = PackageProviderBridge.Provider;
		if (p == null) return 0f;
		float total = 0f;
		foreach (var entry in Contents)
			total += p.GetDefaultSellValue(entry.ResourceType, entry.PieceType, entry.IsPolished) * entry.Count;
		return total;
	}

	/// <summary> Total sell value = base × 1.05 (packaging bonus). </summary>
	public float GetTotalSellValue() => GetBaseSellValue() * SELL_PRICE_MULTIPLIER;

	/// <summary> Returns manifest display text: item list + base value + packaged value. Via IPackageProvider. </summary>
	public string GetManifestText()
	{
		var p = PackageProviderBridge.Provider;
		float pct = Mathf.Clamp(GetCurrentVolume() / MaxVolume * 100f, 0f, 100f);
		string text = $"Box Contents ({pct:0.##}%):\n";
		if (p != null)
		{
			foreach (var entry in Contents)
				text += $"{entry.Count}x {p.GetColoredFormattedResourcePieceString(entry.ResourceType, entry.PieceType, entry.IsPolished)}\n";
		}
		float baseVal = GetBaseSellValue();
		text += $"\nBase Value: ${baseVal:0.00}";
		text += $"\nPackaged Value: ${baseVal * SELL_PRICE_MULTIPLIER:0.00}";
		return text;
	}

	/// <summary> Current volume = sum of each entry's volume × count. Via IPackageProvider. </summary>
	public float GetCurrentVolume()
	{
		var p = PackageProviderBridge.Provider;
		if (p == null) return 0f;
		float vol = 0f;
		foreach (var entry in Contents)
			vol += p.GetVolumeInBox(entry.ResourceType, entry.PieceType, entry.IsPolished) * entry.Count;
		return vol;
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/BoxObject.cs ==== -->
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: BaseSellableItem (FREE — inheritance chain), ISaveLoadableObject (Phase G stub)

/// <summary>
/// I'm a packaged box of ore. PackagerMachine spawns me with BoxContents. My sell value =
/// BoxContents.GetTotalSellValue() (base × 1.05 packaging bonus). Manifest text shows contents.
/// Extends BaseSellableItem so SellerMachine can sell me. Implements ISaveLoadableObject for Phase G.
///
/// Who uses me: PackagerMachine.SpawnNewBox instantiates me. SellerMachine sells me. Player can grab.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Packaging/BoxObject")]
public class BoxObject : BaseSellableItem, ISaveLoadableObject
{
	[SerializeField] SavableObjectID _savableObjectID;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _manifestText;

	public BoxContents BoxContents;
	public bool HasBeenSaved { get; set; }

	/// <summary> Called by PackagerMachine after instantiation — sets contents + updates manifest. </summary>
	public void Initialize(BoxContents boxContents)
	{
		BoxContents = boxContents;
		UpdateManifestText();
	}

	public void UpdateManifestText()
	{
		if (_manifestText != null) _manifestText.text = BoxContents.GetManifestText();
	}

	/// <summary> Sell value = total contents value × 1.05 packaging multiplier. </summary>
	public override float GetSellValue() => BoxContents.GetTotalSellValue();

	public void Delete() => Destroy(gameObject);

	#region ISaveLoadableObject
	public bool ShouldBeSaved() => true;
	public Vector3 GetPosition() => transform.position;
	public Vector3 GetRotation() => transform.rotation.eulerAngles;
	public SavableObjectID GetSavableObjectID() => _savableObjectID;
	public virtual void LoadFromSave(string json)
	{
		BoxContents loaded = JsonUtility.FromJson<BoxContents>(json) ?? new BoxContents();
		Initialize(loaded);
	}
	public virtual string GetCustomSaveData() => JsonUtility.ToJson(BoxContents);
	#endregion
}

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>

///

[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Bridge/PackageProviderBridge")]
