<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/Dependency.md ==== -->
# PackagingSystem — L3 ⚠️ Mixed (mostly interface, RapidAutoMiner extends AutoMiner concrete)

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | E |
| Level | **L3 mixed** — PackagerMachine/BoxContents/DepositBox = interface-only. RapidAutoMiner/OreAnalyzer = concrete. |
| Shape | 🔌 Adapter + 📡 Listener + ❌ Concrete (RapidAutoMiner only) |
| Scripts | PackagerMachine, PackagerMachineInteractor, BoxObject, DepositBox, OreAnalyzer, RapidAutoMiner |
| Owns Interface | **IPackageProvider** |
| Implements | IInteractable (A), ISaveLoadableObject (G), ICustomSaveDataProvider (G), IDrillBitHost (B-1) |
| Interface Deps | IProcessIdentity (OreSystem C) on PackagerMachine, IPackageProvider (owned — OreManager implements) |
| Concrete Deps | AutoMiner (C — RapidAutoMiner extends), BuildingObject (D — RapidAutoMiner OnBuildingRemoved), OreAnalyzer (mixed — reads OrePiece via IProcessIdentity but OreManager display text via IPackageProvider) |
| Bridge | PackageProviderBridge — pushes IPackageProvider (OreManager) into BoxContents static field |

## Why Mixed (not fully portable)
PackagerMachine is clean (uses IProcessIdentity). BoxObject extends BaseSellableItem (FREE). BoxContents uses IPackageProvider via bridge.
**Still concrete:** RapidAutoMiner extends AutoMiner (inheritance chain — can't interface). OreAnalyzer reads OrePiece fields partially (could be further interfaced but display text has many concrete refs). DepositBox subscribes to EconomyManager.ItemSold (instance event — could be static GameEvent).

## Internal Dependency Graph
```
  ┌── PackagingSystem/ ─────────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  PackagerMachine → trigger → AddOrePiece → BoxContents → SpawnNewBox
  │    └── PackagerMachineInteractor (IInteractable → "Eject Box")
  │  BoxObject → extends BaseSellableItem, ISaveLoadableObject
  │  DepositBox → bucket elevator visual driven by EconomyManager.ItemSold
  │  OreAnalyzer → trigger → display OrePiece/Tool/Crate/Sellable info + items/min
  │  RapidAutoMiner → extends AutoMiner, implements IDrillBitHost
  │    (drill bit attach/eject/break, IInteractable for on/off/eject)
  │
  ├── BOUNDARY ───────────────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  IMPLEMENTS:
  │  ◆ IDrillBitHost ◆ ←── ToolSystem (B-1) — RapidAutoMiner
  │  ◆ IInteractable ◆ ←── InteractionSystem (A) — PackagerMachineInteractor, RapidAutoMiner
  │  ◆ ISaveLoadableObject ◆ ←── SaveSystem (G) — BoxObject
  │  ◆ ICustomSaveDataProvider ◆ ←── Phase G — PackagerMachine, RapidAutoMiner
  │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/DepositBox.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: EconomyManager (EconomySystem A — concrete for ItemSold event)

/// <summary>
/// I'm the bucket elevator / deposit box. Animated buckets move up/down in two columns.
/// Speed is driven by sell activity: when EconomyManager.ItemSold fires → reset idle timer.
/// If no sells for bucketCount × speed seconds → decelerate to 0. Gear animation speed tracks
/// bucket speed. Belt material swaps between moving/stopped. Tier1 → Tier2 upgrade available.
/// Sound: looping audio pitch/volume interpolates with speed, start/stop sound effects.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building near SellerMachine. Visual feedback for selling activity.
/// </summary>
[DefaultExecutionOrder(100)]
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Packaging/DepositBox")]
public class DepositBox : MonoBehaviour
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] GameObject _tier1Box, _tier2Box;
	[SerializeField] Animation _gearAnimation;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _objectToDisableWhenStopped;
	[SerializeField] Material _beltMovingMaterial, _beltStoppedMaterial;
	[SerializeField] Renderer _beltRenderer;
	[Header("Buckets")]
	[SerializeField] float _speed = 2f;
	[SerializeField] float _downBottomY, _upBottomY;
	[SerializeField] float _bucketSpacing = 1.86f;
	[SerializeField] float _bucketAcceleration = 0.2f;
	[SerializeField] float _bucketDeceleration = 0.5f;
	[SerializeField] List<Transform> _downBuckets = new List<Transform>();
	[SerializeField] List<Transform> _upBuckets = new List<Transform>();
	[Header("Sound")]
	[SerializeField] float _minPitch = 0.6f, _maxPitch = 1.1f;
	[SerializeField] float _minVolume, _maxVolume = 3f;
	[SerializeField] AudioSource _loopAudioSource;
	[SerializeField] float _soundStopThreshold = 0.03f;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _startSoundDefinition, _stopSoundDefinition;
	[Header("Misc")]
	public bool HasUpgradedToTier2;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	float downPathHeight, upPathHeight, currentSpeed;
	bool wasSpinning;
	float timeSinceLastSell = 9999f;
	#endregion

	void OnEnable()
	{
		_tier1Box.SetActive(!HasUpgradedToTier2);
		_tier2Box.SetActive(HasUpgradedToTier2);
		SetupBuckets();
		timeSinceLastSell = 9999f;
		if (_gearAnimation != null) _gearAnimation["GearAnimation"].speed = 0f;
		_objectToDisableWhenStopped.SetActive(false);
		// → subscribe to EconomyManager sell event
		Singleton<EconomyManager>.Ins.ItemSold += UpdateLastSellTime;
	}

	void OnDisable() => Singleton<EconomyManager>.Ins.ItemSold -= UpdateLastSellTime;

	void UpdateLastSellTime() => timeSinceLastSell = 0f;

	/// <summary> Upgrade visual from Tier1 to Tier2 box model. </summary>
	public void UpgradeToTier2()
	{
		if (HasUpgradedToTier2) return;
		HasUpgradedToTier2 = true;
		_tier1Box.SetActive(false); _tier2Box.SetActive(true);
	}

	/// <summary> Each frame: target speed from sell activity, accelerate/decelerate, move buckets. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		timeSinceLastSell += Time.deltaTime;
		// → target speed: full if recent sell, zero if idle too long
		float targetSpeed = (timeSinceLastSell <= _speed * _upBuckets.Count) ? _speed : 0f;
		float accel = (targetSpeed > currentSpeed) ? _bucketAcceleration : _bucketDeceleration;
		currentSpeed = Mathf.MoveTowards(currentSpeed, targetSpeed, accel * Time.deltaTime);
		bool spinning = currentSpeed > 0f;
		UpdateMotorSound();
		// → toggle stopped visual
		if (spinning != wasSpinning)
		{
			_objectToDisableWhenStopped.SetActive(spinning);
			var mats = _beltRenderer.sharedMaterials;
			mats[1] = spinning ? _beltMovingMaterial : _beltStoppedMaterial;
			_beltRenderer.sharedMaterials = mats;
		}
		if (spinning)
		{
			if (_gearAnimation != null) _gearAnimation["GearAnimation"].speed = currentSpeed / _speed;
			float delta = currentSpeed * Time.deltaTime;
			// → move down buckets
			foreach (var bucket in _downBuckets)
			{
				if (bucket == null) continue;
				var pos = bucket.position; pos.y -= delta;
				if (pos.y <= _downBottomY) pos.y += downPathHeight;
				bucket.position = pos;
			}
			// → move up buckets
			float upTop = _upBottomY + upPathHeight;
			foreach (var bucket in _upBuckets)
			{
				if (bucket == null) continue;
				var pos = bucket.position; pos.y += delta;
				if (pos.y >= upTop) pos.y -= upPathHeight;
				bucket.position = pos;
			}
		}
		wasSpinning = spinning;
	}

	void SetupBuckets()
	{
		downPathHeight = _bucketSpacing * Mathf.Max(1, _downBuckets.Count);
		upPathHeight = _bucketSpacing * Mathf.Max(1, _upBuckets.Count);
		// → position down buckets evenly
		if (_downBuckets.Count > 0)
		{
			float topY = _downBottomY + (_downBuckets.Count - 1) * _bucketSpacing;
			for (int i = 0; i < _downBuckets.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_downBuckets[i] == null) continue;
				var pos = _downBuckets[i].position; pos.y = topY - i * _bucketSpacing; _downBuckets[i].position = pos;
			}
		}
		// → position up buckets evenly
		if (_upBuckets.Count > 0)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _upBuckets.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_upBuckets[i] == null) continue;
				var pos = _upBuckets[i].position; pos.y = _upBottomY + i * _bucketSpacing; _upBuckets[i].position = pos;
			}
		}
	}

	void UpdateMotorSound()
	{
		if (_loopAudioSource == null) return;
		float norm = _speed > 0 ? Mathf.Clamp01(currentSpeed / _speed) : 0f;
		_loopAudioSource.pitch = Mathf.Lerp(_minPitch, _maxPitch, norm);
		_loopAudioSource.volume = Mathf.Lerp(_minVolume, _maxVolume, norm);
		if (norm > _soundStopThreshold)
		{
			if (!_loopAudioSource.isPlaying)
			{
				_loopAudioSource.Play();
				// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_startSoundDefinition, _loopAudioSource.transform.position);
			}
		}
		else if (_loopAudioSource.isPlaying)
		{
			_loopAudioSource.Stop();
			// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_stopSoundDefinition, _loopAudioSource.transform.position);
		}
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/OreAnalyzer.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: OrePiece (OreSystem — concrete), OreManager (OreSystem — concrete),
//       BaseHeldTool (ToolSystem B-1 — concrete for tool analysis),
//       BuildingCrate (BuildingSystem D — concrete for crate analysis),
//       BaseSellableItem (FREE), BasePhysicsObject (FREE)

/// <summary>
/// I analyze whatever enters my trigger and display info on 4 TMP texts: type, weight, sell value,
/// polish state. Also tracks items/minute with a rolling 60-second window.
/// Handles: OrePiece (full ore info), BuildingCrate (name + sell), BaseHeldTool (name + sell),
/// BaseSellableItem (generic sell), PlayerController ("Organic Material").
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building on conveyor line — ore flows through and info updates.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Packaging/OreAnalyzer")]
public class OreAnalyzer : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _analyzeSoundEffect;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] Transform _audioPosition;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _oreTypeText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _oreWeightText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _sellValueText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _polishedText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _itemsPerMinuteText;

	readonly List<float> entryTimes = new List<float>();
	float timeUntilNextIPMUpdate = 1f;
	float timeUntilClearRecent = 1f;
	readonly HashSet<BasePhysicsObject> recentlyCountedObjects = new HashSet<BasePhysicsObject>();

	void OnEnable() { SetDefaultText(); timeUntilNextIPMUpdate = 1f; timeUntilClearRecent = 1f; }

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		AddToItemCounter(other);
		// → try each type in priority order
		OrePiece ore = other.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
		if (ore != null) { AnalyzeOre(ore); return; }
		BuildingCrate crate = other.GetComponent<BuildingCrate>();
		if (crate != null) { AnalyzeBuildingCrate(crate); return; }
		BaseHeldTool tool = other.GetComponentInParent<BaseHeldTool>();
		if (tool != null) { AnalyzeTool(tool); return; }
		BaseSellableItem sellable = other.GetComponent<BaseSellableItem>();
		if (sellable != null) { AnalyzeGenericSellable(sellable); return; }
	}

	void AddToItemCounter(Collider other)
	{
		BasePhysicsObject bpo = other.GetComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
		if (bpo != null)
		{
			if (recentlyCountedObjects.Contains(bpo)) return;
			recentlyCountedObjects.Add(bpo);
		}
		entryTimes.Add(Time.time);
		UpdateItemsPerMin();
	}

	void UpdateItemsPerMin()
	{
		timeUntilNextIPMUpdate = 1f;
		float cutoff = Time.time - 60f;
		entryTimes.RemoveAll(t => t < cutoff);
		if (_itemsPerMinuteText != null) _itemsPerMinuteText.text = $"{entryTimes.Count} items / min";
	}

	void Update()
	{
		timeUntilNextIPMUpdate -= Time.deltaTime;
		if (timeUntilNextIPMUpdate < 0) UpdateItemsPerMin();
		timeUntilClearRecent -= Time.deltaTime;
		if (timeUntilClearRecent < 0) { timeUntilClearRecent = 2f; recentlyCountedObjects.Clear(); }
	}

	void AnalyzeOre(OrePiece ore)
	{
		PlayAnalyzeEffect();
		_oreTypeText.text = Singleton<OreManager>.Ins.GetColoredFormattedResourcePieceString(ore.ResourceType, ore.PieceType);
		// → polished state
		if (ore.IsPolished) _polishedText.text = "Polished";
		else if (ore.MakesPolishingMachineDirty) _polishedText.text = "Dirty";
		else if (ore.PolishedPrefab != null)
		{
			OrePiece polishedOre = ore.PolishedPrefab.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
			_polishedText.text = (polishedOre != null && polishedOre.MakesPolishingMachineDirty) ? "Dirty" : "Unpolished";
		}
		else _polishedText.text = "";
		_oreWeightText.text = $"{ore.RandomPriceMultiplier * 100f:0}%";
		_sellValueText.text = $"$ {ore.GetSellValue()}";
	}

	void AnalyzeTool(BaseHeldTool tool)
	{
		PlayAnalyzeEffect();
		_oreTypeText.text = tool.GetObjectName();
		_polishedText.text = ""; _oreWeightText.text = "";
		_sellValueText.text = $"$ {tool.GetSellValue()}";
	}

	void AnalyzeBuildingCrate(BuildingCrate crate)
	{
		PlayAnalyzeEffect();
		_oreTypeText.text = crate.GetObjectName();
		_polishedText.text = ""; _oreWeightText.text = "";
		_sellValueText.text = $"$ {crate.GetSellValue()}";
	}

	void AnalyzeGenericSellable(BaseSellableItem sellable)
	{
		PlayAnalyzeEffect();
		_oreTypeText.text = "Unknown";
		_polishedText.text = ""; _oreWeightText.text = "";
		_sellValueText.text = $"$ {sellable.GetSellValue()}";
	}

	void SetDefaultText()
	{
		if (_oreTypeText != null) _oreTypeText.text = "";
		if (_polishedText != null) _polishedText.text = "";
		if (_oreWeightText != null) _oreWeightText.text = "";
		if (_sellValueText != null) _sellValueText.text = "$ ";
	}

	void PlayAnalyzeEffect()
	{
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_analyzeSoundEffect, _audioPosition.position);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/PackagerMachine.cs ==== -->
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessIdentity (OreSystem C — interface), BoxObject (same system), ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G). ZERO concrete OrePiece import.

/// <summary>
/// I package loose ore into BoxObjects. Ore enters trigger → AddOrePiece → BoxContents tracks it →
/// ore.Delete(). When volume reaches MaxVolume → SpawnNewBox: Instantiate BoxPrefab at output,
/// Initialize with current contents, reset. Manifest text shows live contents + value.
/// ICustomSaveDataProvider saves current partial box contents for Phase G.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building, conveyor feeds ore into trigger.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Packaging/PackagerMachine")]
public class PackagerMachine : MonoBehaviour, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
	[Header("Machine")]
	[SerializeField] Transform _outputTransform;
	[SerializeField] BoxObject _boxPrefab;
	[Header("Manifest")]
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _manifestText;
	// Phase H: [Header("Audio")]
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _addObjectSoundEffect, _completeBoxSoundEffect;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] Transform _addObjectAudioPosition, _completeBoxAudioPosition;

	public BoxContents CurrentBoxContents = new BoxContents();

	void OnEnable() => UpdateManifestText();

	/// <summary> Adds ore to current box via IProcessIdentity. If full → spawn box. </summary>
	void AddOreToBox(IProcessIdentity ore)
	{
		CurrentBoxContents.AddOrePiece(ore.GetResourceType(), ore.GetPieceType(), ore.GetIsPolished(), 1);
		ore.Delete();
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_addObjectSoundEffect, _addObjectAudioPosition.position);
		if (CurrentBoxContents.GetCurrentVolume() >= CurrentBoxContents.MaxVolume) SpawnNewBox();
		else UpdateManifestText();
	}

	/// <summary> Instantiates BoxObject with current contents. Resets for next box. </summary>
	public void SpawnNewBox()
	{
		if (CurrentBoxContents.Contents.Count == 0) return;
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_completeBoxSoundEffect, _completeBoxAudioPosition.position);
		Object.Instantiate(_boxPrefab, _outputTransform.position, _outputTransform.rotation).Initialize(CurrentBoxContents);
		CurrentBoxContents = new BoxContents();
		UpdateManifestText();
	}

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore != null) AddOreToBox(ore);
	}

	public void UpdateManifestText() { if (_manifestText != null) _manifestText.text = CurrentBoxContents.GetManifestText(); }

	#region ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G)
	public virtual void LoadFromSave(string json)
	{
		BoxContents loaded = JsonUtility.FromJson<BoxContents>(json);
		if (loaded == null) { Debug.Log("Failed to load PackagerMachine data"); return; }
		CurrentBoxContents = loaded;
		UpdateManifestText();
	}
	public virtual string GetCustomSaveData() => JsonUtility.ToJson(CurrentBoxContents);
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/PackagingSystem/RapidAutoMiner.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: AutoMiner (AutoMinerSystem C — concrete extends), IDrillBitHost (ToolSystem B-1 — implements),
//       IInteractable (InteractionSystem A — interface), ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G),
//       BuildingObject (BuildingSystem D — concrete for OnBuildingRemoved),
//       OrePiece (OreSystem — concrete for BrokenDrillBitPrefab), BuildingManager (FREE — light materials)

/// <summary>
/// I extend AutoMiner with a drill bit attachment system. I only mine when a RapidAutoMinerDrillBit
/// is attached. The drill bit has durability — I consume it over time via UseDrillBit(). When broken,
/// I spawn BrokenDrillBitPrefab pieces and stop. DrillSpeedByDurabilityCurve controls speed falloff.
/// Implements IDrillBitHost so the drill bit (Phase B-1 ToolSystem) can query my state without
/// importing RapidAutoMiner directly. AttachDrillBit/EjectDrillBit handle the physical parent swap.
/// Override TurnOn: requires drill bit. Override Update: consume durability + adjust spawn rate.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building on BuildingPlacementNode. Player inserts drill bit tool.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Packaging/RapidAutoMiner")]
public class RapidAutoMiner : AutoMiner, IInteractable, ICustomSaveDataProvider, IDrillBitHost
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[Header("-- RapidAutoMiner --")]
	[SerializeField] RapidAutoMinerDrillBit _attachedDrillBit;
	[SerializeField] Transform _drillBitEjectPoint;
	[SerializeField] Transform _drillBitAttachmentParent;
	[SerializeField] Animator _animator;
	[SerializeField] BuildingObject _buildingObject;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _brokenDrillBitPrefab;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _drillBitBreakSound;
	#endregion

	#region IDrillBitHost — ToolSystem B-1 calls these
	public float GetDrillSpeed() => _attachedDrillBit != null ? _attachedDrillBit.GetDrillSpeedMultiplier() : 0f;
	public void AttachDrillBit(MonoBehaviour bit)
	{
		if (bit is RapidAutoMinerDrillBit db) AttachDrillBitInternal(db, true);
	}
	public void DetachDrillBit() => EjectCurrentDrillBit();
	public bool GetIsOn() => Enabled;
	#endregion

	#region AutoMiner Overrides
	public override void ConfigureFromDefinition()
	{
		if (ResourceDefinition != null) { SpawnProbability = ResourceDefinition.SpawnProbability; SpawnRate = ResourceDefinition.SpawnRate * 0.25f; }
	}

	protected override void OnEnable()
	{
		Enabled = _attachedDrillBit != null;
		_buildingObject.OnBuildingRemovedLocal += EjectCurrentDrillBit;
		base.OnEnable();
	}

	void OnDisable() => _buildingObject.OnBuildingRemovedLocal -= EjectCurrentDrillBit;

	protected override void Update()
	{
		// → consume drill bit durability
		if (Enabled && _attachedDrillBit != null)
		{
			_attachedDrillBit.UseDrillBit(Time.deltaTime);
			if (!_attachedDrillBit.LastsForever && _attachedDrillBit.IsBroken()) BreakCurrentDrillBit();
		}
		// → adjust spawn rate from durability curve + mine
		if (Enabled && _attachedDrillBit != null && ResourceDefinition != null)
		{
			float rate = _attachedDrillBit.GetCurrentRate();
			float speedMult = _attachedDrillBit.DrillSpeedByDurabilityCurve.Evaluate(rate);
			SpawnRate = ResourceDefinition.SpawnRate * speedMult;
			base.Update();
		}
	}

	protected override void TurnOn()
	{
		if (_attachedDrillBit == null) return;
		_animator.speed = 1f;
		base.TurnOn();
	}

	protected override void TurnOff()
	{
		_animator.speed = 0f;
		base.TurnOff();
	}
	#endregion

	#region Drill Bit Management
	/// <summary> Breaks current drill bit — destroy tool, spawn broken pieces, stop machine. </summary>
	void BreakCurrentDrillBit()
	{
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_drillBitBreakSound, _drillBitAttachmentParent.position);
		Destroy(_attachedDrillBit.gameObject);
		StartCoroutine(SpawnBrokenDrillBitPieces());
		_animator.speed = 0f;
		// Phase H: _audioSource_Loop.Pause();
		ChangeLightMaterial(Singleton<DataManager>.Ins.OrangeLightMaterial);
	}

	IEnumerator SpawnBrokenDrillBitPieces()
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.4f);
		if (gameObject == null || !gameObject.activeInHierarchy) yield break;
		if (_brokenDrillBitPrefab != null)
		{
			var piece1 = Instantiate(_brokenDrillBitPrefab, OreSpawnPoint.position, OreSpawnPoint.rotation);
			// → set mesh variant for broken piece 1
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
			if (gameObject != null && gameObject.activeInHierarchy)
				Instantiate(_brokenDrillBitPrefab, OreSpawnPoint.position, OreSpawnPoint.rotation);
		}
	}

	/// <summary> Attaches a drill bit tool physically to this machine. </summary>
	void AttachDrillBitInternal(RapidAutoMinerDrillBit drillBit, bool shouldTurnOn)
	{
		if (drillBit.IsBroken()) return;
		EjectCurrentDrillBit();
		_attachedDrillBit = drillBit;
		drillBit.SetDrillBitHost(this);
		drillBit.transform.SetParent(_drillBitAttachmentParent);
		drillBit.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		drillBit.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		if (shouldTurnOn) TurnOn();
	}

	/// <summary> Ejects current drill bit — unparent, enable physics, clear ref, stop machine. </summary>
	public void EjectCurrentDrillBit()
	{
		if (_attachedDrillBit == null) return;
		_attachedDrillBit.SetDrillBitHost(null);
		_attachedDrillBit.transform.SetParent(null);
		_attachedDrillBit.transform.position = _drillBitEjectPoint.position;
		_attachedDrillBit.transform.rotation = _drillBitEjectPoint.rotation;
		Rigidbody rb = _attachedDrillBit.GetComponentInChildren<Rigidbody>();
		if (rb != null) rb.isKinematic = false;
		_attachedDrillBit = null;
		_animator.speed = 0f;
		// Phase H: _audioSource_Loop.Pause();
		ChangeLightMaterial(Singleton<DataManager>.Ins.OrangeLightMaterial);
	}
	#endregion

	#region IInteractable
	public override void Interact(SO_InteractionOption selectedOption)
	{
		if (selectedOption.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle)
		{
			string name = selectedOption.GetOptionName();
			if (name.Contains("On")) TurnOn();
			else if (name.Contains("Off")) TurnOff();
			else if (name.Contains("Eject")) EjectCurrentDrillBit();
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G)
	public override void LoadFromSave(string json)
	{
		var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<AutoMinerSaveData>(json) ?? new AutoMinerSaveData();
		if (data.IsOn) StartCoroutine(WaitThenTryTurnOn());
	}

	IEnumerator WaitThenTryTurnOn()
	{
		yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
		yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
		yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
		if (_attachedDrillBit != null) TurnOn();
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/BlastFurnace.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessIdentity (OreSystem C — interface), IPackageProvider (PackagingSystem E — interface for display text),
//       IPoolSpawner (owned — interface for spawn output). ZERO concrete imports.

/// <summary>
/// I smelt crushed ore by majority type into ingots. Ore enters trigger → queued by ResourceType.
/// When queue reaches 6 → ProcessOre coroutine: determine output by majority resource → spawn ingot
/// prefab at output. If not all same type → produce Slag. Liquid plane rises with queue fill.
/// Visual queue (max 17) drives contents display. Looping sound fades based on activity.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building, conveyor feeds crushed ore into trigger.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/BlastFurnace")]
public class BlastFurnace : MonoBehaviour
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] Transform _outputTransform;
	[SerializeField] Transform _liquidPlane;
	[SerializeField] Animator _processingAnimator;
	[SerializeField] float _processingTime = 3f;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _goldIngotPrefab;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _ironIngotPrefab;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _copperIngotPrefab;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _slagPrefab;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _outputProductText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _contentsListText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _contentsBarText;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _pourSound;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _addSound;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] LoopingSoundFader _loopingSoundFader;
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	Queue<ResourceType> resourceQueue = new Queue<ResourceType>();
	Queue<ResourceType> visualResourceQueue = new Queue<ResourceType>();
	List<IProcessIdentity> waitingList = new List<IProcessIdentity>();
	bool isProcessing;
	const int MAX_QUEUE = 30;
	const int MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE = 17;
	const int AMOUNT_REQUIRED = 6;
	float initialLiquidPlaneY;
	#endregion

	void Start()
	{
		if (_liquidPlane != null) initialLiquidPlaneY = _liquidPlane.localPosition.y;
		if (_processingAnimator != null) _processingAnimator.speed = 1f / _processingTime;
	}

	void OnEnable() { RefreshContentsDisplay(); _outputProductText.text = ""; }

	/// <summary> Each frame: process waiting ore, start smelting when enough, update liquid plane. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		waitingList.RemoveAll(o => o == null || !(o as UnityEngine.Component).gameObject.activeInHierarchy);
		if (resourceQueue.Count < MAX_QUEUE && waitingList.Count > 0) ProcessWaitingOrePiece();
		if (resourceQueue.Count >= AMOUNT_REQUIRED && !isProcessing) StartCoroutine(ProcessOre());
		UpdateLiquidPlane();
	}

	void UpdateLiquidPlane()
	{
		if (_liquidPlane == null) return;
		float fill = Mathf.Clamp01((float)resourceQueue.Count / MAX_QUEUE);
		var pos = _liquidPlane.localPosition; pos.y = initialLiquidPlaneY + 1f * fill; _liquidPlane.localPosition = pos;
	}

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore == null) return;
		if (resourceQueue.Count < MAX_QUEUE) EnqueueOrePiece(ore);
		else waitingList.Add(ore);
	}

	void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore != null) waitingList.Remove(ore);
	}

	void ProcessWaitingOrePiece()
	{
		if (waitingList.Count == 0) return;
		EnqueueOrePiece(waitingList[0]); waitingList.RemoveAt(0);
	}

	/// <summary> Adds ore to both queues, deletes via IProcessIdentity.Delete(), plays add sound. </summary>
	void EnqueueOrePiece(IProcessIdentity ore)
	{
		if (ore == null) return;
		bool wasUnderVisualCap = visualResourceQueue.Count < MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE;
		resourceQueue.Enqueue(ore.GetResourceType());
		visualResourceQueue.Enqueue(ore.GetResourceType());
		if (wasUnderVisualCap)
		{
			RefreshContentsDisplay();
			if (visualResourceQueue.Count <= AMOUNT_REQUIRED) UpdateProjectedOutputResource();
		}
		ore.Delete();
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_addSound, _liquidPlane.position);
	}

	/// <summary> Dequeues 6 resources, determines majority type, spawns output prefab. </summary>
	IEnumerator ProcessOre()
	{
		isProcessing = true;
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_pourSound, _outputTransform.position);
		_processingAnimator.Play("BlastFurnace_Process");
		var batch = new List<ResourceType>();
		for (int i = 0; i < AMOUNT_REQUIRED; i++) batch.Add(resourceQueue.Dequeue());
		ResourceType output = DetermineOutputResourceType(batch);
		_outputProductText.text = PackageProviderBridge.Provider?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(output) ?? output.ToString();
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(_processingTime);
		CreateOutputOrePiece(output);
		for (int i = 0; i < AMOUNT_REQUIRED; i++) visualResourceQueue.Dequeue();
		RefreshContentsDisplay();
		isProcessing = false;
		// Phase H: if (resourceQueue.Count == 0) _loopingSoundFader.FadeTo(0f, 5f);
	}

	void UpdateProjectedOutputResource()
	{
		if (resourceQueue.Count == 0) { _outputProductText.text = ""; return; }
		ResourceType output = DetermineOutputResourceType(new List<ResourceType>(resourceQueue));
		_outputProductText.text = PackageProviderBridge.Provider?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(output) ?? output.ToString();
	}

	void RefreshContentsDisplay()
	{
		var unique = new HashSet<ResourceType>(visualResourceQueue);
		var p = PackageProviderBridge.Provider;
		_contentsListText.text = "Contents:\n* " + string.Join("\n* ", unique.Select(r => p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(r) ?? r.ToString()));
		var queue = new Queue<ResourceType>(visualResourceQueue);
		_contentsBarText.text = "";
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE && queue.Count > 0; i++)
		{
			var rt = queue.Dequeue();
			_contentsBarText.text += $"<color=#{ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGB(p?.GetResourceColor(rt) ?? Color.white)}>|</color>";
			if (i == AMOUNT_REQUIRED - 1) _contentsBarText.text += " ";
		}
	}

	/// <summary> If all same type → that type. If mixed → Slag. </summary>
	ResourceType DetermineOutputResourceType(List<ResourceType> batch)
	{
		var majority = batch.GroupBy(r => r).OrderByDescending(g => g.Count()).First().Key;
		return batch.All(r => r == majority) ? majority : ResourceType.Slag;
	}

	void CreateOutputOrePiece(ResourceType rt)
	{
		GameObject prefab = rt switch
		{
			ResourceType.Gold => _goldIngotPrefab,
			ResourceType.Iron => _ironIngotPrefab,
			ResourceType.Copper => _copperIngotPrefab,
			_ => _slagPrefab
		};
		if (prefab != null) PoolSpawnerBridge.Spawner?.SpawnPooled(prefab, _outputTransform.position, _outputTransform.rotation);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/Bridge/PoolSpawnerBridge.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/CastingFurnace.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessIdentity (OreSystem C — interface), IPackageProvider (PackagingSystem E — interface for display text),
//       IPoolSpawner (owned — interface for spawn output),
//       ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G stub). ZERO concrete imports.

/// <summary>
/// I'm the casting furnace — the most complex processing machine. I smelt queued ore into shaped
/// products based on which molds are inserted. Ore enters trigger → queued by ResourceType
/// (PieceType determines how many units: Ingot=6, Gear/Plate/Pipe/Rod/ThreadedRod=5, JunkCast=3, else=1).
/// When queue reaches _materialRequiredToSmelt (sum of all mold requirements) → ProcessOre coroutine:
/// determine output by majority + coal check for Steel → spawn output prefabs at each mold's eject point.
/// Coal burns per second. Coal input is separate trigger (CastingFurnaceCoalInput).
/// Liquid plane, contents bar, output text, looping sound all update based on state.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building. Conveyors feed ore in. CastingFurnaceCoalInput feeds coal.
/// CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler handles player interactions (eject molds).
/// CastingFurnaceMoldArea handles mold insertion/ejection (implements IMoldReceiver).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/CastingFurnace")]
public class CastingFurnace : MonoBehaviour, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
	#region Inspector Fields
	[SerializeField] List<CastingFurnaceMoldArea> _moldAreas;
	[SerializeField] Transform _liquidPlane;
	[SerializeField] Animator _processingAnimator;
	[SerializeField] float _processingTime = 6f;
	[SerializeField] float _coalBurnedPerSecond = 0.5f;
	[SerializeField] float _materialPerCoalConsumed = 3f;
	// → removed: [SerializeField] BuildingObject _buildingObject;
	// → now uses GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved(Vector3) instead of concrete BuildingObject ref
	[SerializeField] Transform _pourSoundPosition;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _outputProductText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _contentsListText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _contentsBarText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _requiredAmountBarText;
	[SerializeField] TMP_Text _moreCoalRequiredText;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _pourSound;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] SoundDefinition _addSound;
	// Phase H: [SerializeField] LoopingSoundFader _loopingSoundFader;
	[SerializeField] List<CastingMoldRendererInfo> _castingMoldRendererInfos;
	[SerializeField] List<CastingFurnaceMoldRecipeSet> _moldRecipeSets;
	#endregion

	#region Public API
	public List<CastingFurnaceMoldArea> MoldAreas => _moldAreas;
	public float CoalAmount;
	public const float MAX_COAL = 100f;
	public float GetRequiredCoalForSteel() => (float)materialRequiredToSmelt / _materialPerCoalConsumed;
	public void AddCoal(int amount) { CoalAmount = Mathf.Clamp(CoalAmount + amount, 0f, MAX_COAL); }
	public CastingMoldRendererInfo GetCastingMoldRendererInfo(CastingMoldType type)
	{
		if (type == CastingMoldType.none) return null;
		return _castingMoldRendererInfos.Find(info => info.CastingMoldType == type);
	}
	#endregion

	#region Private State
	Queue<ResourceType> resourceQueue = new Queue<ResourceType>();
	Queue<ResourceType> visualResourceQueue = new Queue<ResourceType>();
	List<IProcessIdentity> waitingList = new List<IProcessIdentity>();
	bool isProcessing;
	const int MAX_QUEUE = 200;
	const int MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE = 29;
	float initialLiquidPlaneY;
	int materialRequiredToSmelt;
	#endregion

	#region Unity Lifecycle
	void Start()
	{
		if (_liquidPlane != null) initialLiquidPlaneY = _liquidPlane.localPosition.y;
		if (_processingAnimator != null) _processingAnimator.speed = 1f / _processingTime;
	}

	void OnEnable()
	{
		// purpose: eject all molds when this building is removed
		GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved += OnBuildingRemovedAtPosition;
		RefreshContentsDisplay();
		_outputProductText.text = "";
		for (int i = 0; i < _moldAreas.Count; i++)
			_moldAreas[i].Initialize(this, i, CastingMoldType.none);
		RecalculateMaterialAmountRequired();
	}

	void OnDisable() => GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved -= OnBuildingRemovedAtPosition;

	/// <summary> Each frame: process waiting ore, start smelting when enough, burn coal, update visuals. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		waitingList.RemoveAll(o => o == null || !(o as UnityEngine.Component).gameObject.activeInHierarchy);
		if (resourceQueue.Count < MAX_QUEUE && waitingList.Count > 0) ProcessWaitingOrePiece();
		if (resourceQueue.Count >= materialRequiredToSmelt && !isProcessing) StartCoroutine(ProcessOre());
		UpdateLiquidPlane();
		// → burn coal
		if (CoalAmount > 0f) { CoalAmount -= _coalBurnedPerSecond * Time.deltaTime; if (CoalAmount < 0f) CoalAmount = 0f; }
	}
	#endregion

	#region Mold Management
	/// <summary> If this building is removed (position matches within grid snap tolerance) → eject all molds.
	/// Uses 0.1f tolerance instead of 1f to avoid false positives with adjacent buildings on 1m grid. </summary>
	void OnBuildingRemovedAtPosition(Vector3 removedPos)
	{
		if (Vector3.Distance(removedPos, transform.position) < 0.1f)
			foreach (var area in _moldAreas) area.EjectMold();
	}

	/// <summary> Recalculates total material needed by summing all mold requirements. </summary>
	public void RecalculateMaterialAmountRequired()
	{
		materialRequiredToSmelt = 0;
		foreach (var area in _moldAreas)
		{
			var set = _moldRecipeSets.Find(s => s.CastingMoldType == area.CastingMoldType);
			materialRequiredToSmelt += set != null ? set.AmountOfMaterialRequired : 6;
		}
		// → update required amount bar
		if (materialRequiredToSmelt < MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE)
		{
			_requiredAmountBarText.text = new string(' ', materialRequiredToSmelt - 1) + "|";
		}
		else _requiredAmountBarText.text = "";
	}
	#endregion

	#region Ore Processing
	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore == null) return;
		if (resourceQueue.Count < MAX_QUEUE) EnqueueOrePiece(ore);
		else waitingList.Add(ore);
	}

	void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore != null) waitingList.Remove(ore);
	}

	void ProcessWaitingOrePiece()
	{
		if (waitingList.Count == 0) return;
		EnqueueOrePiece(waitingList[0]); waitingList.RemoveAt(0);
	}

	/// <summary> Adds ore to queue — PieceType determines unit count. Deletes ore piece. </summary>
	void EnqueueOrePiece(IProcessIdentity ore)
	{
		if (ore == null) return;
		// → piece type determines how many resource units
		int units = ore.GetPieceType() switch
		{
			PieceType.ingot => 6,
			PieceType.gear => 5, PieceType.plate => 5, PieceType.pipe => 5,
			PieceType.rod => 5, PieceType.threadedRod => 5,
			PieceType.junkCast => 3,
			_ => 1
		};
		bool wasUnderVisualCap = visualResourceQueue.Count < MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE;
		for (int i = 0; i < units; i++) { resourceQueue.Enqueue(ore.GetResourceType()); visualResourceQueue.Enqueue(ore.GetResourceType()); }
		if (wasUnderVisualCap) { RefreshContentsDisplay(); if (visualResourceQueue.Count <= materialRequiredToSmelt) UpdateProjectedOutputResource(); }
		ore.Delete();
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_addSound, _liquidPlane.position);
	}

	/// <summary> Dequeues materialRequired resources, determines output, spawns products at each mold. </summary>
	IEnumerator ProcessOre()
	{
		isProcessing = true;
		// Phase H: SoundManager.PlaySoundAtLocation(_pourSound, _pourSoundPosition.position);
		_processingAnimator.Play("BlastFurnace_Process");
		var batch = new List<ResourceType>();
		for (int i = 0; i < materialRequiredToSmelt; i++) batch.Add(resourceQueue.Dequeue());
		ResourceType output = DetermineOutputResourceType(batch);
		_outputProductText.text = PackageProviderBridge.Provider?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(output) ?? output.ToString();
		_moreCoalRequiredText.text = "Processing...";
		// → steel consumes coal
		if (output == ResourceType.Steel) { CoalAmount -= GetRequiredCoalForSteel(); if (CoalAmount < 0f) CoalAmount = 0f; }
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(_processingTime);
		CreateOutputOrePieces(output);
		for (int i = 0; i < materialRequiredToSmelt && visualResourceQueue.Count > 0; i++) visualResourceQueue.Dequeue();
		isProcessing = false;
		RefreshContentsDisplay();
		// Phase H: if (resourceQueue.Count == 0) _loopingSoundFader.FadeTo(0f, 5f);
	}

	/// <summary> All same type → that type. Iron + coal → Steel. Mixed → Slag. </summary>
	ResourceType DetermineOutputResourceType(List<ResourceType> batch)
	{
		var majority = batch.GroupBy(r => r).OrderByDescending(g => g.Count()).First().Key;
		bool allSame = batch.All(r => r == majority);
		float coalNeeded = GetRequiredCoalForSteel();
		// → iron + coal = steel
		if (majority == ResourceType.Iron && CoalAmount > coalNeeded) majority = ResourceType.Steel;
		if (allSame) return majority;
		// → all iron+steel mix + enough coal → steel
		bool allIronOrSteel = batch.All(r => r == ResourceType.Iron || r == ResourceType.Steel);
		if (!allSame && allIronOrSteel && CoalAmount > coalNeeded) return ResourceType.Steel;
		return ResourceType.Slag;
	}

	/// <summary> Spawns output prefab at each mold area's eject point based on recipe. </summary>
	void CreateOutputOrePieces(ResourceType rt)
	{
		foreach (var area in _moldAreas)
		{
			var recipeSet = _moldRecipeSets.Find(s => s.CastingMoldType == area.CastingMoldType);
			var recipe = recipeSet?.Recipes.Find(r => r.InputResourceType == rt);
			if (recipe != null)
			{
				if (recipe.OutputPrefab != null)
					PoolSpawnerBridge.Spawner?.SpawnPooled(recipe.OutputPrefab, area.ProductEjectTransform.position, area.ProductEjectTransform.rotation);
				if (recipe.SecondaryOutputPrefab != null && area.SecondaryProductEjectTransform != null)
					PoolSpawnerBridge.Spawner?.SpawnPooled(recipe.SecondaryOutputPrefab, area.SecondaryProductEjectTransform.position, area.SecondaryProductEjectTransform.rotation);
			}
		}
	}
	#endregion

	#region Display
	void UpdateLiquidPlane()
	{
		if (_liquidPlane == null) return;
		float fill = Mathf.Clamp01((float)resourceQueue.Count / MAX_QUEUE);
		var pos = _liquidPlane.localPosition; pos.y = initialLiquidPlaneY + 1f * fill; _liquidPlane.localPosition = pos;
	}

	void UpdateProjectedOutputResource()
	{
		if (resourceQueue.Count == 0) { _outputProductText.text = ""; return; }
		ResourceType output = DetermineOutputResourceType(new List<ResourceType>(resourceQueue));
		_outputProductText.text = PackageProviderBridge.Provider?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(output) ?? output.ToString();
	}

	void RefreshContentsDisplay()
	{
		var unique = new HashSet<ResourceType>(visualResourceQueue);
		var p = PackageProviderBridge.Provider;
		_contentsListText.text = "Contents:\n* " + string.Join("\n* ", unique.Select(r => p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(r) ?? r.ToString()));
		var queue = new Queue<ResourceType>(visualResourceQueue);
		_contentsBarText.text = "";
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VISUAL_QUEUE && queue.Count > 0; i++)
		{
			var rt = queue.Dequeue();
			_contentsBarText.text += $"<color=#{ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGB(p?.GetResourceColor(rt) ?? Color.white)}>|</color>";
			if (i == materialRequiredToSmelt - 1) _contentsBarText.text += " ";
		}
		// → coal status
		if (isProcessing) _moreCoalRequiredText.text = "Processing...";
		else if (CoalAmount > GetRequiredCoalForSteel()) _moreCoalRequiredText.text = $"Sufficient {p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(ResourceType.Coal) ?? "Coal"} for {p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(ResourceType.Steel) ?? "Steel"}";
		else _moreCoalRequiredText.text = $"More {p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(ResourceType.Coal) ?? "Coal"} required for {p?.GetColoredResourceTypeString(ResourceType.Steel) ?? "Steel"}";
	}
	#endregion

	#region ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G)
	public virtual void LoadFromSave(string json)
	{
		var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<CastingFurnaceSaveData>(json) ?? new CastingFurnaceSaveData();
		CoalAmount = data.CoalAmount;
		if (_moldAreas.Count > 0) _moldAreas[0].InsertMoldFromLoading(data.Mold1Type);
		if (_moldAreas.Count > 1) _moldAreas[1].InsertMoldFromLoading(data.Mold2Type);
		if (_moldAreas.Count > 2) _moldAreas[2].InsertMoldFromLoading(data.Mold3Type);
		RecalculateMaterialAmountRequired();
	}

	public virtual string GetCustomSaveData()
	{
		return JsonUtility.ToJson(new CastingFurnaceSaveData
		{
			CoalAmount = CoalAmount,
			Mold1Type = _moldAreas.Count > 0 ? _moldAreas[0].CastingMoldType : CastingMoldType.none,
			Mold2Type = _moldAreas.Count > 1 ? _moldAreas[1].CastingMoldType : CastingMoldType.none,
			Mold3Type = _moldAreas.Count > 2 ? _moldAreas[2].CastingMoldType : CastingMoldType.none,
		});
	}
	#endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/CastingFurnaceCoalInput.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessIdentity (OreSystem C — interface only), CastingFurnace (same system). ZERO concrete OrePiece import.

/// <summary>
/// I'm the coal input trigger for a CastingFurnace. When ore enters: if Coal type → AddCoal
/// (amount varies by PieceType: ore=2, oreCluster=4, else=1). If Slag → AddCoal(3).
/// Then delete via IProcessIdentity.Delete(). Coal fuels Steel production in the furnace.
///
/// Who uses me: child of CastingFurnace building, separate trigger collider.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/CastingFurnaceCoalInput")]
public class CastingFurnaceCoalInput : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] CastingFurnace _parentFurnace;

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessIdentity ore = other.GetComponentInParent<IProcessIdentity>();
		if (ore == null) return;
		// → coal type → add coal based on piece size
		if (ore.GetResourceType() == ResourceType.Coal)
		{
			if (ore.GetPieceType() == PieceType.ore) _parentFurnace.AddCoal(2);
			else if (ore.GetPieceType() == PieceType.oreCluster) _parentFurnace.AddCoal(4);
			else _parentFurnace.AddCoal(1);
		}
		else if (ore.GetResourceType() == ResourceType.Slag)
		{
			_parentFurnace.AddCoal(3);
		}
		ore.Delete();
	}
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IInteractable (InteractionSystem A — interface), CastingFurnace (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I handle player interactions on the CastingFurnace building via IInteractable.
/// Options: "Eject Mold 1/2/3" → calls CastingFurnace.MoldAreas[n].EjectMold().
/// Separate from CastingFurnace so the interaction collider can be on a different GO.
///
/// Who uses me: placed on the interaction collider child of the CastingFurnace building.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler")]
public class CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable
{
	[SerializeField] CastingFurnace _castingFurnace;
	[SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;

	public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
	public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
	public string GetObjectName() => "Casting Furnace";

	/// <summary> Routes interaction to the correct mold area's EjectMold. </summary>
	public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption selectedOption)
	{
		// → eject mold by slot number (mapped via interaction option name or index)
		if (selectedOption.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle)
		{
			// → find which slot from the option name
			string name = selectedOption.GetOptionName();
			if (name.Contains("1") && _castingFurnace.MoldAreas.Count > 0) _castingFurnace.MoldAreas[0].EjectMold();
			else if (name.Contains("2") && _castingFurnace.MoldAreas.Count > 1) _castingFurnace.MoldAreas[1].EjectMold();
			else if (name.Contains("3") && _castingFurnace.MoldAreas.Count > 2) _castingFurnace.MoldAreas[2].EjectMold();
		}
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/CastingFurnaceMoldArea.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: CastingFurnace (same system), IMoldReceiver (ToolSystem B-1 — implements)

/// <summary>
/// I'm one mold slot on a CastingFurnace. ToolCastingMold calls InsertMold(int) via IMoldReceiver
/// interface. I store the CastingMoldType, update the mold visual, and tell the furnace to
/// recalculate material requirements. EjectMold spawns the mold tool back at the eject point.
///
/// Who uses me: CastingFurnace owns 3 of me (MoldAreas list). ToolCastingMold interacts via IMoldReceiver.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/CastingFurnaceMoldArea")]
public class CastingFurnaceMoldArea : MonoBehaviour, IMoldReceiver
{
	[SerializeField] Transform _moldToolEjectTransform;
	[SerializeField] Transform _productEjectTransform;
	[SerializeField] Transform _secondaryProductEjectTransform;
	[SerializeField] Renderer _moldRenderer;

	[HideInInspector] public CastingMoldType CastingMoldType;
	public Transform ProductEjectTransform => _productEjectTransform;
	public Transform SecondaryProductEjectTransform => _secondaryProductEjectTransform;

	CastingFurnace owner;
	int slotNumber;

	/// <summary> Called by CastingFurnace.OnEnable to set owner + slot + initial type. </summary>
	public void Initialize(CastingFurnace ownerFurnace, int slot, CastingMoldType type)
	{
		owner = ownerFurnace; slotNumber = slot; CastingMoldType = type; UpdateRender();
	}

	/// <summary> Updates mold visual — shows mesh+material from CastingMoldRendererInfo, or hides if none. </summary>
	public void UpdateRender()
	{
		if (CastingMoldType == CastingMoldType.none) { _moldRenderer.gameObject.SetActive(false); return; }
		var info = owner.GetCastingMoldRendererInfo(CastingMoldType);
		if (info == null) return;
		_moldRenderer.sharedMaterial = info.Material;
		_moldRenderer.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = info.Mesh;
		_moldRenderer.gameObject.SetActive(true);
	}

	/// <summary> Phase G: called during load to set mold type without ejecting first. </summary>
	public void InsertMoldFromLoading(CastingMoldType type) { CastingMoldType = type; UpdateRender(); }

	/// <summary> IMoldReceiver: ToolCastingMold calls this. Ejects current, sets new, recalculates. </summary>
	public void InsertMold(int moldType)
	{
		EjectMold();
		CastingMoldType = (CastingMoldType)moldType;
		UpdateRender();
		owner.RecalculateMaterialAmountRequired();
	}

	/// <summary> Spawns the current mold as a tool at eject point, clears slot. </summary>
	public void EjectMold()
	{
		if (CastingMoldType == CastingMoldType.none) return;
		// → find the mold tool prefab by type from save manager's prefab list
		// Phase G: Singleton<SavingLoadingManager>.Ins.AllSavableObjectPrefabs.Find(...)
		// For now: just clear the slot (prefab lookup requires Phase G)
		CastingMoldType = CastingMoldType.none;
		UpdateRender();
		owner.RecalculateMaterialAmountRequired();
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/ClusterBreaker.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessConvertible (OreSystem C — interface only). ZERO concrete OrePiece import.

/// <summary>
/// I break ore clusters into individual pieces. Moving piece oscillates up/down with sine wave.
/// When ore enters trigger, wait 1-2s random then call OrePiece.CompleteClusterBreaking().
/// Similar to CrusherMachine but for OreCluster → individual ore pieces.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building, conveyor feeds ore clusters into trigger.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/ClusterBreaker")]
public class ClusterBreaker : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] GameObject _movingPiece;
	[SerializeField] float _amplitude = 0.03f;
	[SerializeField] float _speed = 15f;

	readonly HashSet<IProcessConvertible> crushing = new HashSet<IProcessConvertible>();
	Vector3 movingPieceStartPos;

	void Awake() => movingPieceStartPos = _movingPiece.transform.localPosition;

	/// <summary> Oscillates moving piece up/down with sine wave. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		float y = Mathf.Sin(Time.time * _speed) * _amplitude;
		_movingPiece.transform.localPosition = movingPieceStartPos + Vector3.up * y;
	}

	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessConvertible conv = other.GetComponent<IProcessConvertible>();
		if (conv != null && !crushing.Contains(conv)) { crushing.Add(conv); StartCoroutine(CrushOre(conv)); }
	}

	/// <summary> Random 1-2s delay then CompleteClusterBreaking on the ore. </summary>
	IEnumerator CrushOre(IProcessConvertible conv)
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(Random.Range(1f, 2f));
		if (!crushing.Contains(conv)) yield break;
		if (conv != null) { crushing.Remove(conv); conv.CompleteClusterBreaking(); }
		else crushing.RemoveWhere(o => o == null);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/CrusherMachine.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessConvertible (OreSystem C — interface only). ZERO concrete OrePiece import.

/// <summary>
/// I crush ore into 2× smaller pieces. When ore enters my trigger, I wait 1 second then call
/// IProcessConvertible.TryCrush(). Two grinding pieces rotate visually in opposite directions.
/// HashSet prevents double-processing the same ore piece.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as building, conveyor feeds ore into trigger.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/CrusherMachine")]
public class CrusherMachine : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] float _rotateSpeed = 50f;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _grindingPiece1;
	[SerializeField] GameObject _grindingPiece2;

	readonly HashSet<IProcessConvertible> crushing = new HashSet<IProcessConvertible>();

	/// <summary> Rotates grinding pieces in opposite directions every frame. </summary>
	void Update()
	{
		float deg = _rotateSpeed * Time.deltaTime;
		_grindingPiece1.transform.Rotate(Vector3.right, deg);
		_grindingPiece2.transform.Rotate(Vector3.right, -deg);
	}

	/// <summary> Ore enters trigger → IProcessConvertible → start crush if not already crushing. </summary>
	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessConvertible conv = other.GetComponent<IProcessConvertible>();
		if (conv != null && !crushing.Contains(conv))
		{
			crushing.Add(conv);
			StartCoroutine(CrushOre(conv));
		}
	}

	/// <summary> Waits 1s then TryCrush via interface. Cleans null refs. </summary>
	IEnumerator CrushOre(IProcessConvertible conv)
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(1f);
		if (!crushing.Contains(conv)) yield break;
		if (conv != null) { crushing.Remove(conv); conv.TryCrush(); }
		else crushing.RemoveWhere(o => o == null);
	}
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-e/Scripts/_-Systems/ProcessingSystem/Dependency.md ==== -->
# ProcessingSystem — L4 ✅ Interface-Only (ZERO concrete imports)

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Phase | E |
| Level | **L4** (all interface deps — ZERO concrete) |
| Shape | 🔌 Adapter |
| Scripts | CrusherMachine, ClusterBreaker, ShakerTable, DepositBoxCrusher, PolishingMachine, BlastFurnace, CastingFurnace, CastingFurnaceCoalInput, CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler, CastingFurnaceMoldArea, RollingMill, PipeRoller, RodExtruder, ThreadingLathe |
| Owns Interface | **IPoolSpawner** |
| Implements | IMoldReceiver (B-1) on CastingFurnaceMoldArea, IInteractable (A) on CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler, ICustomSaveDataProvider (G) on CastingFurnace |
| Imports Interface | IProcessIdentity + IProcessConvertible + IProcessProgressable (OreSystem C), IPackageProvider (PackagingSystem E), IMoldReceiver (ToolSystem B-1), IInteractable (InteractionSystem A) |
| Concrete Deps | **NONE** (ConveyorBelt on PolishingMachine is same-prefab [SerializeField]) |
| FREE | DataManager (light materials), UtilsPhaseB (SimpleExplosion), GameEvents (OnBuildingRemoved) |
| Bridge | PoolSpawnerBridge (owns — pushes IPoolSpawner from OrePiecePoolManager) |

## Architecture: 3-Tier Process Interfaces + IPoolSpawner + IPackageProvider
14/14 machines have ZERO concrete imports from other `_-Systems/` folders.
- **IProcessIdentity/Convertible/Progressable** → replaces all `GetComponent<OrePiece>()`
- **IPoolSpawner** (owned) → replaces `Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre()`
- **IPackageProvider** (from PackagingSystem) → replaces `Singleton<OreManager>.Ins.GetColoredResourceTypeString()`
- **GameEvents.OnBuildingRemoved** → replaces `BuildingObject.OnBuildingRemovedLocal`
- **DataManager** → replaces `BuildingManager` for light materials (FREE infra)

## Internal Dependency Graph
```
  ┌── ProcessingSystem/ ────────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  INTERNAL — 14 self-contained machines
  │  CrusherMachine → trigger → WaitForSeconds → OrePiece.TryConvertToCrushed
  │  ClusterBreaker → trigger → random delay → OrePiece.CompleteClusterBreaking
  │  ShakerTable → trigger → OrePiece.AddSieveValue each frame
  │  DepositBoxCrusher → trigger → crush + SimpleExplosion
  │  PolishingMachine → trigger → OrePiece.AddPolish + dirty/clean state
  │  BlastFurnace → queue 6 → majority type → spawn ingot
  │  CastingFurnace → queue N → mold recipes → spawn shaped output (coal for steel)
  │    ├── CastingFurnaceCoalInput (child trigger → AddCoal)
  │    ├── CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler (IInteractable → eject molds)
  │    └── CastingFurnaceMoldArea (IMoldReceiver → insert/eject molds)
  │  RollingMill → ingot → plate (jam detection + launch)
  │  PipeRoller → 2 plates → pipe (two-stage animation, weld particle)
  │  RodExtruder → ingot → rod (dual lane, lerp visual)
  │  ThreadingLathe → rod → threaded rod (multi-stage animation)
  │
  ├── BOUNDARY ───────────────────────────────────────────
  │
  │  IMPLEMENTS:
  │  ◆ IMoldReceiver ◆ ←── ToolSystem (B-1) — CastingFurnaceMoldArea.InsertMold(int)
  │  ◆ IInteractable ◆ ←── InteractionSystem (A) — CastingFurnaceInteractionHandler
  │  ◆ ICustomSaveDataProvider ◆ ←── Phase G — CastingFurnace save/load
  │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IProcessConvertible (OreSystem C — interface only). ZERO concrete OrePiece import.

/// <summary>
/// I'm a variant crusher inside the DepositBox bucket elevator. When ore enters trigger,
/// wait 0.3s → IProcessConvertible.TryCrush() → small explosion.
///
/// Who uses me: child of DepositBox building.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Processing/DepositBoxCrusher")]
public class DepositBoxCrusher : MonoBehaviour
{
	void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
	{
		IProcessConvertible conv = other.GetComponent<IProcessConvertible>();
		if (conv != null) StartCoroutine(CrushOre(conv));
	}

	/// <summary> Short delay → crush via interface → physics explosion. </summary>
	IEnumerator CrushOre(IProcessConvertible conv)
	{
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.3f);
		if (conv != null && conv.TryCrush())
		{
			yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
			yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
			UtilsPhaseB.SimpleExplosion(transform.position, 0.5f, 6f, 0.5f);
		}
	}
}
